tooltip.wildercord.armor.emberweave: Each worn piece softens spells by 3% while you sprint and move (12% with four pieces).
tooltip.wildercord.armor.rimebound: Begin crouching to guard for 0.6 seconds: 4% spell protection per piece. Recharges in 4 seconds.
tooltip.wildercord.armor.stonebound: Each piece gives 4% spell protection and 10% less spell knockback, but 3% less movement speed.
tooltip.wildercord.armor.mirror_thread: Begin crouching to guard for 0.6 seconds. Soften one spell by half and return a fragment (at most 2 damage). Recharges in 5 seconds.
message.wildercord.armor_guard: Guard ready - catch the next spell!
message.wildercord.cinnamon.grow: Cinnamon grows! Her first treat starts one 60-second growth window.
message.wildercord.cinnamon.growth_full: Cinnamon is at her safe size limit. No treat was used.
message.wildercord.cinnamon.growth_block: Cinnamon needs clear space and solid ground to grow. No treat was used.
message.wildercord.cinnamon.exhausted: Cinnamon needs 30 seconds to recover. She'll follow you without attacking.
message.wildercord.cinnamon.recovered: Cinnamon has recovered and can defend you again.
message.wildercord.cinnamon.rest_follow: Cinnamon is recovering. She'll keep following until she feels better.
message.wildercord.cinnamon.recall_owner: This whistle answers only to Cinnamon's configured owner.
message.wildercord.cinnamon.recall_wait: Calling Cinnamon. If her saved chunk is unloaded, recovery can take up to 10 seconds.
message.wildercord.cinnamon.recall_ok: Cinnamon is here and following you.
message.wildercord.cinnamon.recall_block: Cinnamon needs a clear, permitted landing near you. Leave combat, wards or cramped spaces and try again.
message.wildercord.cinnamon.recall_missi: Cinnamon's saved body wasn't recovered. No copy was created. Try again near her last location or ask your server admin.
message.wildercord.cinnamon.recall_retir: Cinnamon was removed by an administrator. The whistle won't recreate her.
message.wildercord.cinnamon.recall_coold: The whistle is resting. Wait up to 10 seconds before calling again.
message.wildercord.cinnamon.recall_ident: Cinnamon's saved identity needs repair. Recovery is paused without replacing her. Ask an admin to restore the matching companion records from backup.
message.wildercord.cinnamon.bow_on: Cinnamon wears her bow. Shears take it off again.
message.wildercord.cinnamon.toy: Cinnamon wiggles with her favourite red bone.
message.wildercord.cinnamon.owner: Cinnamon is waiting for her owner. Set owner in wildercord-cinnamon.json.
message.wildercord.cinnamon.sit: Cinnamon will sit. She keeps this choice when you rejoin or travel.
tooltip.wildercord.silent: This game doesn't know this rune (%s): it's from a different Wildercord version or an add-on that isn't installed. It stays safe and wakes up once you have it.
tooltip.wildercord.cord.wear: Wear it in the Cord slot above your offhand
message.wildercord.already_known: You already know %s. A Runesmith will buy it back, or reroll two of a tier
message.wildercord.learned: Learned %s! Press K to thread it into a spell
message.wildercord.no_cord: Wear a Cord first: the slot above your offhand (E)
message.wildercord.spell_empty: Spell %s is empty. Press K to thread runes
message.wildercord.first_cord: Your Cord hums. You learned Self, Bolt and Push, and spell 1 is ready: R casts, V switches spell, K opens your Cord.
command.wildercord.learnall: Learned all %s runes and revealed %s named fusion recipes
screen.wildercord.too_costly: Costs more than this Cord's %s mana, so it can't be cast.
screen.wildercord.help.title: Threading spells
screen.wildercord.help.1: Click a rune below to add it to the selected spell
screen.wildercord.help.2: Drag a rune onto a socket to insert it there
screen.wildercord.help.3: Drag threaded runes to reorder them, or off the Cord to remove
screen.wildercord.help.4: Click a threaded rune to take it out
screen.wildercord.help.5: Gold marks show what each modifier changes
screen.wildercord.help.6: Scroll over the Codex or the readout to see more
screen.wildercord.help.keys: %s casts (hold to charge) · %s switches spell (hold for the wheel) · %s opens this screen
screen.wildercord.quiet_silent: This game doesn't know this rune (a different Wildercord version or a missing add-on), so it stays quiet
screen.wildercord.quiet_socket: Past the last socket of your %s (%s): kept, but quiet
screen.wildercord.quiet_tier: Too strong for this Cord: needs a %s. Kept, but quiet
screen.wildercord.socket_hint: Click to remove · drag to move
message.wildercord.too_strong: %s is too strong for this Cord: it needs a %s
screen.wildercord.no_cord_hint: Put one in the slot above your offhand (E)
screen.wildercord.codex_hint: Click to add · drag onto a socket
screen.wildercord.empty_spell: Empty spell. Click runes below to thread them.
screen.wildercord.too_costly_health: Costs more health than you have (%s): trim the spell or drop Blood Price
screen.wildercord.modifier_hint: Changes the closest rune on its left that it can affect
message.wildercord.crystals_full: Your mana can't grow further with crystals (%s/%s)
enchantment.wildercord.warding.desc: Spells hurt 8% less per level, up to 80% with Protection's share. Can't share a piece with Protection
enchantment.wildercord.thrift.desc: Spells and passives cost 7% less mana per level
enchantment.wildercord.persistence.desc: Spell effects last 20% longer per level
tooltip.wildercord.not_craftable: Tier IV: can't be crafted, only found
screen.wildercord.not_sustainable: Can't be a passive: only lasting buffs, wards and Orbit auras
screen.wildercord.passive.switch: Click to switch this passive on or off
screen.wildercord.passive.upkeep_hint: Mana per second to keep it running. Passives have no cooldown.
screen.wildercord.passive.locked_hint: Form Heart Circles to open passive slots: the 1st and 5th Circle each open one. Hover the heart above to see your progress.
screen.wildercord.passive.empty: Empty passive. Thread runes that can be sustained.
screen.wildercord.passive.rules: Self or Orbit, then lasting buffs (Swift, Stoneskin, Infinity, Reflect...). Damage like Shock or Dismantle needs an Orbit to carry it. No links and no cooldown: it costs mana every second instead.
screen.wildercord.passive.header: Passive · %s mana/s · renews every %ss · no cooldown
screen.wildercord.passive.header_off: Passive (off) · %s mana/s when on · renews every %ss
screen.wildercord.mana.way.circles: Form Heart Circles by casting and meditating (hover the heart)
screen.wildercord.heart.title: Heart: %s Circle
screen.wildercord.heart.perk.3: %s Circle · Mana Skin: a fifth of damage taken is paid with mana
screen.wildercord.heart.perk.7: %s Circle · Overflow: spells cast at full mana hit 30%% harder
screen.wildercord.heart.perk.8: %s Circle · Archmage: spells cost 15%% less mana
screen.wildercord.heart.complete: Your heart is complete: %s circles. Master Heart.
screen.wildercord.heart.ready: Ready! Meditate (sneak and stand still) for 10 seconds without getting hurt to form it.
screen.wildercord.heart.need.boss: Help slay a boss (Wither, Warden, Elder Guardian, Ender Dragon, a Dungeon Boss, Gravekeeper, or Sword Master)
message.wildercord.circle_broken: Your concentration broke: the circle unravels
screen.wildercord.heart.how: Mana spent casting spells condenses in your heart. Once it's ready, meditate to form the circle.
message.wildercord.circle_ready: Your heart is ready to form the %s Circle. Meditate (sneak and stand still) for 10 seconds without getting hurt to form it.
message.wildercord.circle_formed: %s Circle formed: +%s max mana, +%s mana/s and +%s%% spell power.
message.wildercord.passive_slot: Passive slots open: %s. Thread them on the Cord screen's Passives page.
message.wildercord.perk.2: Overchannel II: hold Cast to charge spells up to 40%% stronger.
message.wildercord.perk.3: Mana Skin: a fifth of the damage you take is now paid with mana.
message.wildercord.perk.4: Overchannel III: maximum channel capacity reached (up to 60%% stronger).
message.wildercord.perk.7: Overflow: spells cast at full mana hit 30%% harder.
message.wildercord.perk.8: Archmage: your spells cost 15%% less mana.
message.wildercord.boss_breakthrough: A boss has fallen. Your heart can now break through to the 7th Circle.
message.wildercord.passive_locked: That passive slot opens with the %s Heart Circle
title.wildercord.circle.1: A ring of mana forms around your heart
screen.wildercord.mana.title: Mana
screen.wildercord.mana.siphon: Siphon %s: +%s mana per creature your spells hit
screen.wildercord.mana.way.crystals: Mana Crystals: +%s max mana each, up to %s (craft or find in deep ruins)
screen.wildercord.mana.way.enchant: Enchant your Cord: Reservoir, Wellspring, Siphon
screen.wildercord.mana.way.potions: Brew Clarity (amethyst shard) or Mana (lapis lazuli)
screen.wildercord.mana.way.meditate: Meditate: sneak and stand still to regenerate twice as fast
screen.wildercord.chips_hint: Pick a family to filter by category
screen.wildercord.help.7: Just type to search the Codex (Ctrl+F). Esc clears the search
message.wildercord.no_health: Blood Price needs more than %s health
message.wildercord.light_blocked: No room for a light there
message.wildercord.silenced: You are silenced and cannot cast
message.wildercord.hushed: A Hush lies over you: your words make no sound
message.wildercord.zipper_no_wall: There's no wall in front of you to unzip
message.wildercord.zipper_thick: Too thick to unzip (6 blocks at most)
message.wildercord.zipper_claimed: That wall or the ground past it is protected
message.wildercord.too_many_birds: You can only keep %s Thunderbirds at once
message.wildercord.rewind_dimension: Rewind can't reach into another dimension
message.wildercord.rewind_unsafe: Rewind won't return you there: that spot isn't safe now
message.wildercord.time_resumes: Time resumes: %s damage from %s hits lands at once
message.wildercord.deaths_door: Death was cheated too recently: nothing turns it back again for %s s
message.wildercord.rebirth_resting: Too soon to be reborn again (%s s)
message.wildercord.time_skip_nowhere: Nowhere safe ahead to skip to
message.wildercord.warded: These walls are warded: the only way in is through the dungeon
message.wildercord.soar_fading: The wind beneath you is fading...
message.wildercord.soar_ended: The wind sets you down gently
message.wildercord.soar_grounded: Grounded! The wind is torn out from under you
message.wildercord.soar_warded: The ward stills the wind here
message.wildercord.soar_travelled: The wind doesn't follow you between worlds
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.wildercor: Thread simple runes onto a Cord in any order, then cast the whole sequence with one key.
rune.wildercord.touch.desc: Targets what you're looking at, within reach.
rune.wildercord.bolt.desc: Fires a flying bolt, up to 48 blocks.
rune.wildercord.beam.desc: An instant line that hits the first thing within 24 blocks.
rune.wildercord.zone.desc: A 3-block field where you look. Re-applies every second for 6 seconds.
rune.wildercord.rain.desc: 5 strikes from the sky over 2 seconds, around where you look.
rune.wildercord.arc.desc: Lobs a bolt that falls and bursts where it lands.
rune.wildercord.cone.desc: Sweeps everything in a 60-degree cone up to 6 blocks in front of you.
rune.wildercord.trail.desc: For 5 seconds your footsteps leave a path that hits whatever steps on it.
rune.wildercord.wall.desc: A 7-block wall across where you look. Hits whatever crosses it every second for 5 seconds, slows what touches it and turns projectiles aside.
rune.wildercord.orbit.desc: Three orbs circle you for 8 seconds and hit whatever they touch.
rune.wildercord.ring.desc: A hollow ring expands from you out to 7 blocks, hitting everything it passes but sparing the ground right around you.
rune.wildercord.pillar.desc: A column erupts where you look: hits everything within 1.5 blocks, 6 high.
rune.wildercord.wave.desc: A 3-wide wave rolls 14 blocks forward along the ground.
rune.wildercord.mine.desc: Hides a rune where you look. It fires when an enemy steps near (lasts 30 seconds).
rune.wildercord.totem.desc: A floating totem where you look pulses every 2 seconds for 10 seconds.
rune.wildercord.domain.desc: Expands a 9-block domain around you for 6 seconds. Every second everything inside is struck, and enemies inside are slowed.
rune.wildercord.crescent.desc: A crescent slash flies 16 blocks forward, cutting everything in its 5-wide path.
rune.wildercord.barrage.desc: A flurry of 8 blows in one second on everything right in front of you, each at 35% power.
rune.wildercord.orb.desc: A slow, heavy orb you steer with your aim drifts up to 30 blocks through creatures, striking everything within 2 blocks of it once a second.
rune.wildercord.blitz.desc: You flash up to 8 blocks forward in an instant, striking everything you pass through.
rune.wildercord.spark.desc: A quick spark darts up to 16 blocks and hits the first thing in its path, at 75% power.
rune.wildercord.ray.desc: An instant, short ray that hits the first thing within 10 blocks.
rune.wildercord.nova.desc: A small nova bursts from you, hitting everything within 2.5 blocks.
rune.wildercord.wisp.desc: A wisp drifts out and chases the nearest enemy within 16 blocks for up to 4 seconds, striking the first thing it touches.
rune.wildercord.comet.desc: A heavy ball of energy flies up to 24 blocks and bursts on the first thing it touches, hitting everything within 3 blocks.
rune.wildercord.ricochet.desc: An orb that bounces off the ground and walls 4 times, passing through creatures and hitting each once.
rune.wildercord.cluster.desc: A ball of energy that breaks into five shards where it hits; each shard strikes everything within 1.5 blocks of where it lands.
rune.wildercord.lance.desc: A thick lance of light drives 16 blocks forward, through every creature in its path.
rune.wildercord.sweep.desc: A 10-block beam sweeps across in front of you in half a second, hitting everything it crosses once.
rune.wildercord.prism.desc: A beam that splits into three at the first thing it hits, each ray striking the next creature behind it.
rune.wildercord.stream.desc: A steady stream of energy follows your aim for a second, striking the first thing within 20 blocks 6 times at 35% power.
rune.wildercord.needle_circle.desc: A closing iris: 35% smaller shape radius, 20% more power. Costs 20% more mana. One circle discipline per shape.
rune.wildercord.bloom_circle.desc: Six unfolding petals: 35% larger shape radius, 20% less power. Costs 15% more mana.
rune.wildercord.gyre_circle.desc: Counter-turning turbines: flying shapes travel 30% faster at 15% less power. Costs 15% more mana.
rune.wildercord.anchor_circle.desc: A locked square lattice: effect durations last 40% longer at 15% less power. Costs 25% more mana; terrain lifetime caps still apply.
rune.wildercord.reservoir_circle.desc: Filling concentric basins: 25% less mana, 20% less power and 15% shorter effect durations.
rune.wildercord.crucible_circle.desc: A breathing furnace hexagon: 15% more power and 25% shorter effect durations. Costs 20% more mana.
rune.wildercord.confluence_circle.desc: Braided elemental satellites: power starts at 90%, gaining 8% per distinct visual element in this group, up to 130%. Costs 20% more mana.
rune.wildercord.pilgrim_circle.desc: A rolling compass: 15% more power when released while moving horizontally, otherwise 10% less; 10% shorter effect durations. Costs 10% more mana.
rune.wildercord.vigil_circle.desc: An opening watchful eye: 20% more power if crouching on release, otherwise 10% less. Flying shapes move 15% slower. Costs 15% more mana.
rune.wildercord.mercy_circle.desc: Paired sheltering crescents: helpful effects gain 20% power; other effects lose 25%. Costs 15% more mana.
rune.wildercord.tempest_circle.desc: Forked storm spokes: 20% more power when wet or exposed to rain on release, otherwise 10% less. Flying shapes move 10% faster. Costs 20% more mana.
rune.wildercord.eclipse_circle.desc: A moon passing its sun: 20% more power at night on release, otherwise 10% less. Costs 15% more mana.
rune.wildercord.feather_fall.desc: Slow falling and no fall damage for 12 seconds, and you drift the way you look while you fall (sneak to stop).
rune.wildercord.swift.desc: Speed III for 10 seconds, and it shakes off Slowness and frozen skin.
rune.wildercord.heal.desc: Restores 8 health (4 hearts; repeats within one cast heal less). What the target can't use becomes a shield of up to 2 hearts for 10 seconds.
rune.wildercord.harm.desc: 7 magic damage, and it leaves the target exposed for 3 seconds (an arcane mark: Unweave and Prismatic Burst count it).
rune.wildercord.push.desc: Hurls targets away from the spell.
rune.wildercord.light.desc: A light source at the point for 60 seconds.
rune.wildercord.grow.desc: Bone-meals the block that was hit and everything around it, and young animals there grow up.
rune.wildercord.shield.desc: For 30 seconds, the next harmful spell cast at the target meets magic circles that spawn in front of it and stop it. A spell that cost more mana than the one that raised the Shield shatters them and goes through. The stronger the Shield, the more circles stack.
rune.wildercord.launch.desc: Flings targets high into the air, where every spell hits them harder. On Self it rockets you up and forward.
rune.wildercord.dash.desc: Shoves targets the way you're facing. On Self it's a precise dash of about ten blocks: level, and it stops where it should.
rune.wildercord.pull.desc: Pulls targets toward the spell, leaving them staggered and marked as pulled for 4 seconds.
rune.wildercord.fire.desc: 5 fire damage and sets alight for 6 seconds.
rune.wildercord.frost.desc: 5 freeze damage and Slowness III for 4 seconds; the frost leaves it brittle for Shatter for 4 seconds.
rune.wildercord.break.desc: Mines the block that was hit (up to iron-pickaxe hardness; Amplify for diamond).
rune.wildercord.lightning.desc: A 12-damage lightning strike on each target that slows and burns. An enemy takes the strongest strike of a cast once, however many land beside it. You and your allies are immune.
rune.wildercord.blink.desc: Teleports you to where the spell landed (max 40 blocks).
rune.wildercord.explode.desc: 12 damage in a 3.5-block blast that throws what it hits. Blasts of one cast never stack on one enemy. Never breaks blocks.
rune.wildercord.sonic_boom.desc: 16 damage that ignores armour, and everything else on the line between you and the target takes 8, through walls.
rune.wildercord.wither.desc: Wither IV for 6 seconds: it spreads to whoever strikes it in melee, and the withered can't heal.
rune.wildercord.dragon_breath.desc: A 3-block cloud that rolls on along the way you blew it: 5 damage per second for 5 seconds.
rune.wildercord.shock.desc: 4 lightning damage that arcs to one more enemy nearby: it finds a wet or metal-armoured one first.
rune.wildercord.haste.desc: Haste II for 30 seconds: mine and swing faster, and a charged cast fills 30% sooner.
rune.wildercord.reveal.desc: Makes targets glow through walls for 15 seconds, strips their invisibility and leaves them exposed for as long (an arcane mark).
rune.wildercord.regrowth.desc: Regeneration that takes hold: I for 3 seconds, II for 3, III for 2 (about 7 health).
rune.wildercord.cleanse.desc: Washes away harmful effects, fire and every elemental mark.
rune.wildercord.stoneskin.desc: Resistance II for 10 seconds, and Slowness I: stone is heavy.
rune.wildercord.root.desc: Vines hold targets in place for 3 seconds.
rune.wildercord.veil.desc: Invisibility for 12 seconds, and nearby monsters lose track of you. The first damage you deal from it lands half again as hard, and ends it.
rune.wildercord.empower.desc: Strength II for 10 seconds, then Weakness I for 4 (a passive carries only Strength I).
rune.wildercord.levitate.desc: Targets hang in the air for 3 seconds, their drift stopped, and every spell hits them harder while they're off the ground. On Self you float.
rune.wildercord.freeze.desc: Freezes targets solid for 2.5 seconds: they can't move or fight back.
rune.wildercord.meteor.desc: A burning meteor falls on each target (two at most) 1.2 seconds later: 12 damage in a 3.5-block blast, and the crater burns on for a moment.
rune.wildercord.tremor.desc: The ground erupts: 8 damage to enemies within 4 blocks, throwing them up.
rune.wildercord.gravity_well.desc: Drags every enemy within 7 blocks into the point for 2 seconds and pulls what hovers over it down; they're left pulled.
rune.wildercord.summon.desc: Three spirit wolves fight at your side for 20 seconds. While they live, your mana regenerates a quarter slower.
rune.wildercord.venom.desc: 2 damage now and 0.75 a second for 4 seconds, with Poison I: it can kill and works on undead and spiders. The poisoned pass it on, once, to up to 3 enemies within 2.5 blocks.
rune.wildercord.smite.desc: A ring closes at the target's feet; 0.7 seconds later a column of light deals 13 holy damage (doubled against undead) and strips Absorption.
rune.wildercord.inferno.desc: Everything within 4 blocks burns: 3 fire damage a second for 4 seconds.
rune.wildercord.thunderclap.desc: A flash, then a crack of thunder: 5 damage within 3 blocks, and everything hit is stunned for half a second and, if it is a monster, forgets who it was hunting.
rune.wildercord.starfall.desc: Eight falling stars around the point over 2 seconds: 6 damage each. The first stars go to exposed enemies.
rune.wildercord.blind.desc: Blindness and darkness for 5 seconds (3 on players). A blinded monster lashes out at whatever stands next to it.
rune.wildercord.chill.desc: Slowness II for 6 seconds and 1 freeze damage. Chill again within 6 seconds and the cold deepens (III, then IV).
rune.wildercord.silence.desc: Casters can't cast: a cast in hand is cut short and none can follow for 4 seconds (3 on players). Monsters are weakened for 6 seconds.
rune.wildercord.nourish.desc: Restores 6 hunger and some saturation, and ends Hunger. Fed pets heal 6 and are ready to breed.
rune.wildercord.tidebreath.desc: Water breathing and faster swimming for 30 seconds, and it douses you: fire goes out, and fire hits are softer while you drip.
rune.wildercord.grapple.desc: Pulls you to where the spell hit, and stops you there.
rune.wildercord.watchweft.desc: Watches a visible dry floor for forty-five seconds. Gives its owner one private warning only after a visible monster targeting them crosses into three blocks in consecutive complete samples. Remain within sixteen blocks; ninety-second rest.
rune.wildercord.manabraid.desc: Offers an allied connected caster a three-second mana gift. They must release and freshly crouch to accept. After the spell price, spends at most twenty-four extra mana to restore at most sixteen, keeping two. Donor rests thirty seconds; receiver ten.
rune.wildercord.root_carry.desc: Two separate casts select and move one unchanged young Cinder Fern onto nearby visible soil. Selection lasts fifteen seconds; successful relocation starts a twenty-second rest. Refuses grown, changed, hidden, protected or unloaded roots.
rune.wildercord.harvest.desc: Harvests grown crops around the block hit, and replants them.
rune.wildercord.basinfill.desc: Fills an enclosed, one-block-deep hole with permanent source water: at most 16 connected cells, within three blocks of the impact. Aim at its floor with Touch or Bolt. Refuses open edges, deep pits, protected ground and the Nether. One basin per paid cast.
rune.wildercord.icepath.desc: Freezes water within 3 blocks into ice you can walk on. On Self it lays a strip of ice ten blocks long the way you look.
rune.wildercord.collect.desc: Pulls up to 48 items and experience within 8 blocks from ground you can edit. Other owners' drops and pickup reservations stay put.
rune.wildercord.excavate.desc: Mines a 3x3 area of blocks (up to iron-pickaxe hardness; Amplify for diamond).
rune.wildercord.cleave.desc: Cuts in proportion to the target: 6 damage plus 10% of its max health (up to 20 more); enemies beside it take half (three at most).
rune.wildercord.dismantle.desc: Three unseen slashes a tenth of a second apart: 3 damage each, straight through armour; the last is twice as deep against something that isn't facing you.
rune.wildercord.blackspark.desc: 8 damage. One hit in four sparks black: 2.5x damage, an arc of 8 to the nearest other enemy, and you're in the zone (Strength and Speed) for 6 seconds.
rune.wildercord.aftershock.desc: 5 damage, then half a second later the same spot is struck again for 5: whoever is still there takes it.
rune.wildercord.resonance.desc: 5 damage and a cursed mark for 10 seconds. Up to 4 other marked enemies within 16 blocks take half of it too, once each per cast.
rune.wildercord.ripple.desc: Sunlight through the body: 6 damage, doubled against undead, and you heal a quarter of what it took. Half a second later it ripples out: 3 to every other enemy within 2.5 blocks, and you heal 1 for each.
rune.wildercord.primer.desc: Turns each target into a bomb that goes off 2 seconds later, or the moment it dies: 10 damage within 3 blocks (an enemy takes only the strongest bomb). Never breaks blocks.
rune.wildercord.blackflame.desc: Black flames that water can't put out: 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. If the target dies burning, they spread.
rune.wildercord.hollow.desc: Erases what it hits: it vanishes for a moment and returns for 20 damage, and everything within 4 blocks is dragged into the gap for 8 more.
rune.wildercord.repel.desc: A violent outward blast: 4 damage and hurls everything within 3 blocks away (light creatures far, heavy ones barely). On enemies just pulled in, it sets off Collapse.
rune.wildercord.decree.desc: A spoken command: everything hit is stunned for 2 seconds and condemned: your next 2 spell hits on it deal 40% more. Speaking it costs you 2 health, unless it holds 3 or more.
rune.wildercord.weigh.desc: Crushingly heavy for 5 seconds: triple gravity, barely able to move or jump, and fliers are dragged down.
rune.wildercord.shackle.desc: Chains each target to the spot for 5 seconds: it's yanked back if it strays more than 2 blocks, and the chain bites for 2.
rune.wildercord.bubble.desc: Traps targets in a floating bubble that pops for 4 damage and leaves them soaked. It holds small creatures 2.5 seconds, bigger ones 2, the largest 1.5.
rune.wildercord.infinity.desc: For 6 seconds the closer a hostile thing comes the slower it moves: enemies within 5 blocks are slowed harder the nearer they are, and projectiles slow to a stop in the air.
rune.wildercord.reversal.desc: For 30 seconds, one killing blow is reversed: back to half health instead of dying. Once death has been cheated, nothing turns it back again for a minute.
rune.wildercord.reflect.desc: For 10 seconds, whatever hurts the target takes 60% of the damage back as arcane damage that ignores armour. Each reflection cracks it (6 at most).
rune.wildercord.overdrive.desc: Past your limits for 10 seconds: Strength II, Speed II and Haste II, but you lose 1 health every 2 seconds. The weaker it leaves you, the harder you hit: Strength III under half health, IV under a quarter.
rune.wildercord.foresight.desc: Sees the next 2 attacks coming (for 15 seconds): each is dodged with a sidestep. A dodge turns away 12 damage at most, and casting it again in the same spell doesn't refill it.
rune.wildercord.restore.desc: Puts things back: heals 4, puts out fire, and mends 8% of every worn and held item's durability (an item once a minute).
rune.wildercord.swap.desc: You and the first creature hit trade places, instantly.
rune.wildercord.zipper.desc: Unzips the wall in front of you and steps you through up to 6 blocks of solid wall (never one that isn't yours to open).
rune.wildercord.shadowstep.desc: You vanish and reappear right behind the first creature hit, facing its back. Your next blow on it within 3 seconds lands half again as hard.
rune.wildercord.stasis.desc: Time stops for everything hit for 5 seconds. Every hit meanwhile is held, then lands all at once when time moves again.
rune.wildercord.rewind.desc: Turns back the clock: return to where you were 5 seconds ago, if it is safe, with the health you had then if it was more.
rune.wildercord.accelerate.desc: Time runs faster for 10 seconds: Speed II, Haste III, Jump Boost II and Regeneration, and your spells charge 40% faster and your bolts and arcs fly 50% faster.
rune.wildercord.time_skip.desc: Time skips ahead: you vanish, reappear up to 8 blocks forward on safe ground, and nearby monsters lose track of you. For a moment after, nothing can hurt you (not again for 5 seconds).
rune.wildercord.rampart.desc: Raises a 5-wide, 3-high wall of earth at the point for 10 seconds.
rune.wildercord.shades.desc: Two shadow hounds rise from your shadow and hunt at your side for 15 seconds. They are frail (20 health) and bite hard only where the light is dim (level 7 or less); each bite leaves its target shadowed.
rune.wildercord.thunderbird.desc: A storm bird circles above you for 12 seconds. Every 2 seconds it marks the enemy you last hit (or the nearest within 12 blocks) and dives on that spot for 4.5 damage: step aside and it misses. Two at most.
rune.wildercord.barrier.desc: A thin barrier of light: 2 absorption hearts for 20 seconds.
rune.wildercord.brace.desc: Braces for the blow: 80% less damage for 2 seconds. Bracing again takes 6 seconds.
rune.wildercord.anchor.desc: Holds you fast for 15 seconds: blows and blasts can't knock you back, no spell can move you, and 4 more armour (8 once you've stood still a second).
rune.wildercord.bramble.desc: Thorns for 10 seconds: the next 4 things that hurt you from within 4 blocks take 3 damage and are shoved away.
rune.wildercord.frostward.desc: For 60 seconds you can't freeze, not even in powder snow, and a frost hold on you lasts a second at most.
rune.wildercord.cushion.desc: For 30 seconds falls can't hurt you, and a hard landing throws out a gust that knocks enemies back and hurts them: three quarters of a point for every block you fell past four (6 at most).
rune.wildercord.deflect.desc: For 8 seconds a whirl of wind sends arrows and other projectiles coming at the target back at whoever shot them.
rune.wildercord.haven.desc: Raises living leaf shutters across a 4-block haven for 8 seconds: enemies inside are shoved out once a second, and enemy projectiles glance off its boundary.
rune.wildercord.chisel.desc: Mines the block that was hit (up to stone-pickaxe hardness; Amplify for iron).
rune.wildercord.glimmer.desc: Grows glowing lichen over the block that was hit and up to 4 around it: a light that stays.
rune.wildercord.prune.desc: A gust clears leaves, grass, flowers, vines and cobwebs within 3 blocks, and they drop as they would to shears.
rune.wildercord.tunnel.desc: Bores a tunnel 2 high and 4 deep into the wall that was hit (up to iron-pickaxe hardness; Amplify for diamond).
rune.wildercord.vein.desc: Mines the block that was hit and, if it's an ore, every matching ore joined to it (up to 16; iron-pickaxe hardness; Amplify for diamond).
rune.wildercord.smelt.desc: Mines the block that was hit and drops it smelted, as a furnace would (iron-pickaxe hardness; Amplify for diamond).
rune.wildercord.fell.desc: Fells the tree that was hit: the log and every log joined to it above, up to 32.
rune.wildercord.span.desc: A bridge of glass grows from your feet toward the point, up to 16 blocks, and shatters 30 seconds later.
rune.wildercord.ember.desc: 3 fire damage and sets alight for 3 seconds. On something already burning it adds 3 seconds instead (10 at most).
rune.wildercord.icicle.desc: 4 freeze damage, or 6 against a target that's already slowed. The icicle melts after 2 seconds and leaves it soaked.
rune.wildercord.pelt.desc: Pelts targets with stones: 4 damage and a hard shove.
rune.wildercord.windcut.desc: A cutting wind: 4 damage and a light shove, and it breaks what the target is winding up: a charge, a bow's draw, a creeper's fuse, a spell.
rune.wildercord.leech.desc: 3 damage, and you heal for what it takes; what a full heart can't hold becomes a shield of up to 4.
rune.wildercord.hex.desc: Hexes targets for 6 seconds: your spells hit them 25% harder, and they fix on you.
rune.wildercord.rend.desc: Rends armour: targets lose 4 armour for 10 seconds, and what they naturally resist they take at full strength.
rune.wildercord.countdown.desc: Marks targets: 1.5 seconds later the moment catches up with them for 6 damage. If the mark dies first, it finds the nearest enemy within 6 blocks.
rune.wildercord.jolt.desc: 4 lightning damage that stuns for 1 second: no moving or fighting back. A caster caught mid-charge loses the spell.
rune.wildercord.bleed.desc: Opens a wound: 2 damage, then 1 more every half second for 4 seconds (half as much again while it moves).
rune.wildercord.coldsnap.desc: A cold snap racing out from the point: 4 freeze damage and Slowness II for 4 seconds to every enemy within 3 blocks, all left brittle for Shatter for 4 seconds.
rune.wildercord.flashfire.desc: A flash of heat: 5 fire damage to every enemy within 3 blocks, setting them alight for 4 seconds. Allies in it are thawed and dried.
rune.wildercord.banish.desc: Banishes targets: they vanish and reappear up to 8 blocks further away from you, dazed.
rune.wildercord.cyclone.desc: A whirlwind spins every enemy within 3 blocks around the point for 2 seconds, then flings them all the way you were facing for 3 damage.
rune.wildercord.blood_thread.desc: Threads everything hit together (4 at most) for 8 seconds: 40% of any damage one of them takes is dealt to each of the rest (three times a second at most).
rune.wildercord.kindling.desc: 3 fire damage and a stack of Kindling. The fifth stack ignites: 14 damage in a 3-block burst, and everything the burst reaches starts at two stacks.
rune.wildercord.twin_star.desc: Your next spell within 6 seconds is cast twice.
rune.wildercord.borrowed_time.desc: Heals the damage you took in the last 5 seconds, as much as you're missing. Over the next 10 seconds it comes back with a fifth on top, but never kills you, unless you slay a monster.
rune.wildercord.gale_mantle.desc: For 12 seconds, jump again in midair to dash the way you're steering (up to 3 dashes), shoving aside whoever you pass.
rune.wildercord.stoneform.desc: For 8 seconds: no knockback, 20% less damage, and every blow you take from an attacker sends out an aftershock (at most once a second).
rune.wildercord.mirrorfrost.desc: Casts back the last spell that hit you in the past 30 seconds, as your own at 70% power. A spell cast back can't be cast back again.
rune.wildercord.fortune.desc: For 10 seconds, every hit you deal has a 1 in 4 chance to strike for double, and a kill has a 1 in 4 chance to drop extra experience.
rune.wildercord.phantom.desc: Leaves an afterimage of you that every monster within 16 blocks turns on for 4 seconds, then it bursts for 8 damage, and 1 more for every 6 it took.
rune.wildercord.stormheart.desc: For 10 seconds, whatever hurts you (a blow of 2 or more) is struck by lightning (at most once a second).
rune.wildercord.extend.desc: +100% duration. At most three per target rune.
rune.wildercord.quicken.desc: Bolts fly twice as fast; delays are halved. On fields, walls, totems, domains, latches, streams and barrages it makes the same strikes come twice as fast, so the spell ends sooner.
rune.wildercord.bounce.desc: Bounces off blocks up to 3 times.
rune.wildercord.homing.desc: Steers toward the nearest enemy within 12 blocks.
rune.wildercord.chain.desc: After a hit, jumps to up to 3 more enemies within 6 blocks.
rune.wildercord.frugal.desc: Half the mana, but 40% weaker and shorter.
rune.wildercord.linger.desc: The effect lands twice more, a second apart.
rune.wildercord.volley.desc: Fires three times in quick succession.
rune.wildercord.focus.desc: Half the radius, +50% power. At most two per target rune.
rune.wildercord.vow.desc: A binding vow: the shape's effects hit twice as hard, but the whole spell's cooldown is 5x longer. One per shape.
rune.wildercord.blood_price.desc: Pay for the whole spell in health instead of mana: 1 health per 4 mana. Never lethal.
rune.wildercord.execute.desc: Double power against targets under half health. One per effect.
rune.wildercord.delay.desc: The rest fires 1 second later, from you.
rune.wildercord.on_hit.desc: The rest fires wherever the shape before it hits.
rune.wildercord.on_land.desc: The rest fires when you next touch the ground.
rune.wildercord.on_kill.desc: The rest fires at each creature the shape before it kills.
rune.wildercord.echo.desc: Everything before it fires again 0.5 seconds later. After On Hit or On Kill, only for the first hit or kill.
rune.wildercord.pulse.desc: The rest fires three times, one second apart, from you. After On Hit or On Kill, only for the first hit or kill.
rune.wildercord.on_hurt.desc: The rest fires at whatever next hurts you (within 15 seconds).
rune.wildercord.if_sneaking.desc: The rest fires only if you're sneaking. Build two spells in one.
rune.wildercord.on_low_health.desc: The rest fires when your health drops below 30% (within 30 seconds).
rune.wildercord.if_airborne.desc: The rest fires only if you're in the air. Build aerial finishers.
rune.wildercord.combo.desc: The rest fires only on every third cast of this spell: a finisher.
rune.wildercord.imbue.desc: The rest isn't cast: it's stored, with 3 charges, in what the shape before it touches. With Self, the item in your hand (a weapon's hits, a bow's arrows, a tool's blocks, armour when you're hurt, a block where it's placed, anything else when used), or with empty hands the block you're looking at. Any block becomes a glyph that goes off at whoever steps on, uses, shoots or breaks it, or when it's powered. The stored part costs 3 times as much; releasing it costs no mana, but everything you've imbued shares one cooldown as long as the stored spell's, and you keep up to 6 imbued items.
rune.wildercord.firestorm.desc: Sets targets alight for 6 seconds and deals 5 damage, and the fire leaps to every enemy within 2 blocks of them (2 damage), then a moment later to those within 2 blocks of those (1.5).
rune.wildercord.steam.desc: A scalding burst of steam: 5 damage and Blindness for 3 seconds, and a cloud hangs where it burst: everything in it is blinded and left wet.
rune.wildercord.magma.desc: The ground under the target turns to magma for 4 seconds: 2 damage a second to every enemy standing on it, and the pool widens as it burns.
rune.wildercord.tempest.desc: A lightning strike for 8 damage, and a gale that hurls targets far away; where they come down a second bolt strikes for 4.
rune.wildercord.plasma.desc: 10 damage, half of it ignoring armour, and the target is ionised for 5 seconds: the next storm damage it takes conducts as if it were wet.
rune.wildercord.hail.desc: Five hailstones of 2 damage each, each staggering the target, and Slowness II for 4 seconds.
rune.wildercord.glacier.desc: Freezes targets in place for 2 seconds (1 second on players). The ice spreads: up to 3 other enemies within 2.5 blocks freeze for 1 second, and when it cracks everything frozen takes 2.
rune.wildercord.lifesteal.desc: 5 damage, and you heal for what it dealt. For 6 seconds everything the target suffers, from anyone, heals you for a quarter of it.
rune.wildercord.warp.desc: You and the first creature hit swap places through the void, and you come out unseen for a second. An enemy is left pulled and reeling: Slowness II and Nausea for 2 seconds.
rune.wildercord.bloom.desc: Regeneration II for 6 seconds, plants grow around the first 3 allies it touches, and allies near them catch Regeneration I for 5.
rune.wildercord.surge.desc: Speed I and Strength I for 8 seconds; the blows you land in that time arc on to a nearby enemy for 2 (four arcs at most).
rune.wildercord.nullify.desc: Strips an enemy's good effects, or an ally's bad effects. Vexes, and spirit wolves and shades that aren't yours, dissolve.
rune.wildercord.phoenix_pyre.desc: Wreathes allies in healing flame for 6 seconds: Regeneration I and Fire Resistance, and every second enemies within 2 blocks of them are set alight and take 1 damage. The first time an ally falls under 35% health the pyre flares: 6 health, and 4 damage to enemies within 3 blocks.
rune.wildercord.hellmouth.desc: Opens a pit of black fire for 3 seconds that drags enemies within 3 blocks toward it and burns those at its core for 2 damage a second, then caves in for 4 damage.
rune.wildercord.starfire.desc: Five motes of starfire seek up to five enemies within 6 blocks: 2 damage each, and they burn for 3 seconds.
rune.wildercord.everburn.desc: Sets targets alight for 5 seconds with a fire that burns two and a half times as fast (1.5 more damage a second), and rekindles once for 3 more when it goes out.
rune.wildercord.bloodboil.desc: 3 damage, and for 5 seconds the target's blood boils: each time it's hurt it takes 2 more fire damage (up to 5 times).
rune.wildercord.conflagration.desc: Sets targets alight for 6 seconds, and every burning enemy within 6 blocks flares up for 4 damage (1 more for each other one flaring, up to 3) and burns 2 seconds longer.
rune.wildercord.blizzard.desc: A blizzard howls 3 blocks around where it lands for 4 seconds, walking 6 blocks the way you faced: enemies in it are slowed (Slowness II), chilled and take 1.5 damage a second.
rune.wildercord.frostbloom.desc: Regeneration II for 5 seconds, and for 8 seconds anything that strikes the ally is frozen stiff (Slowness III for 2 seconds) and heals them a point (4 at most).
rune.wildercord.black_ice.desc: Freezes targets for 1.5 seconds (1 on players) and leaves them weak (Weakness II for 5 seconds). One that dies in the next 5 seconds shatters: 4 damage to enemies within 3 blocks, which turn brittle in their turn.
rune.wildercord.rime_seal.desc: Writes a frost seal 3 blocks across on the ground for 6 seconds. An enemy that stands in it for a second freezes solid for 1.5 seconds (1 on players) and takes 3 damage, once each.
rune.wildercord.cryostasis.desc: Seals an ally in ice for 2 seconds (4 at most, however it's extended): they can't move, cast or be hurt, and heal 6 health while they wait. When it opens it bursts: enemies within 3 blocks are thrown back, take 3, and are slowed and left brittle. Not again on the same creature for 10 seconds.
rune.wildercord.frostbite.desc: 3 damage, then 1 damage a second for 5 seconds as the cold sets in (Slowness I, then II, then III); at the end the target freezes for a second and a half.
rune.wildercord.absolute_zero.desc: Slowness IV for 3 seconds. A target showing signs of cold (slowed, brittle, frozen skin, held) freezes solid and takes damage for each: 4.5 for one, 7 for two, 9.5 for three, 12 for four, and is held 1.5 to 3 seconds (half as long on players), then not again until 3 seconds after it thaws.
rune.wildercord.magnetize.desc: Magnetizes a target for 4 seconds: enemies within 5 blocks are drawn to it, and any that touch it are shocked for 3 damage (once a second).
rune.wildercord.riftbolt.desc: A black bolt for 7 damage that tears the target through a rift up to 5 blocks away, left in Darkness for 3 seconds.
rune.wildercord.stormweave.desc: Marks up to 4 enemies within 6 blocks; a moment later lightning weaves between them all: 4 damage each, and 1 more for every other one caught in the web; a target alone takes 2 more.
rune.wildercord.stormclock.desc: 4 damage, and lightning strikes the same spot again 2 and 4 seconds later: 3 damage to enemies within 1.5 blocks each time.
rune.wildercord.heartstopper.desc: 5 damage, and for 6 seconds the target's heart skips every 2 seconds: a stumble, a lurch, then a full stop (a quarter, half, then one and a half seconds of stun).
rune.wildercord.thunderhead.desc: A thundercloud gathers over the target for 4 seconds and strikes an enemy within 4 blocks of it every second: 2 damage, and the rain soaks it so the bolt conducts.
rune.wildercord.downdraft.desc: Slams every airborne enemy within 6 blocks to the ground: 4 damage, and 1 more for every block it fell (up to 6). Flyers lose their lift. With nothing in the air it pins whoever stands under it (Slowness III for a second, 2 damage).
rune.wildercord.updraft.desc: Hurls enemies within 2.5 blocks high into the air, where every spell hits them harder; a moment later a downdraft smashes them back down for 4 damage.
rune.wildercord.skyglyph.desc: Writes a wind glyph where it lands for 10 seconds: an ally who steps on it is launched high and forward, an enemy thrown back 4 blocks.
rune.wildercord.recoil.desc: Hurls targets 5 blocks back; 2 seconds later the wind snaps them back to where they stood, for 5 damage.
rune.wildercord.zephyr.desc: A warm breeze that clears the air: allies within 4 blocks get Speed I, Jump Boost I and Regeneration I for 10 seconds, and it blows away blindness, darkness, nausea and slowness.
rune.wildercord.crimson_mist.desc: A red mist 3 blocks around where it lands for 5 seconds: enemies in it bleed for 2 damage a second, allies in it heal 1.5 health a second and are hidden from monsters more than 4 blocks away.
rune.wildercord.sinkhole.desc: The ground gives way: enemies within 3 blocks are dragged to its middle and pinned for 2 seconds (Slowness IV, no jumping), then crushed for 6 damage.
rune.wildercord.geode.desc: Crystal armour: Resistance II for 5 seconds, and anything that strikes the ally is cut by crystal shards for 2 damage and left cracked (every spell hits it 20% harder for 5 seconds).
rune.wildercord.fossilize.desc: The target turns slowly to stone: Slowness I, II, then III over 3 seconds, then it's stone, held for 2 seconds (1 on players), brittle while it stands (every spell hits it 20% harder), and cracked for 6 damage.
rune.wildercord.bonespur.desc: Spurs of bone burst from the ground under up to 4 enemies within 4 blocks: 5 damage each, and they bleed for 3 seconds.
rune.wildercord.monolith.desc: A pillar of stone bursts up under the target: 8 damage, and it's thrown 3 blocks into the air; where it lands, 3 more to whatever is there. The pillar crumbles after 4 seconds.
rune.wildercord.soulbond.desc: Binds you and an ally for 10 seconds: any damage either of you takes is split between you. The bond breaks beyond 16 blocks.
rune.wildercord.second_wind.desc: For 20 seconds, the first blow that would kill the ally leaves them at 4 health instead, with Regeneration II and Speed II for 4 seconds and a gust that shoves enemies away. Once death has been cheated (by this or any other spell), it isn't again on them for a minute.
rune.wildercord.transfusion.desc: You give up to 4 of your own health (never below 2), and the ally heals three times what you gave and is cured of one harmful effect.
rune.wildercord.lifebloom.desc: Heals 4, then 1 a second for 5 seconds; when it fades it bursts, healing every ally within 3 blocks for 3.
rune.wildercord.sanguine_rite.desc: You pay 3 of your own health (never your last; more with Amplify, Overcharge and a crowd) for 12 damage that ignores armour.
rune.wildercord.entropy.desc: The target unravels: 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5 and 3 damage over 5 seconds, straight through armour, and each wound strips a point of its armour until it ends.
rune.wildercord.devour.desc: 5 damage, and 1 more for every tenth of its health the target is missing (up to 10). If it kills, you feed: 10 mana and 4 absorption (twice a cast at most).
rune.wildercord.timesteal.desc: Steals up to 2 of the target's good effects, with the time they had left (at most 30 seconds), and gives them to you. With nothing to steal it steals a moment: the target drags, and you are quickened, for 2 seconds.
rune.wildercord.hemomancy.desc: 4 magic damage, and 1 more for every 1.5 health you're missing (up to 8 more). Under half health you heal a quarter of what it deals.
rune.wildercord.reckoning.desc: For 4 seconds, every wound the target takes is counted; then half of it comes due again at once (at most 12), and half of what comes due heals you (at most 6).
rune.wildercord.singularity.desc: A black hole opens where it lands for 2.5 seconds, drawing in enemies within 5 blocks and swallowing arrows and bolts, then bursts: 6 damage (1 more for each thing swallowed, up to 5), and they're flung outward.
rune.wildercord.prismatic_burst.desc: 5 damage, and 4 more for every mark on the target (burning, frozen, windswept, pulled, soaked, wet, cracked, shadowed, bleeding or exposed), up to 5, each used up and passed on to up to 3 enemies within 4 blocks: up to 25.
rune.wildercord.chronoshift.desc: Turns an ally's clock forward: their other spells come off cooldown 3 seconds sooner, a third of the mana they spent in the last 5 seconds comes back (30 at most), and they get Haste I and Speed I for 5 seconds.
rune.wildercord.strata_rise.desc: Raises a real five-wide, three-high stone wall over seven ticks. Lasts eight seconds, drops no material, respects protected land and cannot trap creatures.
rune.wildercord.tidal_lift.desc: Borrows up to three real water sources within four blocks, lifts them along a ten-block arc, then returns them. Each enemy takes 4 damage once and is soaked for five seconds. Needs nearby source water.
rune.wildercord.wind_steps.desc: Forms five real wind platforms ahead, ascending one block every two steps. Lasts eight seconds; allies standing on expiring steps get three seconds of slow falling.
rune.wildercord.cinder_bulwark.desc: Raises a cracked, glowing wall. Enemies brushing against it take 2 magic damage once per cast. Lasts eight seconds and drops nothing.
rune.wildercord.root_bulwark.desc: Raises a living root wall that gives nearby allies brief Regeneration I. Lasts eight seconds, respects land protections and drops no wood.
rune.wildercord.boiling_surge.desc: Lifts nearby real water through a scalding arc, returning each source afterwards. Each enemy takes 5 damage once and two seconds of Weakness. Original steam curls trace the crest.
rune.wildercord.thunder_tide.desc: Suspends real borrowed water inside electrical rings and drives it forward. Each enemy takes 5 damage once, is soaked and slowed for one second. Water returns safely.
rune.wildercord.rime_causeway.desc: Condenses wind into an ascending three-wide ice causeway. Lasts eight seconds, leaves no farmable ice and cushions allies when it fades.
rune.wildercord.thunder_walk.desc: Builds five copper-lit wind stepping stones. Each enemy touching a stone takes 2 magic damage once per cast; allies receive slow falling before expiry.
rune.wildercord.springbed.desc: Pours one safe Basinfill vessel, then grows up to eight existing bank crops or moist Moonreed buds by one stage. The new water must hydrate their soil. Never creates plants or opens mature Moonreed without pollinators. Once per paid cast.
rune.wildercord.cinder_sieve.desc: Consumes one carried coal or charcoal to furnace-process up to sixteen visible loose inputs within four blocks. Only commits when complete outputs fit your inventory. Preserves owned, delayed and protected drops; grants no XP. Once per paid cast.
rune.wildercord.ashen_mercy.desc: Extinguishes an ally and removes harmful conditions, converting only actual conditions removed into at most four restored health. Gives five seconds of heat protection. At most eight allies, once per target and paid cast; clean targets receive no healing.
rune.wildercord.clockroot.desc: Roots remember safe ground for four seconds. A foe fleeing more than two blocks is returned once if its original floor and route are still safe, loaded and permitted. Refuses bosses, anchored or mounted targets and warded arenas. At most eight foes per paid cast; eight-second target rest.
rune.wildercord.skylatch.desc: Lifts an ally about one block and holds vertical height for four seconds while lateral movement remains free. Crouch to release into two seconds of gentle descent. Refuses ceilings, flight abilities, anchors and warded arenas. At most eight allies per paid cast; eight-second target rest.
rune.wildercord.thresherwind.desc: Three travelling shear lanes harvest up to nine mature crops ahead of the impact. Replants only by consuming a real seed from each crop's drops. Collects this harvest, preserves full-inventory leftovers, respects loaded land and claims. Once per paid cast.
rune.wildercord.nullcatch.desc: An open mirror pocket catches one hostile front projectile over three seconds. One payment buys one capture; rear, allied, reflected and ownerless attacks pass. No stored attack or refund.
rune.wildercord.second_bell.desc: Two visible electrodes ring after one and two seconds. Leaving the marked spot evades the second discharge. Two targets at most, eight total damage per payment after bonuses; no movement hold.
rune.wildercord.red_ledger.desc: Three visible blood gates measure ordinary movement over three seconds. Moving one block spends a gate for a small cut. Standing still avoids all cuts; teleports do not count. Six total damage per payment after bonuses.
rune.wildercord.quietus.desc: A visible short escrow waits for one newly cast hostile magic projectile, closes on it and taxes up to eight of its player's current mana. No hit, free ammunition or mana reward; old and reflected spells pass.
rune.wildercord.blood_escrow.desc: Spend up to three actual health, never below four, to buy one ally a six-second absorption chamber. Crouching or an existing ward refuses. One gift per payment; no refund or renewal.
rune.wildercord.frost_molt.desc: Peel an actual frozen condition into one three-second ice plate. It stops one ordinary projectile of six damage or less; larger, bypass and other attacks pass. Clean allies cannot mint a plate; crouching sheds it.
rune.wildercord.pulse_ferry.desc: One sap parcel visits two different wounded eligible allies within four blocks on separate beats. Each receives at most three actual healing, six total. Crouching refuses a visit. No overheal or repeated recovery.
rune.wildercord.last_lantern.desc: Record one allied player's safe ground for six seconds. Their next fresh crouch requests one safe return within eight blocks. Invalid floor, route, dimension or permission refuses. No health rewind or forced return.
rune.wildercord.pocket_current.desc: Water envelopes carry up to sixteen ready, permitted loose items into your own tracked chest. Both halves need ownership and permission; full slots, foreign drops, locks and loot tables refuse without item loss.
rune.wildercord.wayline.desc: Latch a short line to owned safe ground within six blocks. Hold forward for a bounded two-second tow; crouch to release. Normal collision remains, no one else is moved, and no flight ability is granted.
rune.wildercord.night_seam.desc: Inspect beyond at most three owned ordinary stone cells for one open-ground and nearby-threat clue. No blocks change, no one moves, and protected, special, block-entity, warded or unloaded walls refuse.
rune.wildercord.shard_compass.desc: Offer one carried raw iron, copper or gold sample to locate a nearby matching loaded permitted deposit with an accessible side. A successful find spends the sample and points a short graded pebble route; refusal preserves it. Never mines or creates rewards.
rune.wildercord.frostwire.desc: Chills each target (Slowness II for 4 seconds); a moment later a current races through every chilled or frozen enemy within 6 blocks of it, 6 at most: 5 damage each, 7 to one frozen solid.
rune.wildercord.seethe.desc: Traps each target in a bubble of boiling water for 2 seconds (1 fire damage every half second), then it bursts into scalding steam: 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 blocks, blinded for 2 seconds and left soaked.
rune.wildercord.bloomstep.desc: Steps you through a door of blossoms to where the spell landed (up to 32 blocks). Grass and flowers spring up where you left and where you arrive, and you and your allies within 3 blocks of where you arrive get Regeneration I for 5 seconds.
rune.wildercord.skyburst.desc: Flings each target high into the air (3 at most); at the top of its flight it explodes and rains fire down: 7 damage to it and every enemy within 3 blocks of it or beneath it, setting them alight, and the wind that carried it fans the flames (Wildfire). Never breaks blocks.
rune.wildercord.stitchtime.desc: Heals the ally 4 and stitches the next 4 seconds: every wound they take meanwhile is counted, and when the time is up it all heals back at once (12 at most).
rune.wildercord.parasite.desc: Plants a parasite in each target for 6 seconds: Poison I, and every second it drains 1 health from it into you. If its host dies with it inside, it leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 blocks for the time it had left (once).
rune.wildercord.razorgale.desc: A whirl of blades round where it lands: every enemy within 3 blocks is cut for 2 and left bleeding; half a second later the gale comes back round for 2 more, tearing every wound open (Rupture).
rune.wildercord.doomclock.desc: Sets a clock ticking on each target (3 at most) for 3 seconds: every blow it takes meanwhile (up to four a second) winds it 2 tighter, 12 at most. At zero it bursts: 8 damage and all it was wound, to it and every enemy within 3 blocks (an enemy takes one burst a cast). Never breaks blocks.
rune.wildercord.thunderstep.desc: You come down as a bolt of lightning where the spell landed (up to 24 blocks), right behind the first enemy it hit: 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 blocks of you, stunned for half a second. On Self it strikes where you stand.
rune.wildercord.halo.desc: A halo crowns the ally for 8 seconds: every 1.5 seconds it smites an enemy within 6 blocks of them (whoever hurt them, or else the nearest) for 3 holy damage (tripled against undead), and the ally heals 1 each time.
rune.wildercord.thunderquake.desc: The ground booms like thunder: three shockwaves roll out from where it lands over a second, reaching 2, 4 and 6 blocks. Each strikes every enemy it reaches for 4 and tosses it up, so the nearer, the harder: 12 at the heart.
rune.wildercord.cometfall.desc: A comet streaks down on the point a second later: 16 damage to every enemy within 4 blocks, setting them alight, and five shards of it scatter into the nearest other enemies within 10 blocks for 4 each. Never breaks blocks.
rune.wildercord.riposte.desc: For 10 seconds the ally sees the next 2 blows coming: each is sidestepped, and answered at once with the blow's own damage (4 to 12) to whoever struck.
rune.wildercord.dust_devil.desc: A dust devil touches down where it lands and chases the nearest enemy for 5 seconds. Enemies within 2 blocks of it are caught up and whirled round it, blinded and scoured for 3 damage a second; when it blows out it flings them high.
rune.wildercord.malison.desc: 4 damage and a curse for 8 seconds: your spells hit it 25% harder, and it's shadowed. If it dies cursed, the curse passes on, 5% stronger each time (up to 45%), for the time it had left, to up to 3 enemies within 6 blocks of it.
rune.wildercord.avalanche.desc: Snow and ice crash down round where it lands: 6 damage to every enemy within 3 blocks (half again on a bare head), buried in snow (Slowness III for 3 seconds). Drifts of snow lie where it fell for 10 seconds.
rune.wildercord.echolocate.desc: A sonar pulse from the point: every enemy within 16 blocks glows through walls for 10 seconds, and those it hits are dazed (Slowness II) for 3.
rune.wildercord.resonant_shriek.desc: A sculk shriek: 8 damage that ignores armour, a stagger, and Darkness for 6 seconds. A second later it echoes for half as much.
rune.wildercord.tidecall.desc: The tide crashes in at the point: 6 damage to every enemy within 3.5 blocks, dragging them into the middle (as a Pull does) and leaving them soaked. A crowd it bunches takes 1 more for each neighbour (4 at most).
rune.wildercord.infest.desc: Silverfish burrow out of the stone around each target: 1 damage every half second for 4 seconds, and Slowness I.
rune.wildercord.sandstorm.desc: A sandstorm whirls at the point for 4 seconds: every enemy within 3.5 blocks takes 2 damage a second, can't see and is slowed.
rune.wildercord.vinelash.desc: A thorned vine lashes each target: 5 damage, and it's yanked 4 blocks toward you and tripped (Slowness II for 2 seconds).
rune.wildercord.remedy.desc: Cures what ails and turns it to good (poison to Regeneration, slowness to Speed, weakness to Strength...) for half its time; heals 4 and gives Regeneration I for 6 seconds. A zombie villager it touches is weakened, ready for a golden apple.
rune.wildercord.warcry.desc: A war horn sounds: you and your allies within 8 blocks of the target gain Strength I and Speed I for 12 seconds, and each kill one of you makes meanwhile heals that one for 1.
rune.wildercord.fangs.desc: A ring of evoker fangs snaps up around each target: 6 damage from below.
rune.wildercord.undertow.desc: Drags each target down: Slowness III for 3 seconds and soaked. Out of the water it hauls the target toward the nearest water within 6 blocks (with none near, the ground turns to slurry for 3 damage); in water it's pulled under and takes 5.
rune.wildercord.treasure_sense.desc: For 60 seconds, Luck II, and the nearest unopened treasure chests and suspicious blocks within 24 blocks sparkle now and then.
rune.wildercord.tusk_charge.desc: You charge like a hoglin, up to 8 blocks the way you look, tossing everything in your path into the air: 3 damage, and 0.8 more for every block you ran up (9 at most).
rune.wildercord.blazecall.desc: Three blaze fireballs fall on each target over a second: 3 fire damage each, setting it alight and staggering it.
rune.wildercord.shulkershell.desc: Shuts the target in a shulker's shell for 4 seconds: 80% less damage and no knockback, but it can't move. When it opens, what it turned aside leaves as up to 3 bullets that seek the nearest enemies (6 damage each at most, and they float), and enemies within 3 blocks float up for 2 seconds.
rune.wildercord.portalfall.desc: A portal opens under each target and drops it from up to 7 blocks up, with 2 damage on the way through; where it lands, enemies within 2 blocks take 3 and stagger.
rune.wildercord.ancient_seed.desc: Plants an ancient seed at the point: a torchflower or pitcher plant blooms, and crops within 4 blocks grow a stage now and every 3 seconds for 12 seconds more.
rune.wildercord.vortex.desc: A whirling vortex opens where you look for 3 seconds, dragging creatures within 5 blocks into its eye and striking everything in the eye twice a second.
rune.wildercord.snare.desc: Strings an unseen tripwire from your feet to where you look (up to 12 blocks). The first enemy to cross it within 30 seconds springs it on everything within 2.5 blocks, and whoever it catches stumbles for a second.
rune.wildercord.trial_key.desc: Opens a fight: +60% power against targets at full health. One per effect.
rune.wildercord.if_wounded.desc: The rest fires only if you're below half health. Build a last stand into any spell.
rune.wildercord.if_outnumbered.desc: The rest fires only if 3 or more enemies are within 8 blocks of you.
rune.wildercord.moonpetal.desc: A storm of moonlit petals at the point: 5 damage to every enemy within 3 blocks, and 4 health to you and your allies there. Stronger under a full moon and at night, weaker under a new moon.
rune.wildercord.hoarfrost.desc: Rime creeps over each target for 3 seconds, slowing it more every second; then it freezes solid for 2 seconds and takes 6 damage, and the frost blooms: enemies within 2 blocks take 3 and are slowed. Cast again on a creeping target, it starts nothing new.
rune.wildercord.hush.desc: A pocket of silence at the point for 6 seconds (4 blocks): monsters inside lose their targets and are weakened, and enemy casters can't cast.
rune.wildercord.sporebloom.desc: Spores burst from a giant mushroom at the point: enemies within 3 blocks take Poison I and spore damage, and monsters among them turn on each other for 5 seconds (players get Nausea). Your allies there get 4 hunger back.
rune.wildercord.sunscorch.desc: The noon sun, focused: 8 fire damage and alight for 5 seconds, and the target glows for 6. Under open sky by day it burns 50% hotter and blinds; bright light of its own counts as dusk (25% hotter).
rune.wildercord.mire.desc: The ground turns to mire under each target for 5 seconds: it sinks (Slowness IV, no jumping) and is soaked.
rune.wildercord.glowvine.desc: Glowing cave vines heavy with glow berries grow down from the ceiling around the point: a light that stays. Vines already there bear berries again.
rune.wildercord.rootsnare.desc: Mangrove roots burst up around the point: every enemy within 3 blocks is held for 1.5 seconds and takes 3 damage, then slowed for 4 seconds and cut by 1 damage for every 1.5 blocks it moves (5 at most).
rune.wildercord.stalactite.desc: A stalactite drops on the spot each target stands on: 7 damage, 30% more against a bare head. Step aside and it misses.
rune.wildercord.summit_wind.desc: A howling mountain wind: 5 damage and hurls every enemy within 3 blocks up and away, holding them aloft so they glide down out of the fight (a fifth stronger above y=120). On Self it carries you 12 blocks up and lets you glide down.
rune.wildercord.soulfire.desc: Blue soul flames: 3 fire damage a second for 5 seconds that water can't dull and the fire-proof can't shrug off, and the damage they deal gives you back a little mana (up to 5 a cast).
rune.wildercord.warp_step.desc: Steps you to where the spell landed (up to 24 blocks). 3 seconds later you're pulled back, unless you're sneaking.
rune.wildercord.blood_moss.desc: Crimson moss spreads over each target: 1 damage a second for 6 seconds, and the most wounded of you and your allies nearby heals for all of it.
rune.wildercord.basalt_surge.desc: Basalt columns burst up in a line from you to the point: 7 damage and a toss into the air for everything along it.
rune.wildercord.starlight_tether.desc: Tethers each target to the point with a thread of starlight for 5 seconds: it's dragged back if it strays 3 blocks, taking 1 damage each time (once a second at most).
rune.wildercord.cinderbrand.desc: Brands each target: 3 fire damage, and for 6 seconds your fire spells burn it 50% hotter and its burning hurts a little more.
rune.wildercord.ashen_veil.desc: Wreathes the target in ash for 10 seconds: fire can't hurt it, and whatever strikes it up close is set alight for 4 seconds and blinded by the ash for a second.
rune.wildercord.kindled.desc: +30% power, and the effect sets what it hits alight for 4 seconds.
rune.wildercord.cinderheart.desc: Your heart burns for 12 seconds: Strength II, fire can't hurt you, and every enemy within 4 blocks takes 3 fire damage a second. It can't be lit again until 24 seconds after it goes out.
rune.wildercord.constellation.desc: Joins up to 5 enemies within 12 blocks of you in a constellation of light and strikes them all at once.
rune.wildercord.eclipse.desc: A dark disc eclipses the point for 5 seconds: enemies beneath it (4 blocks) are blinded, take 2 damage a second, and your spells hit them 20% harder. Under it the light counts as dim.
rune.wildercord.starmaw.desc: Devours the light: 14 damage, and it swallows each of the target's good effects and wards (Foresight, Riposte, Reflect, Reversal, Infinity, Anchor) for 4 more damage apiece, and its absorption for 1 per heart.
rune.wildercord.drowning_word.desc: A drowning word: for 5 seconds the target's lungs fill with water (it loses its air, takes 2 damage a second and can't cast), and it's soaked.
rune.wildercord.if_wet.desc: The rest fires only if you're in water or rain.
rune.wildercord.tidewrit.desc: Writes the tide: a 7-wide wall of water rolls from you through the point, 10 damage to everything in it, sweeping it about 11 blocks on, soaked.
rune.wildercord.starshard.desc: A shard of the fallen star: 11 damage, then it splinters into 3 sparks that strike the nearest other enemies within 8 blocks for 4.
rune.wildercord.riftcall.desc: Opens a rift at the point for 3 seconds: it drags enemies within 5 blocks toward it for 2 damage a second, then snaps shut on them for 6. It gapes wider for every creature it holds (up to 5): half a block of reach and 1 more damage each.
rune.wildercord.unstable.desc: Rift-touched: the effect's power swings anywhere from 50% to 200% each time it lands.
rune.wildercord.manaburn.desc: Burns magic: 5 damage. A spellcaster (a player wearing a Cord, or a Runebound) also takes 4 more, a player loses up to 20 mana (less from a weaker hit), and a charge or telegraphed cast in hand is cut short.
rune.wildercord.manatide.desc: Drinks in the storm: for 10 seconds, every spell you and your allies hit cast gives back a quarter of its mana (30 at most, however extended). Each player can drink only once a minute.
rune.wildercord.tidehook.desc: A hook of water snags each target and reels it in to your feet in three tugs (a flyer is reeled down): 4 damage, it's left soaked and gasping for half a second when it lands.
rune.wildercord.current.desc: Only in water or rain: a current sweeps you and the allies within 2 blocks about 15 blocks the way you look, and you land without fall damage. On dry land it fizzles.
rune.wildercord.glaive.desc: A spinning glaive flies out up to 12 blocks and curves back to you, striking everything it passes on the way out and again on the way back.
rune.wildercord.imprint.desc: Leaves an imprint of the spell where you stand. 2 seconds later it erupts, striking everything within 3 blocks of it.
rune.wildercord.latch.desc: A thread of light latches onto the first creature within 16 blocks of your aim and strikes it 4 times, a second apart, at 70% power, while it stays within 24 blocks and in sight.
rune.wildercord.kindred.desc: Shares a helpful effect: it also lands on you and on the nearest ally it missed within 8 blocks, at half power.
rune.wildercord.thirst.desc: You heal for a quarter of the damage the effect deals.
rune.wildercord.belated.desc: The effect lands 1.5 seconds late, but 25% stronger.
rune.wildercord.on_reaction.desc: The rest fires at each creature the shape before it sets off an element reaction on (Shatter, Conduct, Blight...).
rune.wildercord.on_weakness.desc: The rest fires at each creature the shape before it strikes with an element it's weak to.
rune.wildercord.spellbrand.desc: Brands each target with a sigil for 8 seconds. The next time your magic hurts it, the sigil bursts for 7 damage of the element of the spell that set it off.
rune.wildercord.gash.desc: A wound that won't close: 3 damage, and for 8 seconds the target can't heal, is left bleeding, and weeps 0.4 damage plus 1% of its health a second.
rune.wildercord.prospect.desc: The ground rings out: every ore within 12 blocks of where it lands glows through the rock for 20 seconds.
rune.wildercord.searing_edge.desc: For 15 seconds the target's weapon sears: each melee hit it lands sets the foe alight for 4 seconds and deals 2 more fire damage.
rune.wildercord.flash_freeze.desc: 4 freeze damage. A soaked target (in water, or after a water rune or Bubble) freezes solid for 3 seconds (1.5 on players), one only rained on for 2 (1); a dry one is slowed and left brittle.
rune.wildercord.drowse.desc: Sleepy pollen lulls each target to sleep for 6 seconds (2 on players): it can't move or fight back, but any damage wakes it, and the blow that does deals 75% more. Bosses only grow drowsy.
rune.wildercord.galvanize.desc: Sets a spark of raw power against the block it strikes for 5 seconds: it powers what it touches as a redstone block would (doors open, lamps light, pistons push).
rune.wildercord.prolong.desc: Every good effect on the target (Speed, Strength, Regeneration, a potion's...) lasts 15 seconds longer, up to 5 minutes.
rune.wildercord.umbra.desc: The dark bites: 4 damage, doubled where the light is dim (level 7 or less, or under an Eclipse), and it leaves the target shadowed.
rune.wildercord.disarm.desc: A snatching gust tears the weapon from each creature's hand for 5 seconds, then it drifts back. Bosses keep hold; a player keeps hold too, but can't use what they're holding for 3 seconds.
rune.wildercord.soar.desc: Wings of wind let you fly for 20 seconds: double-tap jump to take off, then jump and sneak to rise and sink. It can't be renewed mid-flight, and when the wind fades it sets you down gently, then your wings need 30 seconds' rest. A pull or a grounding wind tears it away, and it won't lift anyone in a warded arena.
rune.wildercord.relay.desc: An Archive lesson for active Circle VIII and an Echo Cord: place a visible focus within 8 blocks, then press cast again within 4 seconds to release one aimed ray. Relay then Harm, Frost or Shock only; 90% normal strength, 16 blocks total path, 8-second shared rest. No modifiers, links, Knots, woven runes or storage.
rune.wildercord.excise.desc: Rootbound study teaches active Circle XVI to cut one visible hostile native Zone core within 12 blocks. Hold Cast for 16 ticks; 36 base mana once, 12-second shared rest and 12-tick recovery. Only Beam then Excise. Damage, broken sight or more than one block of movement cancels without refund. Existing poison, fire and sibling fields survive.
rune.wildercord.reweave.desc: The Ebb Ledger teaches active Circle XII to rewrite one paid Harm field once. Place a radius-2 disc within 8 blocks; its four half-Harm beats remain at 0.4, 1.4, 2.4 and 3.4 seconds, expiring at 4 seconds. A fresh cast press fixes a 7 by 1.25 block lane after a silent 0.4-second warning. Forty base mana once, eight-second shared rest. Reweave then Harm only; no modifiers, links, composites or storage.
rune.wildercord.tollgate.desc: The Warden's Threshold teaches active Circle X: set a 5-block gate on visible floor within 10 blocks for 6 seconds. A hostile walking into it is stopped once and slowed; 3 tolls in all. Allies pass and a jump clears it. 30 mana once, 10-second shared rest. Wall then Tollgate only.
rune.wildercord.lifeline.desc: The Thread Between Stars teaches active Circle XIV: thread one ally, pet or summon you can see within 16 blocks, then press again within 8 seconds to pull them to a safe spot beside you. A crouching ally refuses. 28 mana once, 10-second shared rest. Beam then Lifeline only.
rune.wildercord.conduit.desc: Notes on a Grounded Storm teach active Circle XVIII: plant a rod on visible floor within 20 blocks for 20 seconds, then press again to spark for 0.4 seconds and arrive on it. Damage, a blocked line or a hostile beside the rod stops you. 32 mana once, 15-second shared rest. Pillar then Conduit only.
rune.wildercord.slowburn.desc: Hunger drains half as fast for 10 minutes. Can be a passive.
rune.wildercord.camp_ward.desc: Wards an 8-block camp for 5 minutes: monsters that appear inside fade at once, and phantoms nearby lose their prey. One per caster.
rune.wildercord.warm_cloak.desc: You can't freeze for 10 minutes, even in powder snow. Can be a passive.
rune.wildercord.softsole.desc: You don't trample farmland when you jump or step down onto it, for 10 minutes. Can be a passive.
rune.wildercord.softfoot.desc: For 5 minutes, monsters more than 8 blocks away lose track of you, unless you struck them in the last 10 seconds. Can be a passive.
rune.wildercord.hollow_pocket.desc: Opens your own 9-slot pocket. What you keep there stays yours, through death too.
rune.wildercord.lodestar.desc: Sets your lodestar where it lands, or at your feet. Homeward takes you back to it.
rune.wildercord.homeward.desc: Hold still for 3 seconds to return to your lodestar, in this world and within 2000 blocks. Moving or getting hurt breaks it. 2-minute rest.
rune.wildercord.gravefinder.desc: For a minute, pale motes point the way to where you last died.
rune.wildercord.skyread.desc: Tells you the weather, how long it will hold, the hour and the moon.
rune.wildercord.lullaby.desc: You and allies within 8 blocks count as rested, so phantoms leave you be. Tells you how many are asleep.
rune.wildercord.steedsong.desc: Your mount, or the animal it touches, gets Speed II and Jump Boost II for 3 minutes.
rune.wildercord.glidewind.desc: For 2 minutes, a tailwind keeps your elytra glide from slowing down, up to a steady cruise.
rune.wildercord.waymark.desc: Raises a pillar of light only you can see, from 160 blocks, for 10 minutes. Up to 3 at once.
rune.wildercord.ember_rest.desc: Kindles a resting fire for 5 minutes: allies within 6 blocks regenerate and stay warm. One per caster.
rune.wildercord.orbcall.desc: Experience orbs within 10 blocks drift to you for 5 minutes. Can be a passive.
rune.wildercord.tinker_hum.desc: For 5 minutes, a worn tool or piece of armor you carry mends a point every 10 seconds, up to 30.
rune.wildercord.lantern_soul.desc: An unseen light follows you for 5 minutes. Can be a passive.
rune.wildercord.keenkeep.desc: Your held tool wears half as fast for 5 minutes. Can be a passive.
rune.wildercord.landread.desc: Tells you the biome, height and light where it lands, and whether slimes spawn there.
rune.wildercord.rally_light.desc: Raises a beacon for 3 minutes: allies within 10 blocks get Haste I and Speed I. One per caster.
rune.wildercord.dew_drink.desc: For 10 minutes, rain or water feeds you a hunger point every 15 seconds.
rune.wildercord.sunbask.desc: For 10 minutes, open daylight heals you a point every 6 seconds while nothing hurts you.
rune.wildercord.currentkin.desc: Swim with the dolphins' grace for 3 minutes. Can be a passive.
rune.wildercord.surefoot.desc: Step up full blocks without jumping for 5 minutes. Can be a passive.
rune.wildercord.long_arm.desc: Reach 2 blocks farther to build and mine for 5 minutes. Can be a passive.
rune.wildercord.nightwatch.desc: For 10 minutes, a bell warns you when a monster within 16 blocks starts hunting you. Can be a passive.
rune.wildercord.trailblaze.desc: For 10 minutes, you leave green crumbs every 6 blocks that only you can see. Up to 40.
rune.wildercord.hearthpath.desc: For a minute, warm motes point the way to your bed or spawn.
rune.wildercord.lostfind.desc: For 30 seconds, gold motes point to the nearest loose items within 32 blocks.
rune.wildercord.stillwell.desc: For 5 minutes, standing still for 3 seconds slowly refills your mana, up to 12.
rune.wildercord.starchart.desc: Tells you where you are, which way you face, and how far it is to spawn.
rune.wildercord.petward.desc: Your pets within 16 blocks get Resistance I for 3 minutes.
rune.wildercord.whistle.desc: Your pets within 48 blocks that aren't sitting or leashed come to your side.
rune.wildercord.luckcharm.desc: Luck I for 5 minutes. Can be a passive.
rune.wildercord.smoke_signal.desc: A tall column of smoke rises where it lands for 2 minutes.
rune.wildercord.wayfarer_hymn.desc: You and allies within 10 blocks get Speed I and Jump Boost I for 3 minutes. It ends for anyone who strikes.
rune.wildercord.steedmend.desc: Your mount, or the animal it touches, regenerates for 3 minutes.
rune.wildercord.dynamo_stride.desc: For 5 minutes, every 24 blocks you walk gives back 2 mana, up to 12.
rune.wildercord.tarry.desc: For 5 minutes, your good effects run down at half speed.
rune.wildercord.clot.desc: For 3 minutes, poison and wither on you wear off twice as fast.
rune.wildercord.heartsense.desc: For 30 seconds, you see the heartbeat of every creature within 24 blocks.
rune.wildercord.quench.desc: Puts you out, and for 3 minutes fire on you burns out three times as fast.
rune.wildercord.hearthbond.desc: Bonds you and allies within 12 blocks for 3 minutes: when one drops low they regenerate, and the rest hear it. Once a minute each.
rune.wildercord.springseek.desc: For 30 seconds, blue motes point to the nearest water source within 24 blocks.
rune.wildercord.savor.desc: For 5 minutes, food you eat fills you for longer.
