rune.wildercord.deepwarn.desc: For 5 minutes, warns you of lava below or a long drop ahead. Can be a passive.
rune.wildercord.enderhush.desc: For 10 minutes, endermen you haven't hurt forget their anger at you. Can be a passive.
rune.wildercord.furrow.desc: Strikes a row of 9 ground blocks running ahead of you, and whatever stands on them, at 70% power: a crop row to sow, grow or harvest.
rune.wildercord.plot.desc: Strikes a 3x3 patch of ground where you look, and whatever stands on it, at 80% power.
rune.wildercord.seedbed.desc: Strikes a 5x5 bed of ground where you look, and whatever stands on it, at 60% power: a whole field at once.
rune.wildercord.shaft.desc: Strikes a column of 8 blocks straight down from the block you look at, at 80% power: a mine shaft or a well.
rune.wildercord.stairwell.desc: Strikes a stair of 8 steps going down ahead of you, three blocks high at each step, at 70% power: dig your way down and walk it.
rune.wildercord.corridor.desc: Strikes a corridor 2 high and 8 deep into the block you look at, along your facing, at 80% power.
rune.wildercord.seam.desc: Strikes a 7-block line across the block you look at, side to side, and what stands by it, at 90% power.
rune.wildercord.facade.desc: Strikes a 5-wide, 3-high face of blocks where you look, and whatever stands at it, at 80% power.
rune.wildercord.dome.desc: Strikes the shell of a dome of radius 2 over where you look, and everything under it, at 90% power: carve a room or light a shelter.
rune.wildercord.footing.desc: Strikes the 3x3 ground under your feet, and you and whatever stands on it, at 90% power.
rune.wildercord.canopy.desc: Strikes a 3x3 layer of blocks 3 above where you look (leaves, a roof), and whatever is beneath, at 90% power.
rune.wildercord.shoreline.desc: Strikes the water and the banks beside it within 4 blocks of where you look, and what wades there, at 70% power.
rune.wildercord.perimeter.desc: Strikes the 24-block edge of a 7x7 square where you look, and whatever stands on it, at 80% power: a fence line of light or thorns.
rune.wildercord.spire.desc: Strikes a column 6 high rising from the block you look at, and whatever stands in it: a trunk, a pillar, a stack of cactus.
rune.wildercord.pit.desc: Strikes a 3x3 pit 2 deep where you look, and whatever stands over it, at 90% power.
rune.wildercord.crossway.desc: Strikes a cross of ground with arms of 4 where you look, and whatever stands on it, at 80% power: two paths at once.
rune.wildercord.lodeseek.desc: Seeks up to 8 ores within 3 blocks of the block you look at and strikes each, at 60% power. No ore, no strike.
rune.wildercord.vault.desc: Strikes the 3x3x3 cube of blocks around the block you look at, and whatever is inside, at 90% power.
rune.wildercord.lamplit.desc: Strikes the four corners and the middle of a 9x9 square where you look, at 80% power: lamps for a yard.
rune.wildercord.fissure.desc: Cracks a jagged line of 10 blocks of ground ahead of you and strikes whatever stands along it, at 110% power.
rune.wildercord.spiral.desc: Strikes a spiral of ground winding out 4 blocks from where you look, and whatever stands on it.
rune.wildercord.rosette.desc: Strikes a rosette of 13 ground blocks across 9 blocks where you look, and whatever stands on them.
rune.wildercord.stepstones.desc: Strikes 5 stepping stones of ground, every second block ahead of you, at 80% power: a path across water or dark.
rune.wildercord.causeway.desc: Strikes a road of ground 3 wide and 8 long ahead of you, and whatever stands on it, at 70% power.
rune.wildercord.hedgerow.desc: Strikes a 9-block line of ground across where you look, side to side, and whatever stands on it, at 90% power.
rune.wildercord.lattice.desc: Strikes every other block of a 5x5 square where you look (13 in a checkerboard), at 80% power: spacing for crops or lights.
rune.wildercord.collapse.desc: Strikes a 3x3 slab two blocks thick at the block you look at, and everything up to 6 blocks beneath it, at 120% power: bring the ceiling down.
rune.wildercord.fan.desc: Strikes five spokes of ground 3 to 6 blocks ahead of you in a 90-degree fan, and whatever stands on them.
rune.wildercord.bobber.desc: Lands on the first water within 24 blocks of your aim and strikes it and everything within 2.5 blocks: the fish, the drowned, the catch.
rune.wildercord.herd.desc: Strikes every animal within 8 blocks of you, at 90% power: feed, heal or move the herd.
rune.wildercord.fellowship.desc: Strikes you and every ally within 12 blocks (party, pets and team), at 80% power. Only allies: it never touches a foe.
rune.wildercord.saddle.desc: Strikes you, what you ride and whoever rides with you: speed a horse, shield a boat.
rune.wildercord.packbond.desc: Strikes every pet of yours within 24 blocks, and nothing else.
rune.wildercord.nursery.desc: Strikes every young animal within 8 blocks of you: grow them up, feed them.
rune.wildercord.shoal.desc: Strikes every creature in water within 10 blocks of you, at 90% power: fish, squid, drowned and swimmers.
rune.wildercord.rearguard.desc: Strikes everything behind you within 8 blocks, at 110% power.
rune.wildercord.grudge.desc: Strikes up to 6 creatures within 24 blocks that hurt you last or are hunting you, at 120% power.
rune.wildercord.sentinel.desc: Strikes up to 8 enemies within 16 blocks that are hunting you or an ally, at 110% power.
rune.wildercord.aureole.desc: Strikes you and everything within 3 blocks of you, friend and foe alike: each effect finds its own.
rune.wildercord.tether.desc: Strikes the creature you look at (within 24 blocks) and everything within 3 blocks of it, at 110% power.
rune.wildercord.flock.desc: Strikes every flying creature within 16 blocks: bats, bees, parrots, phantoms, vexes and ghasts.
rune.wildercord.angler_lure.desc: Your fishing bobber within 32 blocks: the wait for a bite is cut in half, leaving at least 1 second. Once per bobber.
rune.wildercord.bait_blessing.desc: Luck for 60 seconds, Luck II with Amplify. Fishing reads your luck, so better catches come a little more often.
rune.wildercord.reeling_tide.desc: Reels in your bobber with the rod in your hand. A fish that is biting is caught as usual.
rune.wildercord.school_sight.desc: Fish, squid, dolphins, turtles and axolotls within 16 blocks of the point glow for 12 seconds.
rune.wildercord.tackle_mend.desc: Mends 16 durability of a held fishing rod, more with Power.
rune.wildercord.bobber_bell.desc: For 60 seconds your bobber rings and splashes when a fish bites.
rune.wildercord.water_reading.desc: Tells whether your bobber sits in open water (needed for treasure) and whether rain is speeding up bites.
rune.wildercord.dolphin_call.desc: Dolphins within 24 blocks swim to you. If any come, you get Dolphin's Grace for 20 seconds.
rune.wildercord.axolotl_kinship.desc: Axolotls within 12 blocks are healed and follow you for 30 seconds.
rune.wildercord.shoal_herd.desc: Fish within 10 blocks of the point swim to it for 10 seconds.
rune.wildercord.refloat.desc: Fish, squid and dolphins stranded on land within 6 blocks are set back in water within 8 blocks.
rune.wildercord.reed_cut.desc: Cuts kelp, seagrass, sugar cane and lily pads within 3 blocks of the point, up to 12. Kelp and cane keep their base to regrow.
rune.wildercord.wring.desc: Soaks up water like a sponge within 2 blocks of the point, up to 24 blocks.
rune.wildercord.spring_draw.desc: Fills an empty bucket in your hand with water. Without one, places a water source where you aim.
rune.wildercord.brimming.desc: Fills up to 4 cauldrons within 4 blocks of the point with water.
rune.wildercord.oceans_favor.desc: Water Breathing, Dolphin's Grace, Conduit Power and Night Vision for 120 seconds. Found only, never crafted.
rune.wildercord.diving_bell.desc: Under water: a 1-by-2 pocket of air at the point, walled in glass, for 15 seconds.
rune.wildercord.tide_lantern.desc: A light at the point for 60 seconds that shines under water too.
rune.wildercord.sluice.desc: Puts out fire within 4 blocks of the point, up to 24 blocks, campfires too, and anything burning there.
rune.wildercord.soak_through.desc: Concrete powder within 2 blocks of the point sets and dirt turns to mud, up to 12 blocks.
rune.wildercord.rain_cloud.desc: A small cloud rains on the point: farmland within 4 blocks is soaked, up to 8 crops grow, fires go out and a cauldron gains water.
rune.wildercord.storm_glass.desc: Tells how long until the weather turns.
rune.wildercord.kelpsong.desc: Kelp, seagrass and sea pickles within 4 blocks of the point grow as if bone mealed, up to 8.
rune.wildercord.coral_mend.desc: Dead coral touching water within 3 blocks of the point comes back to life, up to 8.
rune.wildercord.nest_tend.desc: Turtle eggs within 4 blocks move a stage closer to hatching, up to 4, and baby turtles grow.
rune.wildercord.lily_path.desc: Lays up to 10 lily pads across the water the way you look, for 30 seconds.
rune.wildercord.sandbar.desc: Raises a 12-block sandstone path at the water's surface the way you look, for 20 seconds.
rune.wildercord.ice_auger.desc: Bores through up to 3 blocks of ice at the point, leaving water to fish in.
rune.wildercord.tide_marker.desc: Sets a glowing buoy at the point for 5 minutes and tells you where it is. One per caster.
rune.wildercord.shore_sense.desc: Points to the nearest dry land within 48 blocks.
rune.wildercord.fathom.desc: Tells how deep the water is at the point and marks the bottom.
rune.wildercord.wreck_sense.desc: Chests and barrels under water and suspicious sand and gravel within 20 blocks shine for 15 seconds, up to 12.
rune.wildercord.drift_net.desc: Up to 16 items floating in water within 6 blocks of the point drift to you. Others' drops stay put.
rune.wildercord.mooring_call.desc: The nearest empty boat within 24 blocks comes to your side.
rune.wildercord.fair_wind.desc: In a boat: sail the way you look for 10 seconds.
rune.wildercord.upwell.desc: In water: rush up toward the surface.
rune.wildercord.sounding.desc: In water: dive fast for 2 seconds.
rune.wildercord.porpoise.desc: In water: leap forward like a dolphin, with no fall damage from the leap.
rune.wildercord.skimstep.desc: Run across water for 15 seconds. Crouch to sink.
rune.wildercord.skaters_edge.desc: Speed for 30 seconds, Speed II when standing on ice.
rune.wildercord.drown_ward.desc: For 60 seconds your air refills when it runs low, up to 3 times.
rune.wildercord.sea_breeze.desc: Clears Mining Fatigue, Nausea and Hunger.
rune.wildercord.inkveil.desc: Invisible for 10 seconds in water, 3 on land.
rune.wildercord.shellback.desc: Resistance for 15 seconds, 30 in water or rain.
rune.wildercord.dewcatch.desc: Up to 4 glass bottles in your pack fill with water.
rune.wildercord.divers_hands.desc: Mine at full speed under water for 60 seconds.
rune.wildercord.tillage.desc: Tills the dirt and grass in a 5-by-5 patch around the block it strikes into farmland, as a hoe would. Widen reaches further; never more than 32 blocks a cast.
rune.wildercord.dewfall.desc: A soft dew wets every farmland block in a 5-by-5 patch around the point to full moisture.
rune.wildercord.tilth.desc: Loosens the coarse and rooted dirt in a 5-by-5 patch into plain dirt; rooted dirt sheds its hanging roots, as a hoe would.
rune.wildercord.plowline.desc: Ploughs a straight furrow from the block it strikes along the way you face: up to 8 blocks of dirt or grass tilled into farmland, longer with power (16 at most).
rune.wildercord.sow.desc: Plants seeds from your own inventory into the empty farmland of a 5-by-5 patch, one seed for each block. Nothing is planted that you don't carry.
rune.wildercord.ripen.desc: Hurries each crop, stem, berry bush and nether wart in a 5-by-5 patch one stage on (two at 1.5 power, three at most). Ripe ones are left as they are.
rune.wildercord.dewkeep.desc: Hangs a mist over a 5-by-5 patch for 60 seconds: its farmland is wetted now and again every 5 seconds, so a field far from water never dries. Lovely from a Totem or a Zone.
rune.wildercord.fieldsense.desc: Reads the field within 6 blocks: every ripe crop glints, and you're told how many are ripe and how many are still growing.
rune.wildercord.thawfield.desc: A warm breath melts the snow layers in a 5-by-5 patch away from crops and soil. Snow blocks and ice are left alone.
rune.wildercord.cloche.desc: Sets a glass of quickened time over a 5-by-5 patch for 30 seconds: once a second, every plant under it gets the growing tick the world gives now and then. At most 25 plants a second.
rune.wildercord.scarecrow.desc: Stands a ward of rustling wind on the spot for 20 seconds: rabbits, foxes and monsters within 5 blocks are shooed out of it once a second. Pets and farm animals stay put.
rune.wildercord.fallow.desc: Rests the bare farmland in a 5-by-5 patch back into dirt. Farmland with something growing on it is left as it is.
rune.wildercord.ditchwater.desc: Fills the hole you strike with one source of water, if it is an open hole with farmland within 4 blocks. Never in the Nether's heat.
rune.wildercord.compost.desc: Feeds the composter you strike from your inventory, as if you dropped the items in yourself: up to 8 seeds, leaves or scraps (16 at double power).
rune.wildercord.stalkrise.desc: Sugar cane and cactus in a 5-by-5 patch grow one block taller, never past three tall; bamboo grows as bone meal would grow it.
rune.wildercord.gourdcall.desc: Grown pumpkin and melon stems in a 5-by-5 patch try at once to set their fruit, as many times as a day of waiting would give them.
rune.wildercord.berrybless.desc: Sweet berry bushes in a 5-by-5 patch ripen to full, and the glow berry vines among them come into fruit.
rune.wildercord.courtship.desc: Up to 6 grown farm animals within 5 blocks fall in love at once, as if you'd fed them. Animals that aren't ready yet (or belong to someone else) are left alone.
rune.wildercord.herdcall.desc: Farm animals within 8 blocks walk to the spot it lands (to you, cast on yourself). Up to 12 come at once.
rune.wildercord.fleece.desc: Shears every woolly sheep within 5 blocks, as shears would, and the wool falls at their feet.
rune.wildercord.milkmaid.desc: Fills the empty buckets in your inventory with milk, one for each grown cow or goat within 5 blocks.
rune.wildercord.henhouse.desc: Each chicken within 5 blocks lays its next egg now. A hen hurried along can't be hurried again for 2 minutes.
rune.wildercord.gentlehand.desc: Farm animals within 5 blocks stop panicking and stand calm for 8 seconds, easy to lead or pen.
rune.wildercord.fodder.desc: Feeds the animals within 5 blocks from your inventory, each with one item of the food it eats: it heals 4 and a young one grows a tenth of the way up.
rune.wildercord.barnwarmth.desc: A hearth's warmth heals the farm animals and your pets within 5 blocks by 4 (more with power).
rune.wildercord.herdsense.desc: Farm animals within 12 blocks glow for 10 seconds, and you're told how many there are and how many are ready to breed.
rune.wildercord.hearthcook.desc: Cooks the raw food in your own inventory as a smoker would: up to 8 pieces (16 at double power). Only food; the rest of your pack is left alone.
rune.wildercord.stewpot.desc: Cooks bowls from your inventory into stew, as a crafting table would: a red and a brown mushroom make mushroom stew, six beetroots make beetroot soup. Up to 3 bowls.
rune.wildercord.bakehouse.desc: Bakes from your inventory: three wheat into bread, then a pumpkin, sugar and an egg into a pie. Up to 4 bakes (8 at double power).
rune.wildercord.pollinate.desc: The bees within 8 blocks dust the crops around the point: one crop in a 5-by-5 patch grows a stage for each bee, 2 per bee at double power. No bees, no help.
rune.wildercord.hivehum.desc: Each beehive and bee nest within 5 blocks fills by one level of honey. A hive hummed into can't be hurried again for a minute.
rune.wildercord.calmsmoke.desc: A puff of campfire smoke settles the angry bees within 6 blocks: they forget their quarrel and go back to work.
rune.wildercord.wildflower.desc: Sows wild flowers onto the open grass in a 5-by-5 patch: up to 6 flowers, more when widened.
rune.wildercord.saplingrise.desc: Saplings and mushrooms in a 5-by-5 patch are urged to grow: up to 3 of them each get the growth of 8 bone meal.
rune.wildercord.saplingsow.desc: Plants saplings from your own inventory onto open dirt and grass in a 5-by-5 patch, two blocks apart: up to 4.
rune.wildercord.leaffall.desc: The wild leaves in a 5-by-5-by-5 block around the point drop now, as if they'd decayed, with what decay would drop. Leaves placed by hand stay.
rune.wildercord.barkstrip.desc: Strips the bark off the logs and wood in a 5-by-5-by-5 block around the point, as an axe would.
rune.wildercord.coppice.desc: Fells the tree you strike (its logs, never more than 32, drop as an axe would cut them) and replants the stump with a sapling from your inventory. A log with no living leaves is part of a build and is left alone.
rune.wildercord.feastday.desc: A harvest feast for everyone it reaches: 6 hunger and 6 seconds of Saturation each, and Regeneration I for 10 seconds.
rune.wildercord.picnic.desc: A shared basket: each target eats 3 hunger and heals 2 (more with power).
rune.wildercord.honeydew.desc: Sweet as a honey bottle: cures Poison and heals 3 (more with power).
rune.wildercord.leafshade.desc: Cool leaf-shade: Fire Resistance for 15 seconds.
rune.wildercord.barkhide.desc: Skin like old oak: Resistance I for 12 seconds.
rune.wildercord.sapflow.desc: Spring sap rises in you: Regeneration I for 8 seconds.
rune.wildercord.trot.desc: Your mount (or the horse you strike) gets Speed II and Jump Boost I for 20 seconds. Cast on yourself while riding.
rune.wildercord.beeline.desc: You zip straight ahead like a bee to a flower, about 6 blocks, and land without a fall.
rune.wildercord.fieldstride.desc: A farmhand's long stride: Speed I and Jump Boost I for 20 seconds.
rune.wildercord.hayloft.desc: Tosses you up as if from a haystack, about 4 blocks, and you float down for 3 seconds without a fall.
rune.wildercord.stairdelve.desc: Carves a stair 5 steps down the way you face (iron-pickaxe hardness; Amplify for diamond). Stops short of lava, water or a drop.
rune.wildercord.riser.desc: Carves a stair 5 steps up the way you face (iron-pickaxe hardness; Amplify for diamond). Stops short of lava or water.
rune.wildercord.plumbline.desc: Digs a shaft up to 8 deep under the point (iron-pickaxe hardness). Stops a block above lava, water or a drop.
rune.wildercord.siftfall.desc: Sand and gravel hanging over air above the point fall as items, up to 4 high.
rune.wildercord.gangue.desc: Mines plain rock within 2 blocks of the point and leaves the ores standing.
rune.wildercord.orepluck.desc: Mines up to 8 ores with an open face within 4 blocks of the point.
rune.wildercord.luckstrike.desc: Mines the ore hit with Fortune I (II with Amplify).
rune.wildercord.silklift.desc: Mines the block hit whole, as Silk Touch would. Never a chest or anything with contents.
rune.wildercord.deepsound.desc: Tells you the nearest ore up to 16 blocks under the point, and how deep.
rune.wildercord.oretally.desc: Counts the ores within 6 blocks of the point by kind.
rune.wildercord.lavaseal.desc: Lava within 3 blocks of the point sets: still lava to obsidian, flowing lava to cobblestone. 16 at most.
rune.wildercord.deepway.desc: Bores a 3x3 road 3 deep into the wall hit (diamond-pickaxe hardness) and sets 2 torches from your pack.
rune.wildercord.hollowsense.desc: Points you to the nearest open cave within 12 blocks of the point.
rune.wildercord.kilnbake.desc: Blocks near the point bake in place when a furnace makes a block of them, like sand to glass. 9 at most.
rune.wildercord.blockpack.desc: Crafts nine of a kind in your pack into their block, like iron ingots into an iron block. 8 blocks at most.
rune.wildercord.unpack.desc: Turns up to 4 storage blocks in your pack back into nine pieces each.
rune.wildercord.millstone.desc: Grinds up to 16 cobblestone in your pack into gravel, or else gravel into sand.
rune.wildercord.toolmend.desc: Mends the tool in the target's hand with its repair material from your pack: a quarter for each, 4 at most.
rune.wildercord.levelground.desc: Mines away what stands up to 3 blocks over the point within 2 blocks of it.
rune.wildercord.holefill.desc: Fills holes near the point up to its height with stone, dirt or planks from your pack. 16 at most.
rune.wildercord.shoreup.desc: Props up hanging sand and gravel near the point with blocks from your pack. 8 at most.
rune.wildercord.stilt.desc: Raises you on a packed mud column up to 5 high. It crumbles after 30 seconds.
rune.wildercord.plankway.desc: Lays a lasting bridge up to 12 long the way you face, from planks or stone in your pack.
rune.wildercord.polish.desc: Polishes stone near the point: andesite, granite, diorite, tuff, basalt and the like. 9 at most.
rune.wildercord.brickwork.desc: Cuts stone near the point into its bricks. 9 at most.
rune.wildercord.agestone.desc: Ages masonry near the point: moss on cobblestone and stone bricks, cracks in deep bricks. 9 at most.
rune.wildercord.concreteset.desc: Concrete powder near the point sets into concrete. 16 at most.
rune.wildercord.chalkline.desc: Draws a line from you to the point for 20 seconds and tells you its length and rise.
rune.wildercord.pitfloor.desc: Lays a 3x3 packed mud floor over the air at the point. It crumbles after 20 seconds.
rune.wildercord.torchfall.desc: Sets up to 6 torches from your pack on the darkest floor near the point, 5 blocks apart.
rune.wildercord.gloomsight.desc: Marks the pitch-dark floor near the point, where monsters spawn, for 10 seconds.
rune.wildercord.lumenpath.desc: Hangs a light every 4 blocks from you to the point, 6 at most, for 120 seconds.
rune.wildercord.snuffout.desc: Puts out fire, campfires and candles within 4 blocks of the point.
rune.wildercord.headlamp.desc: A light follows the target for 60 seconds.
rune.wildercord.leverflip.desc: Flips up to 4 levers near the point.
rune.wildercord.buttonpush.desc: Presses up to 4 buttons near the point.
rune.wildercord.doorcall.desc: Opens or shuts up to 4 doors, trapdoors and gates near the point. Iron ones stay put.
rune.wildercord.chestsort.desc: Joins like items in the chest, barrel or shulker box hit and lays them out in order.
rune.wildercord.stow.desc: Moves pack items the chest hit already holds into it. Your hotbar stays.
rune.wildercord.restock.desc: Tops up your hotbar stacks from the chest hit.
rune.wildercord.stocktake.desc: Tells you the biggest stocks across the chests within 4 blocks of the point.
rune.wildercord.unburden.desc: Moves your whole pack into the chest hit, as far as it has room. Your hotbar stays.
rune.wildercord.lodepull.desc: Loose drops within 6 blocks drift to the target for 30 seconds. Never someone else's drops.
rune.wildercord.caveward.desc: For 60 seconds, sand, gravel or powder snow that buries the target's head crumbles into items.
rune.wildercord.delvemark.desc: Marks your spot for 10 minutes. Cast again within 128 blocks and hold still 2 seconds to go back to it.
rune.wildercord.motherlode.desc: Mines up to 16 ores within 3 blocks of the point with Fortune II (III with Amplify).
rune.wildercord.floorlay.desc: Lays a 5x5 floor at the point from stone, dirt or planks in your pack, over air only.
rune.wildercord.packtidy.desc: Joins like stacks in your pack. Your hotbar is left alone.
rune.wildercord.tidy.desc: Blocks it breaks drop straight into your pack; what doesn't fit lands at your feet.
rune.wildercord.replanting.desc: Ripe crops it breaks are replanted from their own seeds.
rune.wildercord.kilned.desc: What it breaks drops already smelted, with no fuel. Only one drop rule per effect.
rune.wildercord.silken.desc: Blocks it breaks drop themselves, as with Silk Touch. Only one drop rule per effect.
rune.wildercord.windfall.desc: Blocks it breaks drop as if mined with Fortune III. Only one drop rule per effect.
rune.wildercord.veinfollow.desc: Breaking an ore also breaks up to 8 more touching blocks of the same ore.
rune.wildercord.timbering.desc: Breaking a log fells up to 24 more logs of the tree above it.
rune.wildercord.level_ground.desc: Never breaks a block below your feet, so you can't dig yourself a pit.
rune.wildercord.steady.desc: The effect can't break any block, and costs 10% less. Not with block modifiers.
rune.wildercord.damp.desc: Fire it starts on blocks goes straight out; creatures still burn.
rune.wildercord.magnetic.desc: Items within 6 blocks of where it lands fly to you.
rune.wildercord.sowing.desc: Plants seeds from your pack on bare farmland within 3 blocks of where it lands.
rune.wildercord.furrowing.desc: Tills grass and dirt within 2 blocks of where it lands into farmland.
rune.wildercord.fertile.desc: Crops and saplings within 3 blocks of where it lands grow a stage.
rune.wildercord.torchset.desc: If it lands somewhere dark, sets a torch there from your pack.
rune.wildercord.ore_sensing.desc: Ores within 8 blocks of where it lands glimmer for 10 seconds.
rune.wildercord.fetching.desc: The loot of creatures it kills lands at your feet.
rune.wildercord.bountiful.desc: Creatures it kills drop twice the experience, even untouched by your hand.
rune.wildercord.culling.desc: Lands only on monsters, 20% stronger; everything else is passed over.
rune.wildercord.headhunting.desc: Lands only on the healthiest creature it reaches, 60% stronger.
rune.wildercord.hallowed.desc: Twice as strong on the undead; the living are passed over.
rune.wildercord.tapering.desc: The first creature takes 50% more; each after takes a quarter less than the one before.
rune.wildercord.pooled.desc: Double power, shared evenly between every creature it reaches.
rune.wildercord.sunlit.desc: Twice as strong under open daylight sky; half as strong anywhere else.
rune.wildercord.gentle.desc: Passes over farm animals, pets and villagers.
rune.wildercord.sparing.desc: Passes over other players and their pets.
rune.wildercord.soothing.desc: Creatures it lands on forget their anger at you; 30% weaker.
rune.wildercord.cushioned.desc: Whoever it moves takes no fall damage on their next landing (10 seconds).
rune.wildercord.mending.desc: Also mends 10 durability on each target's held item and armour.
rune.wildercord.nourishing.desc: Also feeds each player it lands on 3 hunger.
rune.wildercord.purifying.desc: Also lifts one harmful effect from each target.
rune.wildercord.matchmaking.desc: Grown animals it lands on fall in love.
rune.wildercord.fleecing.desc: Sheep it reaches are shorn; the wool lands at your feet.
rune.wildercord.inward.desc: Lands on you alone, 40% stronger. Not with Selfless.
rune.wildercord.selfless.desc: Skips you and lands on the others 30% stronger. Not with Inward.
rune.wildercord.triage.desc: Lands only on the most hurt creature it reaches, 60% stronger.
rune.wildercord.if_night.desc: The rest fires only at night.
rune.wildercord.if_day.desc: The rest fires only by day.
rune.wildercord.if_raining.desc: The rest fires only while rain or snow falls on you.
rune.wildercord.if_underground.desc: The rest fires only with no open sky above you.
rune.wildercord.if_alone.desc: The rest fires only with no other player or monster within 16 blocks.
rune.wildercord.if_near_ally.desc: The rest fires only with a friendly player or your pet within 8 blocks.
rune.wildercord.if_unhurt.desc: The rest fires only at full health.
rune.wildercord.if_holding_tool.desc: The rest fires only with a pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe or shears in hand.
rune.wildercord.if_brimming.desc: The rest fires only with more than half your mana left.
rune.wildercord.if_in_fields.desc: The rest fires only with farmland within 4 blocks of your feet.
rune.wildercord.on_mine.desc: The rest waits up to 30 seconds for the next block you mine, then fires there.
rune.wildercord.on_harvest.desc: The rest waits up to a minute for the next ripe crop you pick, then fires there.
rune.wildercord.on_catch.desc: The rest waits up to 2 minutes for your next catch with a rod, then fires where you reeled it in.
rune.wildercord.on_sprint.desc: The rest waits up to 15 seconds for you to start sprinting, then fires from you.
rune.wildercord.on_splash.desc: The rest waits up to 30 seconds for you to enter water, then fires there.
rune.wildercord.on_mount.desc: The rest waits up to 30 seconds for you to ride something, then fires at your mount.
rune.wildercord.on_wake.desc: The rest waits up to 10 minutes for you to wake from a bed, then fires from you.
rune.wildercord.land_reading.desc: Reads the ground where it lands: its biome, how warm it is, and its height against sea level.
rune.wildercord.depth_sounding.desc: Sounds the rock under the point: how far down the first open cave or lava lies, up to 64 blocks.
rune.wildercord.spawn_bearing.desc: Tells which way the world spawn lies and roughly how far.
rune.wildercord.home_bearing.desc: Tells which way your bed or respawn anchor lies and roughly how far, when it is in this world.
rune.wildercord.grave_bearing.desc: Tells which way you last died and roughly how far, when it was in this world.
rune.wildercord.portal_reckoning.desc: Tells where this spot lies in the other realm: one Nether block is eight in the Overworld.
rune.wildercord.slime_sense.desc: Tells whether slimes can spawn underground in this chunk.
rune.wildercord.sky_reading.desc: Reads the sky: the weather now and about how many minutes until it turns.
rune.wildercord.moon_reading.desc: Reads the moon tonight and how many nights until the next full moon.
rune.wildercord.sun_reading.desc: Tells the time of day and how many minutes until dusk or dawn.
rune.wildercord.lux_reading.desc: Reads the light where it lands, from blocks and from the sky, and whether monsters may spawn there.
rune.wildercord.chalk_line.desc: Draws a dust line from you to the point for 10 seconds and tells its length in blocks.
rune.wildercord.village_sense.desc: Senses the nearest village and tells which way and roughly how far. Structure senses share a 30-second rest.
rune.wildercord.ruin_sense.desc: Senses the nearest trail ruins and tells which way and roughly how far. Structure senses share a 30-second rest.
rune.wildercord.shipwreck_sense.desc: Senses the nearest shipwreck and tells which way and roughly how far. Structure senses share a 30-second rest.
rune.wildercord.portal_sense.desc: Senses the nearest ruined portal and tells which way and roughly how far. Structure senses share a 30-second rest.
rune.wildercord.fortress_sense.desc: In the Nether, senses the nearest fortress and tells which way and roughly how far. Structure senses share a 30-second rest.
rune.wildercord.stronghold_compass.desc: In the Overworld, tells which way the nearest stronghold lies, but never how far. Structure senses share a 30-second rest.
rune.wildercord.spire_sense.desc: In the End, senses the nearest End city and tells which way and roughly how far. Structure senses share a 30-second rest.
rune.wildercord.trail_blaze.desc: Sets a glowing end rod on the face it hits for 5 minutes, to mark the way back. It drops nothing.
rune.wildercord.relic_sense.desc: Suspicious sand and gravel within 12 blocks glow for 20 seconds, and you hear how many there are.
rune.wildercord.spawner_sense.desc: Counts the monster and trial spawners within 32 blocks and points to the nearest.
rune.wildercord.steady_brush.desc: With a brush in hand, brushes up to 3 suspicious blocks near the point at once, hands free. The brush wears a point for each.
rune.wildercord.appraise.desc: Reads a villager: their trade, their level, and how many of their trades are sold out.
rune.wildercord.trade_renew.desc: A villager with a trade restocks every offer. Each villager only once a day.
rune.wildercord.haggle.desc: For 20 seconds villagers give you their Hero of the Village prices.
rune.wildercord.folk_call.desc: Villagers within 16 blocks walk over to the point.
rune.wildercord.folk_census.desc: Counts the villagers within 32 blocks: with a trade, without one, nitwits, children, and golems.
rune.wildercord.lapis_thrift.desc: For 60 seconds, your next enchantment at a table gives one lapis back.
rune.wildercord.quickbrew.desc: Brewing stands within 6 blocks brew twice as fast for 20 seconds.
rune.wildercord.potion_steep.desc: Good potion effects last a quarter longer, up to 45 seconds more and 8 minutes in all.
rune.wildercord.lore_reading.desc: Reads the item in your hand: how many enchantments it holds and what an anvil will charge to work it.
rune.wildercord.shelf_count.desc: At an enchanting table: how many bookshelves feed it, out of 15, and how many are blocked.
rune.wildercord.beacon_swell.desc: Beacons within 16 blocks reach half again as far for 60 seconds.
rune.wildercord.dye_wash.desc: Recolours up to 16 wool, glass, terracotta, concrete or candle blocks around the point to the dye in your other hand. One dye per 8 blocks.
rune.wildercord.checker_dye.desc: Like Dye Wash, but only every other block, for a checkered pattern. One dye per 8 blocks.
rune.wildercord.glyph_carve.desc: Carves a glowing glyph of the way you face onto the first blank line of a sign.
rune.wildercord.lamplighter.desc: Lights the unlit candles and campfires within 6 blocks.
rune.wildercord.snuff_out.desc: Puts out the candles and campfires within 6 blocks.
rune.wildercord.sign_glow.desc: Makes the writing on signs within 6 blocks glow, front and back.
rune.wildercord.frame_veil.desc: Item frames holding an item within 6 blocks turn invisible. Cast again to show them.
rune.wildercord.stand_pose.desc: Armor stands within 6 blocks gain arms and step to their next pose.
rune.wildercord.lava_crust.desc: The lava top around the point hardens to basalt for 20 seconds, a safe place to land.
rune.wildercord.void_step.desc: A platform of end stone forms under your feet and crumbles from the edge after 6 seconds.
rune.wildercord.lava_sense.desc: Tells how much lava lies within 8 blocks and which way the nearest is.
rune.wildercord.gold_parley.desc: Piglins within 12 blocks forget their anger at you. Brutes stay angry.
rune.wildercord.worst_first.desc: Heals the most hurt ally within 8 blocks of where it lands (you too) for 6.
rune.wildercord.salve.desc: Heals 2, gives Regeneration I for 8 seconds and puts out fire.
rune.wildercord.mending_mist.desc: A 4-block mist for 8 seconds: allies inside heal 1 each second.
rune.wildercord.hearthglow.desc: A 4-block glow for 12 seconds: allies inside are thawed and kept at Regeneration I.
rune.wildercord.aftercare.desc: For 15 seconds, each time the target is hurt it heals 1 a second later, 6 in all.
rune.wildercord.hearthsong.desc: Heals each ally within 6 blocks for 2, plus 1 for every ally there (up to 6).
rune.wildercord.grace.desc: For 60 seconds a killing blow leaves the target at 2 health with Resistance III for 3 seconds. Once per 10 minutes each; never a boss.
rune.wildercord.managift.desc: Gives up to 20 of your mana to each ally player hit; they get three quarters of it. Never yourself.
rune.wildercord.manawell.desc: A 3-block well for 10 seconds: allies inside regain 2 mana each second.
rune.wildercord.guardlink.desc: For 15 seconds, 40% of the ally's damage comes to you instead. Breaks past 16 blocks or at 6 health. Not on yourself.
rune.wildercord.rally.desc: Allies within 8 blocks get Speed I and Jump Boost I for 12 seconds.
rune.wildercord.morale.desc: Allies within 6 blocks get Absorption for 20 seconds, one level for each ally there (up to III).
rune.wildercord.shrug_off.desc: Lifts the harmful effect with the most time left.
rune.wildercord.hexguard.desc: For 20 seconds, the next harmful effect that would land is refused.
rune.wildercord.stoutheart.desc: Resistance I for 10 seconds (Amplify makes it II).
rune.wildercord.ironhold.desc: For 6 seconds no single blow deals the target more than 4.
rune.wildercord.evade.desc: For 10 seconds the next melee blow misses and the target slips aside.
rune.wildercord.emberguard.desc: Puts the target out and gives Fire Resistance for 30 seconds.
rune.wildercord.beastguard.desc: Your pet, mount or a farm animal gets Resistance II and Fire Resistance for 60 seconds.
rune.wildercord.hearthguard.desc: A villager, trader or golem takes 60% less damage from monsters for 5 minutes.
rune.wildercord.heel.desc: Your pets within 32 blocks that are not sitting come to your side.
rune.wildercord.bellward.desc: For 2 minutes villagers within 12 blocks take 60% less damage from monsters, and monsters there glow.
rune.wildercord.sanctuary.desc: A 6-block circle for 30 seconds: no monster spawns there, and monsters inside are nudged out.
rune.wildercord.arrowveil.desc: A 4-block dome for 10 seconds: enemy missiles inside drop out of the air.
rune.wildercord.blastward.desc: For 60 seconds explosions within 6 blocks break no blocks.
rune.wildercord.firebreak.desc: Puts out fire within 5 blocks, and the allies there.
rune.wildercord.pacify.desc: The creature forgets its target and picks none for 6 seconds; harming it ends this. Players get Weakness instead. Not bosses.
rune.wildercord.lure.desc: Enemies drop their target and walk to where it lands for 4 seconds.
rune.wildercord.stillbind.desc: Holds the target in place for 3 seconds without harm. Bosses are only slowed.
rune.wildercord.taunt.desc: Enemies hit turn on you for 6 seconds, and you get Resistance I for as long.
rune.wildercord.nudge.desc: A gentle push 3 blocks away from you. No harm.
rune.wildercord.hobble.desc: Slowness III for 4 seconds. No harm.
rune.wildercord.corral.desc: Enemies within 5 blocks are kept inside the ring for 6 seconds.
rune.wildercord.truce.desc: Every enemy within 8 blocks is pacified for 4 seconds. Not bosses.
rune.wildercord.spook.desc: Enemies flee from you for 3 seconds. Bosses and players are only slowed.
rune.wildercord.aegis.desc: You and allies within 6 blocks take half damage and none from missiles for 6 seconds. Rests 2 minutes.
rune.wildercord.accord.desc: Enemies within 16 blocks are pacified for 10 seconds and no monster spawns there meanwhile. Not bosses.
rune.wildercord.citadel.desc: An 8-block ward for 60 seconds: explosions break nothing, missiles from outside drop at the edge, and allies inside take 20% less damage.
rune.wildercord.shieldwall.desc: You and allies within 5 blocks can't be knocked back and get Resistance I for 8 seconds.
rune.wildercord.staunch.desc: Ends poison and wither and keeps them off for 10 seconds.
rune.wildercord.sentry.desc: Monsters within 16 blocks of the target glow for 10 seconds.
rune.wildercord.tend.desc: Heals a villager, golem, pet or animal for 8 (an iron golem for 16).
rune.wildercord.soothe.desc: A neutral creature forgets its anger and its target.
rune.wildercord.withdraw.desc: An ally below half health turns invisible with Speed II for 4 seconds, and its hunters lose track of it.
rune.wildercord.keepsafe.desc: For 10 minutes the block hit can't be broken by anyone outside your party, nor by explosions.
rune.wildercord.faithful.desc: For 5 minutes, a killing blow leaves your pet at 1 health beside you. Once per 10 minutes each.

tooltip.wildercord.world.ignite: Where it lands: sets grass and leaves alight, lights candles and campfires, melts snow and ice, boils water into blinding steam. It lights TNT too: stand clear
tooltip.wildercord.world.freeze: Where it lands: freezes water into ice you can walk on, cools lava into a crust that melts back after 25 seconds, puts out fires, campfires and candles
tooltip.wildercord.world.conduct: Where it lands: in water, shocks every foe in the same water; scrapes a stage of oxidation off copper and powers lightning rods. It may charge a creeper: careful
tooltip.wildercord.world.gust: Where it lands: knocks arrows and fireballs away, blows out small fires and candles, scatters loose items
tooltip.wildercord.world.heave: Where it lands: the ground heaves up, throwing foes standing on it
tooltip.wildercord.world.bloom: Where it lands: grass and flowers bloom, crops grow, and a weakened zombie villager starts to be cured
tooltip.wildercord.world.draw: Where it lands: draws loose items and experience in; an enderman struck can't teleport for 5 seconds
tooltip.wildercord.world.age: Where it lands: crops and saplings grow, copper weathers, young animals grow up faster, and a furnace jumps ahead in its smelting
tooltip.wildercord.world.shimmer: Where it lands: bookshelves and enchanting tables shimmer, and invisible creatures show for 3 seconds
tooltip.wildercord.world.feed: Where it lands: nether wart and crimson fungus grow
reaction.wildercord.overload.desc: Storm on a burning target: +30% damage, and the flames burst: 4 damage to every foe within 3 blocks, thrown back. The fire goes out.
reaction.wildercord.fracture.desc: Earth on a frozen target: +40% damage, the ice cracks, and for 5 seconds every spell hits it 20% harder.
reaction.wildercord.blight.desc: Life on a shadowed target (hexed, blinded, withered...): rot bursts out, 3 damage and poison to it and up to 5 foes around it, and you heal 1 for each (once a second at most).
reaction.wildercord.unweave.desc: Arcane on a target with two marks or more: every mark comes undone, +30% damage for each (up to +120%).
reaction.wildercord.rupture.desc: Wind on a bleeding target: +50% damage, the wound tears open for 4 more through armour, and you heal 2 (once a second at most).
reaction.wildercord.elapse.desc: Time on a burning, poisoned or withering target: all the damage still to come lands at once, half again as much (3 to 16).

screen.wildercord.combat.save_failed: Could not save. Previous live choices and the original file are unchanged. Your draft is still here.
screen.wildercord.combat.help.0: Classic keeps existing Wildercord motion. Articulated is an experimental, limited opt-in for selected sword arts and Master attacks. It does not add animation to every art. Damage, movement, costs and timing are unchanged; only this client sees your choice.
screen.wildercord.combat.help.1: Supported equipment is bare skin or matching vanilla netherite, including the existing funded Aura Armour shell. Other armor, an occupied offhand, capes, extra layers or rejected poses keep the whole existing body, item, armor and shell presentation. Visual mods and shaders need separate verification.
screen.wildercord.combat.help.2: Stable suppresses view/hurt bob and Wildercord shake, impact nudges and FOV punches. It stays selected with Classic or compatibility fallback. Mouse look, accepted aim and combat timing stay free. Default follows Minecraft options and Magic visuals Camera motion.
screen.wildercord.combat.help.3: For less motion, try Stable, Impact Off, Calm/Off body aura and Subtle/Off trails in Magic visuals. Reduced flash removes funded shell pulsing and white hit brightening and softens selected effects. Impact Off still allows a small flash. These choices do not guarantee all effects are flash-free.
screen.wildercord.combat.help.4: Launch options override saved choices: wildercord.articulated, .stableCamera, .armor, .armorArms and .auraShell. Explicit false wins too; missing adapters can require whole fallback. Reset saves Classic + Stable, but cannot change launch arguments. Find Magic visual settings in Controls or the Grimoire Life journal.
