item.wildercord.draft_kite.use: Use: 8 seconds of Slow Falling; spends one Windreed Tassel. Reusable, 20-second cooldown. Does not fly upward.
item.wildercord.windreed_braid.lore: The scent of the pass, wound through a patient knot.
item.wildercord.windreed_braid.use: Use: Downwind for 30 seconds, 10% slower movement. Calm approaches attract less wildlife attention; sprinting, close hare approaches and retaliation remain dangerous. Consumed.
item.wildercord.dusk_pearl.lore: A bead of living light, offered by a patient river dweller.
item.wildercord.dusk_pearl.use: Offer Seagrass to a wet, undisturbed Lantern Newt. One pearl; its saved gathering rest lasts two minutes. Crafts Marshlights or Tideward field notes.
message.wildercord.lantern_newt.water: Her gills need water or rain before she can offer a pearl.
message.wildercord.lantern_newt.rest: The little lantern is gathering its light. Let her rest.
guide.wildercord.lantern_newt: A small amphibian of open swamp shallows. It visits seagrass without consuming the plants; its nodules brighten at night, in rain and after Tidebreath or Life magic. Offer seagrass while it is wet and undisturbed for one Dusk Pearl, with a saved two-minute rest. Hurt animals flee and refuse feeding briefly. Pearls weave into waterloggable Marshlights, or bind Tideward field notes. It cannot be bred and gives no pearl when killed.
guide.wildercord.lantern_newt.hint: Watch open, shallow water in swamps and mangrove swamps. At night, look for three small lights along a paddle tail.
book.wildercord.tideward.1:
LIGHTS ALONG THE BANK

Iona, Tideward surveyor

We mark safe banks with reed cages. Their light comes from a gift, never a knife. The small newts browse living seagrass and carry the wetland night on their backs.
book.wildercord.tideward.2: Keep the gills wet. Offer one seagrass and wait two minutes before gathering again. A hurt newt flees and refuses your hand. Tidebreath and Life make its lights answer, but that answer offers no second pearl.
book.wildercord.tideward.3: Bind pearl, glass, string and seagrass into a Marshlight. It shines below water as well as above. Moths find such lamps, and travellers find the bank. Leave the plants standing. A living shore is worth more than a bag of beads.
item.wildercord.moonreed_floss.lore: Soft silver fibres from a flower opened by moth wings.
item.wildercord.moonreed_floss.use: Harvest a blooming Moonreed without breaking its root. Floss binds a Dewglass Lens.
item.wildercord.dewglass_lens.lore: A brass field instrument whose thread remembers the moon.
item.wildercord.dewglass_lens.use: Use to locate a visible Moonreed within eight blocks; use on reeds or Lantern Newts to inspect them. Five-second rest; 96 uses.
message.wildercord.dewglass.none: No Moonreed is visible nearby. Search open swamp banks.
message.wildercord.dewglass.dry: This root needs water beside it, or rain.
message.wildercord.dewglass.covered: Moonreed needs an open sky to bloom.
message.wildercord.dewglass.day: Moonreed prepares its buds under a wetland night.
message.wildercord.dewglass.growing: A damp root is preparing a bud. Life magic can help.
message.wildercord.dewglass.moth: The bud awaits a visiting Glimmerwing.
message.wildercord.dewglass.ready: The flower is open. Gather its floss; leave the root.
message.wildercord.dewglass.newt_dry: This newt needs water or rain before gathering.
message.wildercord.dewglass.newt_hurt: This newt is frightened. Give it time to settle.
message.wildercord.dewglass.newt_rest: This newt is gathering light: about %s seconds remain.
message.wildercord.dewglass.newt_ready: This wet newt is ready for an offering of Seagrass.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.about: Hover a learned rune for its material field note; click its name to find it in the Codex.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.result: Read the changed body, tool or plant
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.result.t: Tissue closes beside an actual wound. Repair stitches follow the changed equipment slot; garden signs belong to the changed cell. Check health, status, durability and terrain for exact results.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.empty: No change can mean no response
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.empty.ti: A full-health or clean target, refused repair, mature crop or protected cell may produce no successful material response. A cast spending mana does not promise that every effect changed its target.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.ward: Opening, trigger and ending are different
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.ward.tip: A living ward opening announces a limited opportunity. Its trigger follows the real save or strike. Expiration, cancellation or broken ownership do not pretend to heal or save someone.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.settings: Click to open actual local visual settings, then Done to return here. Choose Your spells and Other spells independently. Full, Balanced and Minimal change decoration, not health, mana or damage.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.quality: A small response is still a field clue
Minimal retains smaller authored materials. Crowded, distant or camera-close decoration may be omitted. Reduced flash and Camera motion are separate controls. Read the real outcome before judging it by particles.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.unknown: Learn a Life rune to open its material note.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.heal.mat: Two opposed tissue lips close toward a warm sap bead.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.heal.rea: The recipient gained real health or additional absorption. At base power it requests eight health; repeats on the same target in one cast scale to 60%, then 40%. Unused healing can become a capped absorption shield. A full-health target already at its shield cap gives no new successful change.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.regrowth: Separate tissue bands open beside a small living stem.

A regeneration stage was actually admitted. Ordinary casting takes hold in three stages; these bands announce the accepted status, not every later vanilla regeneration tick. Overlapping regeneration can refuse a weaker stage. Give it time to work rather than treating every band as an instant heal.
Dry seed husks peel away beside a pale tissue seam.

Real harmful conditions, fire, freezing or elemental marks were removed. A clean target has no spent conditions to shed. Use it to interrupt a reaction setup as well as remove visible potion ailments.
Two seed halves cup a food-colored sap drop.

A player's food/condition change or an eligible animal's healing or breeding admission actually occurred. Ordinary unsupported creatures are not fed by this spell. Food, animal healing and readiness to breed have their own real eligibility rules.
Short crossed repair stitches sit beside the actual repaired slot.

Body healing/fire clearing and item repairs are observed separately. At base power the repair requests 8% of maximum item durability, limited by the item's existing damage. Each recipient's slot has a one-minute repair rest; changing the item in that slot does not evade that rest.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.remedy.m: Removed husks give way to sap beads; a tissue patch follows actual healing.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.remedy.r: Harmful conditions are converted into useful boons when admitted, with healing observed separately. Zombie-villager Weakness preparation is a different branch: its preparation effect does not mean the villager has already been cured. Bring the normal cure requirements.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.grow.mat: A branching vine spine rises from the changed cell and sheds a seed coat.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.grow.rea: An eligible plant actually changed, or a young animal actually advanced its age. Aim at something with room to grow. Real cell feedback follows the plant writes; it does not promise an entire bonemeal area has succeeded.
A cut straw bundle drops ripe seed pieces at the crop.

A mature eligible crop was actually harvested. Check its real drops and replanted crop. Immature and protected crops cannot be treated as a successful harvest merely because the spell passed over them.
Small pale lichen plates and a light spore sit at the edited block.
Legal glow lichen was placed. The result is a real block that can keep lighting the area after its brief decoration settles. Suitable support and room for the block matter.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.ancient_: A layered seed coat opens around a rising branched stem.
A flower placement or cell changed during one of the finite growth sweeps. Find young crops before using it. Existing mature crops and denied cells supply no invented growth progress.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.glowvine: A drooping vine carries a single berry weight.

A vine segment/head was placed or an existing berry state really changed. It needs suitable ceiling space. A missing ceiling keeps the failure branch rather than painting a successful vine over the air.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.lifebloo: Uneven living petals cup a sap drop, then answer actual heal pulses and burst recipients.

Immediate healing, a finite repeating bloom, or a real terminal ally heal was admitted. Refresh updates the existing bloom instead of starting another independent timer. Full-health pulses do not claim unused healing; the final burst is checked per actual ally.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.bloom.ma: Three staggered opening petals; helped pollen recipients can receive a separate grain.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.bloom.re: A direct ally regeneration, bounded pollen hop, or real plant change succeeded in its own branch. The receiving ally or changed cell gets the response. Enemies and unsuitable plants do not become successful recipients because they were nearby.
Unequal twig teeth open on the protected recipient; an actual retaliation has a separate thorn response at the attacker.

A thorn ward was admitted or a real hostile attack spent its retaliation. It has finite charges and refill timing. Strike from outside its close retaliation range, wait it out, or avoid feeding it ordinary blows. Thorns do not answer thorns in an endless exchange.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.haven.ma: Sparse leaf shutters and a vine piece mark the living shelter and actual boundary responses.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.haven.re: The field exists; actual projectile glances and pushed foes have their own responses. This is no longer presented as a filled light dome. Hostile incoming projectiles can glance off; allied, outgoing and inside-fired shots are not a universal promise of reflection. It is temporary shelter, not invulnerability.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.reversal: A folded tissue-and-sap pocket opens when its actual death prevention triggers.

A valid save mark was admitted, or the real save fired. Deaths Door rest can refuse a new mark. Prepare it before danger; its opening does not mean a save already happened, and bypassing or ineligible damage is not promised to be caught.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.soulbond: Two endpoint knots of living fibre turn toward the real partner.

An eligible pair bonded, or a real transferred wound changed a recipient. The partner must be valid; a lone, distant or refused target cannot acquire a decorative substitute bond. Watch distance and the other partner's health. Shared wounds remain real danger, and a broken/expired bond is not a heal.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.second_w: Two seed shell halves close around a small Time piece; a real save cracks the shell open.

A valid preparation or actual lethal save succeeded. At base power the save leaves four health, then gives the existing recovery/escape effects. Death cheated by this or another save rests for a minute. A refreshed mark does not give immunity or erase that lockout.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.root_bul: Root splinters climb each placed cell, with leaves and stone grit.

A real living wall cell was placed; successful restoration can shed a separate local response. Allies nearby receive the wall's existing brief regeneration. It is temporary and drops no free wood. Protection, space and existing terrain determine which cells can be placed. A foreign replacement is preserved rather than removed on expiry.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.stitchti: Interrupted tissue stitches sit beside a small Time tooth.

A stitch ward, an actual recorded wound, or its real capped closing heal occurred. At base power it heals four initially, records four seconds of incoming wounds, and can return up to twelve at closure. A counted wound is not a claim of immediate healing. Refresh extends the existing bounded owner; it does not create a second closure timer.
One seed token flips above a forked stem.

The luck mark took hold, a lucky hit really took health, or its fortunate hostile-kill branch awarded extra experience. The death response belongs at that actual victim; it does not promise a drop, doubled damage or the next random roll. Its existing quiet orbit remains a distinct ongoing mark.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.bloomste: A low petal tread stretches toward the real endpoint, beside a small Void fragment.

The caster reached the validated arrival, an eligible ally actually gained regeneration, or real plant growth happened there. A blocked, unsafe, vetoed or redirected teleport does not manufacture an arrival success. The self branch can succeed through its actual regeneration or plant mutation without moving the caster.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.vinelash: A bent living tendon frays toward a thorn at the actual struck foe.

The hostile target's real admitted changes occurred, such as damage or the pull/status branch. Reach, eligibility and boss movement exclusions remain. The tendon identifies the victim, not every creature along the line.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.moonpeta: A one-sided silver petal cutting sits beside warm tissue for positive healing or a cooler thorn for harm.

A real allied heal or hostile change occurred. The existing moon factor still affects its mechanics. Read the recipient and their health rather than assuming every cool petal in the area has dealt damage.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.sporeblo: A split grounded fruit opens into small rising grains.

Its own field/recipient branches admitted a real change: hostile confusion or damage, or eligible allied nourishment. Poison immunity does not make the custom damage branch harmless. It has bounded recipients and finite damage rules; the fruit is not an unlimited damage cloud.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.rootsnar: Opposing root forks hold low around a foe; a real movement tax breaks a thorn.

A hostile hold/status or actual later movement damage occurred. After the initial hold, accumulated ordinary horizontal movement spends the existing finite thorn taxes; at most five tax events are available. Remaining still avoids movement tax but gives up position.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.drowse.m: Folded dry-leaf curtains descend with a small pollen grain; waking opens the curtain sideways.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.drowse.r: Actual sleep or its boss-drowsiness branch was admitted, or a real wake occurred. Damage wakes ordinary sleeping targets; the waking blow gets the existing bonus. Players have the shorter sleep, bosses get drowsiness rather than ordinary full sleep. Coordinate attacks so a small stray hit does not waste the opening.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.venom.ma: A close puncture pair seals around sap, with a small tissue response on an actual trigger.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.venom.re: Poison/admitted custom damage or a real damage tick changed the victim. The custom damage can affect enemies that resist ordinary poison. Propagation has its existing one-hop/recipient limits; repeated display does not create new free ticks or additional payment allowance.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.ashen_me: Scorched husks open beside a tissue seam.
Removed harmful conditions can become real capped healing. A clean target cannot invent converted healing. Its original landing voice is retained.
screen.wildercord.grimoire.life.pulse_fe: A lit sap pocket travels between actual endpoints.
Each endpoint answers only its actual admitted heal. Blocked or full-health healing gives no successful sap response or landing voice; movement and healing are separate results.
item.wildercord.dried_glowcap_gills.lore: Paper-thin lamellae hold the memory of a damp bank.
item.wildercord.dried_glowcap_gills.use: Craft a Fungal Nursery or a Cave Breather.
item.wildercord.cave_breather.lore: A Belowkeeper filter, built to trade quick feet for one clear breath.
item.wildercord.cave_breather.use: Hold in your offhand and use to clear current Poison. 32 filter uses; 10 second rest; 3 seconds of Slowness. Ongoing attacks can poison you again.
message.wildercord.fungal.replica: This is an ordinary carved stone. Its field memory is quiet.
message.wildercord.fungal.filter_rest: Hold the filter in your offhand. It needs current Poison and a rested filter.
message.wildercord.fungal.hint_snail: First, kneel empty-handed to gather dew from a patient Sporeback Snail.
message.wildercord.fungal.hint_root: Find the root-glyph Breathmark on covered cave moss or clay below Y48.
message.wildercord.fungal.hint_air: Find a different Breathmark bearing the open-air glyph. Another root mark adds no step.
message.wildercord.fungal.hint_harvest: Grow a damp dark Glowcap bud, let a snail browse it, and harvest its mature gills yourself.
message.wildercord.fungal.hint_roof: Craft a Fungal Nursery and place it yourself after harvesting gills.
message.wildercord.fungal.hint_breather: Craft your Cave Breather after placing the nursery: dew, dried gills, leather and copper.
message.wildercord.fungal.hint_return: Show your Cave Breather to a Fungal Nursery to finish Mara's investigation.
message.wildercord.fungal.hint_done: Mara's Three Breathmarks are complete. The nursery still shelters; the filter still works.
book.wildercord.fungal.0.1:
WHERE ROOTS DRINK

Mara, Belowkeeper

I followed a patient spiral to the cap below this stone. The stream stayed in its bed. Its roots drank from the side, never from water over their heads. The lamp was enough to spoil a bud.
book.wildercord.fungal.0.2: Set a Glowcap cutting on moss or clay, beside water and under cover. Keep it below bright torchlight. Life can prepare a bud. Only the slow mouth of a living snail can open its gills; leave the visitor its own resting clocks.
book.wildercord.fungal.0.3: Harvest the opened gills and leave the stem standing. Each cap begins again as a young bud. The next stone bears an open-air glyph. Seek another Belowkeeper mark on covered cave moss or clay, not a copy of this root.
book.wildercord.fungal.1.1:
THE SECOND BREATH

Mara, Belowkeeper

We once boxed our spirals in. They went still, but it was fear, not rest. This mark remembers the apprentice who cut four windows into a shelter and let the visitors choose whether to stay.
book.wildercord.fungal.1.2: Two sticks, paper and dried Glowcap gills make an open nursery canopy. Put its roof one block above a walkable dark footing. One snail can tuck beneath it after browsing. It gives no extra dew and shortens no gathering rest.
book.wildercord.fungal.1.3: Dew, gills, leather and copper make a Cave Breather. Keep it in the offhand. One breath clears present poison, then leaves three heavy seconds. The filter rests ten seconds. A fresh bite can still reach you. It is no shield.
book.wildercord.fungal.2.1:
THREE BREATHMARKS

Mara, Belowkeeper

You learned the living spiral, the drinking root and the open roof. Then you made your own breath. I leave three blank runes for what you discover next. This gift is made once.
book.wildercord.fungal.2.2: Keep the garden working: water beside the roots, dark cover above, and a visitor free to leave. A new harvest needs another prepared bud and another real browse. No lamp or chant pays the snail's resting time for it.
book.wildercord.fungal.2.3: We are not owners of the deep. We are guests who mark a safe step for the next traveller. Record the openings you find. Share a filter when a friend stumbles. The nursery remains useful after the journal is finished.
message.wildercord.watchweft.warn: Watchweft noticed a hostile approach. The watch is spent.
message.wildercord.watchweft.obscured: Watchweft is obscured; its next clear sample starts a new watch history.
message.wildercord.manabraid.offer: Mana offered: release crouch, then crouch once within three seconds to accept up to 16.
message.wildercord.manabraid.given: Gave %s mana through a lossy braid.
message.wildercord.manabraid.received: Received %s mana from an allied caster.
message.wildercord.rainshield.offer: %s offers arrow cover. Release sneak, then crouch within two seconds to accept.
item.wildercord.rooks_rainshield.lore: One crooked rib bears the storm; the others hold the cloth.
item.wildercord.rooks_rainshield.use: Hold still and use for 0.6 seconds, then cover one vanilla arrow within a 70-degree frontal cone for two seconds. Right-click a same-team player within three blocks to offer cover. They must begin a new crouch within two seconds then hold Use on that same teammate to open; already-crouching players release and recrouch. Both need grounded feet; the teammate must keep crouching. One catch: four wear, fifteen-second shared rest and heavy hands. Five intact durability needed. Magic, tridents, melee and rear shots pass through. No reflection or arrow pickup.
guide.wildercord.cinder_bailiff.hint: Listen for three ceramic vent clicks near a cooled woodland fern.
guide.wildercord.cinder_bailiff: A Bailiff rests only after reaching and browsing a mature cooled fern. Raised vents warn of three fixed ash lanes. Step behind it or use solid cover; each fan can strike you once. Ordinary physical damage during its warning or a successful cooling spell interrupts preparation. Its fern root survives browsing and harvest. Killing it grants no special materials.
guide.wildercord.siltcrest_bittern.hint: A quiet reed bird stalks wild cod and salmon at dusk. Crouch nearby; rain sends it toward a covered bank.
guide.wildercord.siltcrest_bittern: The bittern slowly coils its neck before one short fish strike. It leaves a small pond with at least two eligible fish and rests its appetite after a meal. Bucket fish, named fish and persistent fish are excluded. Offer raw cod or salmon while crouching for close observation; feeding creates no material or breeding reward. An admitted Tidebreath from an actual ally can interrupt a hunt into visible preening; wild birds are not automatically spell allies. Dry cover two blocks above a shallow bank can shelter it during rain or daylight.
item.wildercord.mossveil_cowl.lore: A quiet breath beside a trusted nose.
message.wildercord.mossveil.trim: The cowl filters %s ticks of poison. Your companion needs a rest.
guide.wildercord.mossveil_dormouse.hint: Look for rounded little sleepers beside mature cave Glowcaps.
guide.wildercord.mossveil_dormouse: Offer three dried Glowcap Gills, waiting five seconds between feedings. The first feeder keeps a five-minute claim; other players cannot finish it. Only her owner can order a curl with an empty hand. She follows a loaded owner by ordinary paths and never teleports across worlds. One Gill can heal a wounded companion by at most two health; full-health feeding refuses. She produces no materials and does not breed. A supported Fungal Nursery gives the Mossveil Cowl a real home: crouch still for two seconds beside your own curled companion to shorten finite poison by at most three seconds and one quarter of its remaining duration. Wear and both saved ten-second rests are paid. Stronger poison, physical damage and movement remain dangerous.
subtitles.wildercord.kit.mossveil.filter: Stitched cowl takes a quiet breath
guide.wildercord.black_bobcat.hint: Look for a tufted black cat in dark forests and old taigas.
guide.wildercord.black_bobcat: A melanistic wildcat as big as a polar bear, with tufted ears, a bobbed tail and pale gold eyes. A wild one keeps to itself, hunts rabbits and chickens and turns on whatever hurts it. Offer it fish, raw or cooked: one time in three it becomes yours. A tame bobcat follows you, sits when you tell it to, joins your fights and heals on more fish. Two tame bobcats fed fish raise a kitten that is yours too.
guide.wildercord.frost_lynx.hint: Look for a spotted silver cat in the snowy taigas and groves.
guide.wildercord.frost_lynx: A silver, dark-spotted cat of the snowfields with long black ear tufts and pale green eyes, kin to the black bobcat and nearly as big. Cold never touches it. Offer it raw rabbit or chicken: one time in three it becomes yours. Its bite chills, slowing what it bit and frosting it over. A tame lynx follows, sits when told, fights beside you and heals on more of what tamed it.
guide.wildercord.dune_cougar.hint: Look for a long tawny cat on the savannas and badlands.
guide.wildercord.dune_cougar: A long, tawny cat of the savannas and badlands with a cream muzzle, amber eyes and a dark-tipped rope of a tail, as big as the black bobcat. It is warier than its kin: raw beef, mutton or pork wins it over only one time in four. A tame cougar standing near you watches over you, and every monster close by glows for a while, picked out by its eye.
message.wildercord.giant.wakes: The ground shakes: %s has woken to the %s.

message.wildercord.tribulation.ally_begi: The sky answers %1$s's heart for the %2$s circle, and you stand in the ring beside them. Stay within %3$s blocks.
message.wildercord.tribulation.allies: %s of your party stand beside you. The storm grows to meet them.
message.wildercord.tribulation.ally_out: You are out of the tribulation.
message.wildercord.tribulation.ally_won: %1$s formed the %2$s circle with you beside them. A share of the spoils is yours.

message.wildercord.mentor.near: close enough to teach: condensing counts +25%%
message.wildercord.mentor.offered: %s offers to take you as their apprentice. The offer lasts a minute.
message.wildercord.mentor.offer_sent: You offered to take %s as your apprentice.

message.wildercord.mentor.taken_mentor: %s is now your apprentice. Every circle they form pays you in Mana Crystals.

message.wildercord.retemper.aura: Tempering: your aura has been measured again. It settles from %1$s back to %2$s; your experience is kept, and the breakthrough waits again once it reaches the new threshold.
message.wildercord.tribulation.warn: The %1$s circle will not form quietly: when its meditation completes, a tribulation of %2$s waves comes for you. Find open ground, and be ready.

message.wildercord.pot.cold: The pot is cold: set it over a lit campfire, fire, magma or lava.
message.wildercord.pot.nothing: Nothing in your pack makes a meal yet. Open the cookbook with an empty hand.
tooltip.wildercord.skyray_bridle: Calls your skyray down from the open sky.
tooltip.wildercord.skyray_bridle.ride: Use to ride. Fly where you look; sneak to step off.
message.wildercord.tribulation.bridle: A skyray circles overhead, waiting for you. A Skyray Bridle falls from the storm.
guide.wildercord.ridgeback_stag.hint: Look for a chestnut stag with a dark ridge down its back on plains, meadows and savannas.
guide.wildercord.ridgeback_stag: A broad chestnut stag bred for the road: the Lumen Stag’s plainer cousin, with horn-coloured antlers and a dark ridge of mane down its spine. Climb on it until it stops throwing you, as you would a horse, then saddle it to ride. It eats wheat, apples, carrots and hay; two tamed stags fed golden apples or golden carrots raise a calf. The stablemaster at a Wayfarer Inn sells deeds to tame ones.
guide.wildercord.reefback_turtle.hint: Look for a great sea turtle with coral on its shell on beaches and mangrove shores.
guide.wildercord.reefback_turtle: A sea turtle big enough to carry a rider, its shell crusted with coral. Ashore it is slow, but in water it swims the way its rider looks, diving or climbing, never throws them off under water and keeps them breathing. Climb on it until it stops throwing you, as you would a horse, then saddle it to ride. Kelp and seagrass heal it and calm a wild one; two tamed reefbacks fed golden apples or golden carrots raise a hatchling.
guide.wildercord.delver_mole.hint: Look for a huge velvet-black mole with a pink star of a nose on plains, meadows and in forests.
guide.wildercord.delver_mole: A mole the size of a pony, with spade claws and a twitching pink star for a nose. Tame it as you would a horse and saddle it, and it digs you a tunnel as it goes through anything a shovel takes that is no harder than grass: dirt, sand, gravel, clay, snow. Ride straight to tunnel level; look down to dig down and up to dig up. It drops what it digs, and never digs where you could not dig yourself. Carrots, potatoes and beetroot heal it and calm a wild one; golden food readies two tame ones to raise a pup.
message.wildercord.mount_bond.full: Bond %s — as close as can be
message.wildercord.mount_bond.deepened: Your bond with %s deepens to level %s. It runs quicker and stands sturdier.
message.wildercord.mount_bond.deepened.d: Your bond with %s deepens to level %s. Sprint while riding and it dashes ahead.
message.wildercord.mount_bond.deepened.s: Your bond with %s deepens to level %s. Land from a jump and it strikes the ground, throwing back what’s around it.

tooltip.wildercord.ridgeback_deed: Use it and a tame, saddled Ridgeback Stag of yours is led up beside you.

message.wildercord.inn_raid.failed.time: The bandits outlasted you and slipped away into the night.

guide.wildercord.rootmolt_strider.hint: Watch broad bark plates below damp cave banks where a snail has matured Glowcaps. Raised shovel arms announce a straight physical rake.
guide.wildercord.rootmolt_strider: Rootmolts eat mature Glowcaps, then guard the same garden while their next meal settles. Six feet carry bark plates and exposed gills; raised shovel arms commit to one straight physical rake. Step sideways during the warning, strike the creature to break its grip, or cleanse the short Root Tether. Sheltered narrow nurseries can admit a snail while excluding this broader rival. Killing it yields no materials.
item.wildercord.maras_empty_bell.lore: The clapper was removed so the roots could hear the rim.
item.wildercord.maras_empty_bell.use: Stand still and hold use for one second near one visible Rootmolt warning or grab. Moving or changing the held bell cancels commitment. Interrupts that creature; one wear, twelve-second shared rest and two heavy seconds. Restore or repair at the authentic Drainhouse alcove.
item.wildercord.rootbound_greaves.lore: Small roots woven through leather remember one still place.
item.wildercord.rootbound_greaves.use: Wear in the feet slot. Crouch still on dry ground for 1.5 seconds to resist one Rootmolt hold after its physical damage. Eight extra wear, ten-second shared rest and two heavy seconds. Movement, jumping, swimming, sprinting or swapping boots breaks preparation.
message.wildercord.drainhouse.snail: Crouch with an empty hand and gather dew from a rested Sporeback carrying a bead.
message.wildercord.drainhouse.threshold: Read the threshold ledger of an authentic Belowkeeper Drainhouse.
message.wildercord.drainhouse.meal: Stay within six blocks, with a clear view, while a living Rootmolt eats a mature Glowcap.
message.wildercord.drainhouse.garden: Read the damp garden ledger after that actual meal.
message.wildercord.drainhouse.counter: After seeing a meal, strike the living Rootmolt during its warning or rake, or sidestep the rake and stay nearby until it ends.
message.wildercord.drainhouse.alcove: Read the raised copper alcove ledger after proving that counter.
message.wildercord.drainhouse.restore: Hold Mycelial Dew and use the raised alcove desk with two dew, two dried gills and four copper ingots.
message.wildercord.drainhouse.done: The bell is yours. Return with one dew, one gill and one copper to mend eight wear after the desk rests a minute.
message.wildercord.drainhouse.replica: This ledger has no authentic Drainhouse provenance, or you cannot reach it.
book.wildercord.drainhouse.0.1:
Mara, Belowkeeper

A drain is a promise: water goes where we guide it. The hill settled, but green gutters still catch rain. The ribs still hold the roof. This house did not fall at once.
book.wildercord.drainhouse.0.2:
The third breath

The pale spiral leaves the cap standing. The six-footed keeper eats it and guards the bank. We called both helpers too soon. Watch the meal before giving a creature a name.
book.wildercord.drainhouse.0.3:
A safe visit

Gently gather real dew from a snail first. Prepare a bud with Life; leave the spiral a clear path. See a living Rootmolt eat a mature cap within six blocks, then read the garden desk.
book.wildercord.drainhouse.1.1:
Six feet at table

The cap vanished beneath breathing gills. No dew bead filled my jar. The plated stranger left, then turned when I neared its bank. Hunger had ended. Ownership had begun.
book.wildercord.drainhouse.1.2:
A refused line

Hit a living keeper during its warning, rake or hold. Or step aside: stay near the marked line, keep a clear view and let the rake finish. Running far away proves no counter.
book.wildercord.drainhouse.1.3:
The upper desk

The hands that saw the meal must prove a counter. A corpse cannot show a warning. Bring that witness to the raised copper alcove and read its ledger. We left the empty bell unfinished.
book.wildercord.drainhouse.2.1:
The empty bell

I took out the cracked clapper and tapped the rim. The roots loosened. Others called it a charm. I call it a brief, close interruption that can leave both creatures alive.
book.wildercord.drainhouse.2.2:
Restore the rim

Read all three desks; prove the meal and counter. Bring two dew beads, two harvested gills and four copper ingots. Use dew on the authentic upper desk. Each traveller earns one bell.
book.wildercord.drainhouse.2.3:
Rootbound feet

Craft greaves with boots, copper, gills and dew. Crouch still on dry ground; one hold is stopped after its wound. Bell and roots must rest. Mend at this desk with dew, gills and copper.
item.wildercord.reedwater_waders.lore: Turned cuffs remember the banks, not the depths.
item.wildercord.reedwater_waders.use: Feet slot. Walk on real shallow-water support without sprinting for a modest water movement aid. One extra wear per second of actual movement; five walking seconds require two seconds of shared rest. No breathing, damage or root immunity.
item.wildercord.dewglass_spectacles.lore: Tamsin repaired the left hinge with reed wire.
item.wildercord.dewglass_spectacles.use: Head slot, no armour. Crouch and look at a visible Reedback warning within eight blocks for half a second. Physical reed notches identify raised claws. One wear and three seconds of shared rest. Walls, hidden animals and committed sweeps refuse.
item.wildercord.bank_surveyors_line.lore: The spool measures a crossing; it does not make one.
item.wildercord.bank_surveyors_line.use: Use two visible supported banks within five seconds, up to eight blocks apart and one step high. Surveys a short direct shallow-water or dry route. Two wear, four-second shared rest, five-second private braid. Sneak-use cancels. Protected, deep, obstructed or unloaded cells refuse.
message.wildercord.bank_line.rest: The line needs a moment to settle.
message.wildercord.bank_line.bank: Choose a nearby visible solid bank with two clear body blocks.
message.wildercord.bank_line.first: First peg observed. Choose the other bank within five seconds.
message.wildercord.bank_line.crossing: No clear supported crossing: check depth, clearance, protection and distance.
item.wildercord.reed_rattle.lore: Smooth river pebbles answer the reed crown inside a little clay chamber.
item.wildercord.reed_rattle.use: Crouch and use on a visible Reedback Crab within three blocks while its claws warn. Six seconds of calm; 20-second rest; 48 uses. Cannot stop a committed sweep.
message.wildercord.reed_rattle.crouch: Lower yourself first: crouch to answer the raised claws.
message.wildercord.reed_rattle.reach: Move within three blocks, with a clear view of the crab.
message.wildercord.reed_rattle.rest: Let the reed fibres rest: about %s seconds remain.
message.wildercord.reed_rattle.warning: Answer raised warning claws; a committed sweep cannot be stopped.
message.wildercord.reed_rattle.crab_rest: This crab has already answered recently. Give its reed crown time to settle.
message.wildercord.reed_rattle.settle: The claws lower. Six quiet seconds to pass its bank.
item.wildercord.mycelial_dew.lore: A single cool bead, gathered after a patient fungal visit.
item.wildercord.mycelial_dew.use: Combine with paper and a brown mushroom for Fungal Poultice.
item.wildercord.fungal_poultice.lore: Belowkeepers call its pale glow borrowed sight.
item.wildercord.fungal_poultice.use: Use for 30 seconds of Night Vision; Slowness for the first 6 seconds. Cannot refresh active Night Vision.
message.wildercord.sporeback.quiet: Crouch with an empty hand to gather a ready dew bead.
message.wildercord.sporeback.wait: The spiral has no ready dew. Let it browse living fungi and recover in peace.
message.wildercord.sporeback.poultice_re: Your sight is already clear; the poultice is kept.
guide.wildercord.sporeback_snail: A peaceful cave browser with an offset spiral shell. Find it on moss or clay beneath Y48 in lush or dripstone caves. It visits mushrooms without eating the block, then holds one dew bead. Crouch empty-handed to gather; each snail rests two minutes between gatherings and must browse again. Fire and physical harm retract its antennae and prevent gathering. Life produces a brief spore answer without minting dew. Brightness sends it toward nearby cover. No breeding or unique death loot.
guide.wildercord.sporeback_snail.hint: Below the moss banks, watch pale spiral shells beside mushrooms. Their antennae move slowly.
book.wildercord.sporeback.1:
Mara, Belowkeeper

I thought the pale spiral was another stone. Then its eyes opened. It followed the damp bank to a brown mushroom and rested its mouth against the cap. The mushroom stayed. A cool bead appeared above the shell.
book.wildercord.sporeback.2:
Borrowed sight

We gather kneeling, with bare hands. A frightened spiral closes its doors. No fire, no knocking. Even a second living chant cannot hurry the bead. Leave the mushroom and the snail both standing; return after its rest.
book.wildercord.sporeback.3:
The first stairs

Fold dew into paper with brown mushroom pulp. Darkness parts for half a minute, but the first steps feel heavy. Carry a torch as well. The Belowkeepers never mistake a glimpse for a map; deeper doors still have to be found.
guide.wildercord.reedback_crab: A territorial keeper of shallow swamp banks. Raised claws and trembling reeds warn before a fixed forward sweep; step sideways and answer during its recovery. Sneak past outside its close personal space. Tidebreath calms it briefly; wind interrupts its claws. Its response rest survives reloading. It leaves small pieces of wet-bank clay, useful in fieldcraft. Peaceful worlds suppress aggression.
guide.wildercord.reedback_crab.hint: Watch low, open swamp banks near water. A reed crown on a mudstone shell may walk sideways.
book.wildercord.reed_roof.1:
UNDER THE REED ROOF

Tamsin, Tideward apprentice

Iona taught me to weave a roof, never a cage. Leave four sides open. Set the posts in shallow water, where a newt can swim beneath the shade without scraping its gills.
book.wildercord.reed_roof.2: Three bamboo, floss, string and seagrass make the refuge. Newts visit in daylight or rain. One rests beneath a roof at a time: eyes close, gills settle, the tail curls. A rest is brief; seagrass or answering magic can wake the visitor.
book.wildercord.reed_roof.3: A roof offers no extra pearl and heals no wound. Give a frightened animal time and leave its gathering rest alone. Our older rule was simple: one shelter holds one visitor; a living bank holds many. Build another roof, rather than another cage.
item.wildercord.manual_page.lore: Carried in a knight's armour since the knight was a swordsman.
item.wildercord.manual_page.use: %s pages of one method and a book bind into its Breathing Manual.
item.wildercord.aura_shard.lore: A sliver of a fallen knight's aura, set hard as crystal. It's still warm.
item.wildercord.aura_shard.use: At a smithing table it forges a diamond or netherite blade with aura; it's the heart of a Breath Sash.
tooltip.wildercord.gear.sash: Aura: holds more, and the breathing stance settles twice as fast and breathes in half again as much
tooltip.wildercord.aura_forged.lumenedge: Aura-forged: %s%% more aura from every blow
Lumen antler grown along the blade. It drinks in what it strikes.
tooltip.wildercord.aura_forged.skyrend_g: Aura-forged: Aura Slash %s%% stronger, flying further and wider, through more foes
Storm-glass in the edge. Its crescents carry like thunder.
tooltip.wildercord.aura_forged.bulwark_m: Riven stone in its head. It stands like a wall.
message.wildercord.duelist.challenge: %1$s, who breathes %2$s, looks you over: "You carry a blade. Will you cross it with mine?"
message.wildercord.duelist.challenge_how: Use the duelist again within ten seconds to accept. It will meet you at %s. Nobody dies: brought low, you're knocked out, and it yields.
message.wildercord.duelist.begins: The duel with %s begins. Win, and it teaches you its breathing.
message.wildercord.duelist.resting: %s is catching its breath: "Again? Give me a moment."
message.wildercord.duelist.no_blade: %s eyes your empty hands: "Come back with a blade."
message.wildercord.duelist.turns_aside: %s turns your blow aside with its sheathed blade: "Speak to me first."
message.wildercord.duelist.won: %1$s kneels: "Well fought. Breathe as I breathe." It shows you %2$s.
message.wildercord.duelist.manual: You already breathe another way: it hands you its manual of %s, to read if you choose.
message.wildercord.duelist.magic: %s frowns: "You leaned on magic. The lesson stands, but it proves nothing of your blade."
message.wildercord.duelist.lost: %s sheathes its blade: "Breathe, and come back when your blade is steadier."
message.wildercord.duelist.forfeit: %s sheathes its blade: the duel is over.
message.wildercord.duelist.called_off: The duel with %s is called off.
guide.wildercord.duelist: A sword master in a travelling cloak, met near villages, on roads and at small campfires. Use one to be challenged to a duel at your own stage; win, and it teaches you its breathing method
guide.wildercord.duelist.hint: A cloaked traveller by a campfire, a blade at the hip
guide.wildercord.fallen_knight: Old armour that aura still walks in. It raises its blade before a slash (step off the line on the ground) and braces its guard: wait it out, strike from behind, or break it with an axe
guide.wildercord.fallen_knight.hint: Plate scraping in the deep halls: strongholds, ancient cities, old dungeons
message.wildercord.master.first_clear: First clear recorded: %s. Your technique lesson is permanent.
message.wildercord.master.first_clear_kn: First clear recorded: %s. You already know this school's technique lesson.
screen.wildercord.aura.masters_rebind: Rebind in Options > Controls > Key Binds > Wildercord: Master's Arts
aura.wildercord.art.spellcut.desc: Edge: after a short windup, sever up to 3 incoming hostile bolts in front and slash nearby foes. 14 aura; 3 second rest.
aura.wildercord.art.rising_break.desc: Form: a rising blade strike wears extra stance and lifts ordinary foes. 20 aura; 5 second rest.
aura.wildercord.art.driving_cut.desc: Form: a committed 5-block thrust breaks a damaged held spell, including absorption, then seals casting for 1 second. Held spells share 8-second interrupt protection. 18 aura; 4 second rest.
message.wildercord.master.dialogue: %s Master: A lethal trial for up to 8 challengers. Speak to me again within 10 seconds to accept.

message.wildercord.master.stone_lesson: Stone master: Hit my back or axe my guard while I brace. Then dodge the reply and counter.
message.wildercord.master.march_hint: Sidestep, jump the pulse, or step onto spent ground.

message.wildercord.master.thunder_lesson: Thunder master: I plant three rods. Leave each circle before its bolt, and never crowd an ally.
message.wildercord.master.verdant_lesson: Verdant master: My bloom rings the ground you stand on. Leave it before it opens, or be rooted.
message.wildercord.master.hollow_lesson: Hollow master: My well drags you in. Sprint against it and stay outside the core.
book.wildercord.relay_lesson.1:
The Archive's register says its last copyists stood inside the arena's circle. The Archivist copied every word. The margin survived because nobody called it a word.

Ilyra Venn
Third Copyist
book.wildercord.relay_lesson.2: I was not inside the circle. I left my mark there and stepped between the shelves. The spell departed from the mark. When a fallen book hid it, the line closed. The register calls this cowardice. I call it a second place to stand.
book.wildercord.relay_lesson.3:
Thread Relay + Harm, Frost or Shock. Cast sets a focus within 8 blocks. Release the key, move, aim; Cast again within 4s. Cost: 24 + effect, once; no refund. Rest: 8s. Keep both sightlines clear.

Cord > Grimoire > Relay: controls and practice.

message.wildercord.relay_lesson.quiet: The Archive has not fallen quiet. Its lectern cannot be read while the Archivist is abroad.

Caster-to-focus plus focus-to-target may total at most 16 blocks; keep both paths clear. Active VIII and your original Echo Cord/slot remain required. You may use Relay immediately without doing this exercise.

book.wildercord.excise_lesson.1:
The Root That Outlived Its Gardener

The Guardian fell, yet one root kept drinking. Its binding had a knot of its own. I cut leaves until winter before I learned to look where the sap still turned.

The Rootbound Gardener
book.wildercord.excise_lesson.2: You pruned the Guardian's bindings to earn Heartwood. Carry that patience into a living field. Find its small turning knot; keep your sight on it while the thread tightens. Cut there, and tomorrow's pulses cease. Yesterday's venom remains in the blood. A neighboring root keeps its own life.
book.wildercord.excise_lesson.3:
Thread Beam + Excise. With an active Sixteenth Circle, hold Cast on a hostile Zone knot within twelve blocks for sixteen ticks. Pay thirty-six base mana once. Both a clean cut and a broken thread demand recovery. A cut keeps no claim on another root.

Your Grimoire keeps this lesson when the garden is gone.
message.wildercord.excise_lesson.invitat: Heartwood preserves Rootbound study. With an active Sixteenth Circle, read The Root That Outlived Its Gardener in Grimoire > Master studies.
message.wildercord.excise_lesson.locked: Studying Excise requires active Circle XVI and your saved Heartwood victory.
message.wildercord.excise_lesson.interru: The reading closed. Rootbound remains in your Grimoire; begin its three pages again with active XVI and Heartwood.
message.wildercord.excise_lesson.copied: Rootbound is saved in your Grimoire. The bound book is optional; read all three pages here to learn Excise.

screen.wildercord.excise_lesson.beats: Damage, broken sight, moving more than one block, opening a menu, losing focus or changing body/world cancels the paid cut. Your target must still be hostile and in the same resolved ward. Only harmful native Zones without anchored links show eligible knots. Cutting one stops its future pulses; Split siblings, applied venom/fire and earlier secondary magic keep their original lives.
screen.wildercord.excise_lesson.practice: Find a hostile caster's Zone, keep outside its reach if possible, and aim at its small living knot. Hold %s until the thread closes; after recovery, release %s before another try. Your first successful cut records this optional exercise. Each real cut earns bounded utility mastery; practice-room caps and repetition limits apply.
Practice remembered: one living knot, one deliberate cut

book.wildercord.tollgate_lesson.1:
The Warden's Threshold

The Warden never chased. It drew one line of heat and let us choose to cross. Most of us chose badly, once.
book.wildercord.tollgate_lesson.2: A threshold is not a wall. Draw a low gate on the ground. The first time each foe crosses, it is halted and thrown back to the side it came from. Three tolls and the gate is spent.
book.wildercord.tollgate_lesson.3: Thread Wall + Tollgate. Look at open ground within ten blocks and press Cast. Thirty base mana; ten seconds' rest. A foe may jump it, go around it, or wait it out. Allies pass freely.
message.wildercord.tollgate_lesson.locke: Studying Tollgate needs active Circle X and Tempered.
message.wildercord.tollgate_lesson.uncop: Tempered, earned against the Cinder Warden, unlocks this study.

message.wildercord.tollgate_lesson.learn: Tollgate learned. Its study stays in Grimoire > Master studies.
message.wildercord.tollgate_lesson.pract: First Tollgate done. Your Grimoire remembers the exercise.
screen.wildercord.tollgate_lesson.invita: Earn Tempered against the Cinder Warden, then study with an active Tenth Circle.
screen.wildercord.tollgate_lesson.beats: Counterplay: jump the gate, go around its five blocks, or wait out six seconds. Each foe is tolled once; allies, pets and party members pass. Claims and dungeon wards refuse the ground.
screen.wildercord.tollgate_lesson.practi: Practice: set a gate between you and a foe and let it cross. Press %s on the ground; the first toll records this exercise.
book.wildercord.lifeline_lesson.1:
The Thread Between Stars

The Eater pulled stars apart. We learned to hold them together: one thread, one friend, one pull.
book.wildercord.lifeline_lesson.2: Press Cast at an ally in sight to tie a thread. Press again to reel them to safe ground beside you. A friend who crouches holds fast and refuses the pull.
book.wildercord.lifeline_lesson.3: Thread Beam + Lifeline. Twenty-eight base mana for the thread; the reel is free. It snaps past twenty-four blocks or after eight seconds. Ten seconds' rest.
message.wildercord.lifeline_lesson.locke: Studying Lifeline needs active Circle XIV and Starbreaker.
message.wildercord.lifeline_lesson.uncop: Starbreaker, earned against the Star Eater, unlocks this study.

screen.wildercord.lifeline_lesson.beats: Counterplay: the ally crouches to refuse. The reel needs sight, safe ground beside you and ground you may change. Distance, death, a world change or leaving the party snaps it.
screen.wildercord.lifeline_lesson.practi: Practice: tie a thread to a party member or your pet, then press %s again to reel them in. The first reel records this exercise.
book.wildercord.conduit_lesson.1:
Notes on a Grounded Storm

The Conductor fell when we learned to ground its rods. Rods work for us too, if nothing stands on them.
book.wildercord.conduit_lesson.2: Press Cast at open ground within twenty blocks to plant a rod. Press again to spark for a moment, then arrive on it. A blow during the spark breaks it.
book.wildercord.conduit_lesson.3: Thread Pillar + Conduit. Thirty-two base mana per rod; arriving is free. A foe beside the rod grounds it. Keep it in sight and within thirty-two blocks. Fifteen seconds' rest.
message.wildercord.conduit_lesson.locked: Studying Conduit needs active Circle XVIII and Grounded.

book.wildercord.reweave_lesson.1:
I kept the tide's accounts. Four debts, entered before the first was paid. You broke my flood and thought the ledger empty. Look again: an unwritten line is still owed.

The Tide Scribe
At the ebb
book.wildercord.reweave_lesson.2: A wall of water obeys the current. This account obeys its first payment. Draw Harm in a circle; then pull its unpaid marks into one narrow line. Keep the place and the hour. Change only the shape. What the warning swallows is spent.
book.wildercord.reweave_lesson.3:
Thread Reweave + Harm. Pay 40 total base mana once. Rest: 160 ticks. Radius 2; beats 8, 28, 48, 68; ends at 80. Release, aim, cast again: one 7 x 1.25 lane, warned for 8 ticks. Lost beats stay lost.

Controls: Cord > Grimoire.
message.wildercord.reweave_lesson.invita: Low Tide preserves The Ebb Ledger. With an active Twelfth Circle, open Cord > Grimoire > Master studies and read its three pages to learn Reweave. No return to the Scriptorium is needed.
message.wildercord.reweave_lesson.quiet: Only a Tide altar whose Scribe has fallen can offer a bound Ebb Ledger. Low Tide already keeps the lesson in your Grimoire.

message.wildercord.reweave_lesson.copied: The Ebb Ledger is saved in your Grimoire. Read its three pages to learn Reweave; the bound book is optional.

screen.wildercord.reweave_lesson.control: Open %s and thread only Reweave + Harm in an active Echo Cord slot. Select it with %s. Tap %s at visible floor within 8 blocks to place the disc. Release the key, aim along the ground and tap again to rewrite it once into a lane from the same center. Hold %s and make a fresh %s press to cancel.
screen.wildercord.reweave_lesson.limits: Pay 40 total base mana on placement: 32 for Reweave + 8 for Harm, with normal discounts once. Rewriting costs nothing and grants no extra cast rewards. One field; 160-tick (8-second) shared rest. Keep active XII, Low Tide, your learned study and the original Echo Cord and slot. Clear sightlines, loaded ground and the same ward remain required. No modifiers, links, Knots, woven effects, passives, scroll storage or copied casts. No refunds.
screen.wildercord.reweave_lesson.beats: The first shape is a radius-2 ground disc. Its four Harm beats are fixed at ticks 8, 28, 48 and 68, each at half strength. Everything ends at tick 80 (4 seconds after placement). Rewriting changes that same field into one 7-block-long, 1.25-block-wide lane with an 8-tick warning. Beats lost during the warning, obstruction or a late tick are spent forever. The clock, remaining beats and paid damage budget never restart. A rewrite too late to leave a beat after the warning is refused.
screen.wildercord.reweave_lesson.practic: Optional exercise: put a Training Dummy on clear ground more than 2 and less than 7 blocks from your planned center. Tap %s at that center, release, aim toward the dummy and tap %s again early enough for a beat to remain after the warning. A real lane hit outside the old disc records the exercise. Normal mana and rest apply; no XP or extra reward is added. Practice is never required to use Reweave.
Practice remembered: disc → rewrite → reach beyond the circle

screen.wildercord.master_forms.controls: Beside a wall in the air: press %s to brace. Let go, then press again while moving to kick away. Sneak drops; menus cancel.
screen.wildercord.master_forms.limits: Half-second brace; one kick up to 4 blocks across and 1.25 up. Land safely before another. Hits interrupt; falling still hurts.
screen.wildercord.master_forms.cost: 20 Aura, even awakened. 6s shared rest; 0.5s landing recovery.
screen.wildercord.master_forms.author: Iven Reed, road tutor
screen.wildercord.master_forms.source_he:
Reach Sovereign and record a legitimate Gale Master clear; old clears count. Sneak-use a wandering teacher with an empty main hand, read the illustrated lesson and accept it. Any breathing method works. Your story remains here and in the Grimoire, even with a full inventory.

Ordinary admitted swings and spells end an active brace or kick. Aura arts wait through landing plus 0.5s recovery. If landing is impossible, art commitment ends after at most 6s plus 0.5s recovery; Wall Turn itself still needs a true safe landing. Rebind the form in Options > Controls > Key Binds > Wildercord: Master forms.
screen.wildercord.master_forms.practice: Practice: jump by a safe wall. %s, release, press, land. Costs real Aura; no XP.
screen.wildercord.master_forms.readback: Read all three pages here on hover, or open Aura > Master form for the illustrated lesson and current controls.
book.wildercord.wall_turn.1: The ledger says the scout outran pursuit. The Returned Step memorial says she turned back for the last marcher. Neither mentions the watchtower wall. She planted one hand on cold stone and changed which way the road went. I copied the scuff; they copied her footprints.
book.wildercord.wall_turn.2: 'I hung there too long. Their arrow found my cloak. The landing hurt.' The note was sewn inside her boot. Later Marchkeepers called it certainty. I teach her hesitation too: one wall, one turn, one true landing. Seek the Returned Step memorial for the other account.
book.wildercord.wall_turn.3: Iven's charcoal lesson: brace beside a visible wall in the air, release your form key, then press again to kick away. The pause is exposed. Land safely before another turn. Spend 20 Aura; rest 6 seconds. Stone, Anchor and old falls still stop or hurt you.
message.wildercord.wall_turn.teacher_hin: I can teach a Sovereign with a recorded Gale clear the Wall Turn. Sneak-use me with an empty hand for the story and lesson.
message.wildercord.wall_turn.learned: Wall Turn learned. Open the Cord screen > Aura > Master form to equip, read the retained story and see your current binding. Your method is unchanged.
message.wildercord.wall_turn.practiced: Wall Turn: brace, kick and safe landing completed. The lesson remains in your Grimoire and Master-form page.

Up to 5 blocks. Walls, ledges, hazards and wards stop it short with no cut and a longer recovery. No invulnerability.
25 Aura. 5s shared rest; 0.8s recovery, 1.2s if stopped.

2.5 blocks, quick. No invulnerability: it moves you off a lane, it does not dodge a hit. Walls and ledges stop it.
12 Aura. 2.5s shared rest; 0.7s recovery with no guard, step or arts.
book.wildercord.cinder_lunge.1: Kiln guards are not fast. They are certain. Hessa held the furnace gate for eleven winters with a short blade and one habit: sink, wait for the coals to settle, then go all at once. The raiders who saw her crouch ran. The ones who did not, met her.
book.wildercord.cinder_lunge.2: 'The crouch is the warning,' she told apprentices. 'A brave foe steps aside. A foolish one stands. Either way you learn something.' She never lunged at a wall or off a ledge. A lunge that stops short leaves you standing in their reach with your weight on the wrong foot.
book.wildercord.cinder_lunge.3: Hessa's lesson: on solid ground, press your form key. Plant for a beat, dash up to five blocks where you look, and cut whatever stands at the end. Spend 25 Aura; rest 5 seconds. A hit, a wall or a ledge stops it short with no cut.
book.wildercord.reed_slip.1: Wall Turn was the scout's. This one is mine, and smaller. On the river road the marsh reeds never break in wind; they lean out of the way and stand back up. I watched them for a season before I tried it with a blade in hand.
book.wildercord.reed_slip.2: It is not a dodge. Nothing passes through you. You simply are not where the cut was going. Step forward and you have only shortened their reach, so the step goes sideways or back, never in. And after, your weight is on your heels. Anyone patient will punish that.
book.wildercord.reed_slip.3: Iven's lesson: on solid ground, hold a strafe or back key and press your form key. You slide two and a half blocks and keep facing. Spend 12 Aura; rest 2.5 seconds. For a moment after, you cannot guard, step or use arts.

screen.wildercord.master_forms.stone_hin: Learn at Sovereign after a recorded Stone Master clear. Sneak-use a wandering Stone teacher with an empty hand. Old clears count; any breathing method works.
Locked: in testing. Stone Hinge is still in testing; an operator can enable it (aura.experimental_stone_hinge). A form already learned stays learned.
Learned permanently from a wandering teacher. It shares the one Master-form slot with Wall Turn. Equip on safe ground, out of combat.

On the ground, hold one strafe key and press %s to plant. A melee blow from in front of where you planted (within about 60 degrees) is turned toward that side; turning the camera afterwards does not change that.

0.3s plant, then a 0.6s catch. You barely move while planted. Damage still lands; only the shove turns. Arrows, blasts and blows from the side or behind push as usual, and so do mobs with extra knockback (attribute or enchantment) or attacks that skip the normal melee hit.
20 Aura, even awakened. 6s shared rest from the plant; 0.5s recovery after.

Reach Sovereign and record a legitimate Stone Master clear; old clears count. Sneak-use a wandering Stone teacher with an empty main hand, read the lesson and accept it. Your copy stays here and in the Grimoire, even with a full inventory.

The plant fails on open drops, hazards, ward edges and the world border, before Aura is paid. If the side lane closes during the catch, the blow pushes you normally. Moving off the plant, jumping or a menu ends it with no refund.
Practice: stand on flat ground, hold a strafe key, press %s, and take a blow from the front. Costs real Aura; no XP.
book.wildercord.stone_hinge.1: The quarry gate had one post left when the slide came. Maren put her back to it and let the rubble push her sideways instead of down. The ledger lists the post as repaired. It does not list her.
book.wildercord.stone_hinge.2: 'A gate does not stop the wind. It swings.' She taught the cutters to stand like the post: feet set, weight low, one side open. The force still arrives. You only choose where it goes.
book.wildercord.stone_hinge.3: Maren's lesson: on firm ground, hold left or right and press your form key to plant. Take the blow from the front while braced and it turns toward the side you held. Spend 20 Aura; rest 6 seconds. The hit still hurts.

aura.wildercord.way_node.blade_edge.pass: Clean hits build momentum a third faster.
aura.wildercord.way_node.blade_edge.chan: It pierces: it cuts on through a held guard instead of stopping there, through ten foes instead of six, and in a clash it has an edge: a little more time on each beat, and an even struggle is its.
aura.wildercord.way_node.blade_form.pass: Finishers add two fifths more (a player's cap still holds).
aura.wildercord.way_node.blade_form.chan: A finisher opens the nearest creature within five blocks whose stance is half worn or more (never a player or a boss), so a worn-down crowd falls one after another.
aura.wildercord.way_node.blade_sovereign: Each finisher feeds your awakening two seconds instead of one, up to eight.
While you're awakened, Aura Slash costs nothing and is ready again in a second.
aura.wildercord.way_node.bulwark_edge.pa: Your stance takes two fifths less wear, and a hit knocks a third less momentum off you.
aura.wildercord.way_node.bulwark_edge.ch: It covers every side, its perfect moment lasts half again as long, a held guard throws a third of each blow it catches back at the striker, and it turns shots back at whoever loosed them (a little aura each).
aura.wildercord.way_node.bulwark_form.pa: Aura armour takes a third of each blow instead of a quarter, and costs a fifth less.
aura.wildercord.way_node.bulwark_form.ch: It challenges: creatures within its reach that hunt your allies turn on you, and a creature that strikes your raised guard staggers.
aura.wildercord.way_node.bulwark_soverei: While you're awakened nothing breaks your stance and everything a foe deals you is a fifth weaker (less against a player's blows); spent, you aren't slowed.
It's a bastion: a foe's shots crossing into it from outside are turned back at its edge, and the creatures inside are slowed a step more.
aura.wildercord.way_node.shadowstep_edge: Blows and arts that land on a foe from behind wear its stance half again as fast.
A perfect guard against a blow slips you behind whoever struck, facing its back, so your counter falls there.
aura.wildercord.way_node.shadowstep_form: For two seconds after an Aura Step every blow you land counts as from behind.
It leaves an afterimage where you set off that strikes a moment later, cutting every foe beside it.
aura.wildercord.way_node.shadowstep_sove: A finisher landed from behind readies your Aura Step at once.
While you're awakened it costs nothing, is ready again in a second, and its afterimage strikes twice.
aura.wildercord.way_node.banner_edge.pas: A third of the momentum you build is built by your allied swordsmen near you too.
aura.wildercord.way_node.banner_edge.cha: Every finisher lets out a rallying cry: you and your allies near you take a sixth less from foes for five seconds, and allied swordsmen build momentum and share half the aura it gave back.
aura.wildercord.way_node.banner_form.pas: A quarter of the aura you gather flows to your allied swordsmen near you.
aura.wildercord.way_node.banner_form.cha: While it presses on a foe, you and your allies within its reach take a tenth less from foes.
aura.wildercord.way_node.banner_sovereig: Allied swordsmen near you lose a third less momentum to hits, and your awakening holds their momentum at the second tier while it burns.
It shelters the party: you and your allies inside take a fifth less from foes, your allied swordsmen gather aura there as you do, and their momentum doesn't ebb.

aura.wildercord.technique_part.thrust.de: A straight lance of a blow down your look, up and down with it: long and narrow, its first foe taking the most.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.rising_cu: Up across the foes in front, throwing them into the air.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.falling_c: Overhead and down onto one or two: narrow and heavy, and hard on a stance.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.sweep.des: Wide and level round the front: many foes, a little each.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.spin.desc: A whole turn: every foe round about you.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.draw.desc: A fast level cut out of the sheath: the lightest stroke, and the cheapest. Every blade knows it from Edge.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.on_the_bl: The stroke lands at once, where your blade reaches. Every blade knows it from Edge.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.wave.desc: The stroke thrown on as a crescent of aura flying seven blocks past its reach (a spin's as a ring racing out), a little lighter; a wall stops it.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.burst.des: The stroke's force breaking out all round you at once: lighter, but nobody near is left out.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.afterimag: A lighter stroke now, and an afterimage left standing where you struck it, striking again from there a moment later. The Way of the Shadowstep lends it.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.pierce.de: Through whatever stands in the way: further, and three more foes, a little lighter. The Way of the Blade lends it.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.sunder.de: Wears a stance two and a half times as hard as an art, to open a foe for your finisher.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.bind.desc: Roots each foe it strikes where it stands for a moment (a player only briefly).
aura.wildercord.technique_part.echo.desc: Strikes each foe again a moment later for half as much, wherever it has gone, if it's still near.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.ward.desc: You take a fifth less from foes for four seconds after. The Way of the Bulwark's own: only it lends it.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.rally.des: You and your allies near take a tenth less from foes for five seconds, and allied swordsmen build momentum. The Way of the Banner's own: only it lends it.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.infuse.de: Your method's own element, twice as strong: an Ember technique burns longer, a Rime one chills deeper, and so on. Every blade knows it from Edge.
