message.wildercord.aura.blade.passed_on: You pass %s to %s. Its story goes on with them.
message.wildercord.aura.blade.passed_sle: It gives you what your stage allows, and wakes the rest as you grow into it.
message.wildercord.aura.blade.tier.named: It has taken a name of its own. Give it another on the Aura page's Blade tab, if you wish.
message.wildercord.aura.blade.tier.awake: It offers three traits drawn from how you fight: choose one on the Aura page's Blade tab.
message.wildercord.aura.blade.tier.soulf: Its trait is half again as strong, and it offers its traits once more: keep yours, or take another free.
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.off: Bonded blades don't work on this server.
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.before_edge: A swordsman bonds one blade from %s: a blade that grows with every fight, kept through death and only ever theirs.
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.how: Kneel in the breathing stance at a ley crossing with the blade in hand and hold still: in ten seconds it's bonded to you. You can bond one blade at a time.
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.step_blade: Hold the blade you mean to bond: a sword, an axe, a spear or the mace (aura-forged ones too).
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.step_crossi: Find a ley crossing, a place of power where two ley lines meet (the ley lines show them).
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.step_kneel: Kneel in the breathing stance and stay still while the ley lines run into the blade.
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.hand_none: Nothing in your hand can be bonded.
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.hand_yes: %s, in your hand, can be bonded.
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.hand_no: %s can't be bonded: only a sword, axe, spear or mace, one at a time, that wears.
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.gives_kept: Kept through death and never breaking: worn to its last point it stays notched until you mend it.
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.gives_yours: Only yours: nobody else can pick it up, take it from a chest, or use its aura, and in anyone else's hands it comes straight home to you. It can't burn, rot away or be lost to the void.
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.gives_grows: It grows with every fight you win with it (its resonance), takes on your aura's colour, and keeps its story.
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.sleeps: Waits for you to reach %s to give all it has
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.resonance_t: Gathered in every fight with it in hand: foes felled (more for stronger ones and bosses), arts, techniques and finishers that land, stances broken, perfect guards, awakenings, duels won, and breakthroughs carried through. One foe can only give so much.
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.waits_boss: Soulforged waits for a boss felled with it
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.waits_top: As far as a blade can grow
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.name_later: It takes a name at Named (%s resonance): one of its own, or yours.
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.suggest_tip: A name of its own, from its story: your method, your Way, where it was bonded, what it has felled, its favourite art. Click again for another.
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.trait_later: It takes a trait at Awakened (%s resonance, from %s), drawn from how you fight.
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.trait_readi: What it reads in how you fight so far:
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.traits_off: Traits don't work on this server
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.last_with_y: It was last with you at %s, %s, %s in %s.
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.away_how: A bonded blade is never lost: it lies where you left it (it can't burn or rot away, and nobody else can pick it up or take it from a chest), it comes home from anyone else's hands and from the void, and a death keeps it with you.
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.release_not: Releasing lets it go for good, to bond another.
screen.wildercord.aura.blade.release_tip: The blade is only steel again (remembering whose it was), its growth and gifts gone; bond it or another anew at a ley crossing.
tooltip.wildercord.bonded_blade.waits_bo: Waits for a boss felled with it
tooltip.wildercord.bonded_blade.trait_wa: A trait waits to be chosen (the Aura page)
tooltip.wildercord.bonded_blade.notched: Notched: it won't break, but mend it
tooltip.wildercord.bonded_blade.not_your: Bonded to %s: it carries no aura for you, and goes home
tooltip.wildercord.bonded_blade.bonded_o: Bonded on day %s at a ley crossing in %s (%s, %s)
tooltip.wildercord.bonded_blade.deed.due: won a duel against a duelist of %s
command.wildercord.aura.blade.not_carrie: Their bonded blade isn't with them
command.wildercord.aura.blade.cant_bond: Hold a bondable blade, from Edge, with no bond already standing
aura.wildercord.blade_trait.well_worn.de: Its favourite art costs 15% less aura and rests 15% less with it in hand.
aura.wildercord.blade_trait.well_worn.sh: Its favourite art cheaper, and back sooner.
aura.wildercord.blade_trait.closing_stro: Finishers with it give back half again as much aura, and build 4 more momentum.
Finishers give back more aura and momentum.
aura.wildercord.blade_trait.sundering_st: Blows, arts and slashes with it wear a stance 12% harder (6% on a player).
aura.wildercord.blade_trait.riposte.desc: For two seconds after a perfect guard, your next coated blow lands 15% harder (half that on a player).
aura.wildercord.blade_trait.riposte.shor: The blow after a perfect guard lands harder.
aura.wildercord.blade_trait.wind_step.de: Aura Step costs a quarter less and rests 15% less with it in hand.
aura.wildercord.blade_trait.wind_step.sh: Aura Step cheaper and back sooner.
aura.wildercord.blade_trait.long_crescen: Aura Slash costs a fifth less and flies a fifth further.
aura.wildercord.blade_trait.inkbound.des: Techniques of your own cost 10% less with it and rank a fifth faster.
aura.wildercord.blade_trait.second_blaze: Your awakening comes back a quarter sooner, and you're spent a quarter less long after it.
aura.wildercord.blade_trait.mountainfell: Against bosses and Runebound foes, coated blows and arts land 10% harder and wear their stance 15% harder.
Harder on bosses and mighty foes.
Coated blows with it land 12% harder on the undead.
aura.wildercord.blade_trait.last_light.d: Below a third of your health, you take 8% less from foes.
aura.wildercord.blade_trait.last_light.s: Less harm taken when you're nearly down.
aura.wildercord.blade_trait.moonwake.des: At night, blows with it draw a quarter more aura.
aura.wildercord.blade_trait.moonwake.sho: More aura from blows at night.
aura.wildercord.blade_trait.rallying_ste: Your finishers give allied swordsmen within 10 blocks 5 momentum.
Kept through death and never breaking; only you can pick it up, take it from a chest or use its aura, and it comes home from anyone else's hands. It gathers resonance in every fight.
It takes a name, its own or yours, and blows with it draw a tenth more aura.
It offers three traits drawn from how you fight, and takes the one you choose.
Its trait half again as strong, blows a fifth more aura, its fullest look, and its traits offered once more (change free, once).
message.wildercord.hearth.no_mount: No mount or animal to sing to
message.wildercord.hearth.lodestar_far: Your lodestar is too far, or in another world
message.wildercord.hearth.homeward_rest: Homeward needs %s more seconds of rest
message.wildercord.hearth.star: You're at %s, %s, %s facing %s. Spawn is %s blocks away
message.wildercord.hearth.time: It's about %s o'clock. Moon phase %s of 8
message.wildercord.tide.open_water: Open water: treasure can bite here
message.wildercord.tide.closed_water: Not open water: no treasure here
message.wildercord.tide.not_in_water: You need to be in water
message.wildercord.tide.not_in_boat: You need to be in a boat
message.wildercord.delve_stopped: Stopped short of lava, water or a drop
message.wildercord.deepsound_none: No ore in the 16 blocks below
message.wildercord.millstone_none: No cobblestone or gravel to grind
message.wildercord.toolmend_none: Nothing to mend, or no material for it
message.wildercord.delve_no_blocks: No stone, dirt or planks in your pack
message.wildercord.delve_no_chest: Aim at a chest, barrel or shulker box
screen.wildercord.lore_journal.title: Lore Journal
screen.wildercord.lore_journal.hidden: Leads not found yet: %s. Explore ruins, talk to duelists, read your field guide.
screen.wildercord.lore_journal.empty.pla: No places yet. Look for memorials, tombs and tournament boards.
screen.wildercord.lore_journal.empty.peo: No one met yet. Duelists wander the world.
screen.wildercord.lore_journal.empty.tal: No conversations yet. Use a duelist to talk.
journal.wildercord.entry.victory: Won the trial of the %s Master.
journal.wildercord.entry.place.sleeping_: Found a Sleeping Blade in stone.
journal.wildercord.entry.place.crossroad: Stood at the Crossroads of the Ways.
journal.wildercord.entry.learned.lineage: Joined a lineage of master and disciple.
journal.wildercord.entry.learned.techniq: Wrote a technique of your own.
journal.wildercord.quest.scout_wall.clue: A memorial says the Marchkeepers' scout carved a last lesson under a watchtower wall. Gale teachers still tell it.
journal.wildercord.quest.scout_wall.hint: Duelists wander open country. Look for one breathing Gale, and use them to talk.
journal.wildercord.quest.scout_wall.done: The Gale duelist knew the scout's story. Ask Iven's students about Wall Turn when you reach Aura Form.
journal.wildercord.quest.kiln_gate.title: Hessa's Gate
journal.wildercord.quest.kiln_gate.clue: An Ember duelist spoke of Hessa, who held a kiln gate for eleven winters by breathing slow before every strike.
journal.wildercord.quest.kiln_gate.objec: Breathe in the stance at a waterfall or a mountain summit.
journal.wildercord.quest.kiln_gate.hint: You need a breathing method first: win a duel to learn one. Then breathe beside falling water or on a high peak.
journal.wildercord.quest.kiln_gate.done: The fire learned to wait. Training grounds deepen every breath you take there.
journal.wildercord.quest.keeper_openings: The Sword Tomb's testament: the old masters left openings on purpose. A perfect guard finds them.
Guard with Aura just as a blow lands. Practise on any foe; a duelist is safest.
You found the opening. After a perfect guard, your breath's own counter waits for you.
journal.wildercord.quest.warden_threshol: Your field guide notes that some armour breaks only when two elements meet. The Cinder Warden is one.
Set off any element reaction with your spells.
Mark a foe with one element, then hit it with another. Frost then fire is a good start.
Reactions break what plain force cannot. The Cinder Warden's lesson waits at Circle X.
journal.wildercord.quest.different_hands: The tournament stewards keep a ledger of three schools and one rule: win a fair duel first.
Win a duel against any duelist.
Use a duelist to challenge them. Lose, and nothing is taken; try again.
The stewards would bow to you now. Their board is open to you.
Maren's student says every school keeps a Master, and teachers can call one for those who are ready.
Reach Aura Form or Heart Circle VIII. Then sneak and use a teacher twice. The trial is dangerous.
You met a Master. Their record of victories stays with you, win or lose.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.ember.greet: Hessa kept the kiln gate with this breath. Slow in, then all at once.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.ember.hint: Breathe where water falls or wind is thin. The fire learns to wait.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.ember.victor: You stood in the heat and did not flinch. Take the breath with you.
dialogue.wildercord.master.ember.greet: The kiln gate held eleven winters. Show me why you deserve it.
dialogue.wildercord.master.ember.hint: A banked fire is patient. So am I, until I am not.
dialogue.wildercord.master.ember.victory: The coals settle. You may call yourself a keeper of the gate.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.rime.greet: Rime is the breath of the still lake. We move only when we must.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.rime.hint: Frost settles on the patient. Let your foe tire first.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.rime.victory: Your hands stayed steady in the cold. That is the whole art.
dialogue.wildercord.master.rime.greet: I guarded the north ford through a winter that never ended.
dialogue.wildercord.master.rime.hint: Hurry, and you slip. Stay still, and the ice holds you.
dialogue.wildercord.master.rime.victory: The ford is yours to guard now. Do not let it thaw.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.thunder.gree: Thunder breath lives in the moment before the storm breaks.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.thunder.hint: Hold your breath at the top. Release it with the cut.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.thunder.vict: Quick. Quicker than I thought. The storm likes you.
dialogue.wildercord.master.thunder.greet: I learned this on the bell tower, counting between flash and roar.
dialogue.wildercord.master.thunder.hint: Count the beat between my cuts. That is where you strike.
dialogue.wildercord.master.thunder.victo: The bell rings for you now. Count well.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.gale.greet: Iven taught the road this breath. Never twice in the same place.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.gale.hint: The old scout kicked off a watchtower wall. Look for walls.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.gale.victory: You went where I was not. Good. Keep moving.
dialogue.wildercord.master.gale.greet: The Marchkeepers' scout carved her last lesson under a tower. I read it.
dialogue.wildercord.master.gale.hint: Wind does not fight the wall. It goes around.
dialogue.wildercord.master.gale.victory: The scout's road is yours to walk. Leave cairns for the next one.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.stone.greet: Maren kept the quarry gate. A gate does not stop the wind. It swings.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.stone.hint: The ledger of Masters is real. Grow strong, then ask a teacher twice.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.stone.victor: You did not move when I pushed. The mountain approves.
dialogue.wildercord.master.stone.greet: I am the hinge the quarry turns on. Push, if you can.
dialogue.wildercord.master.stone.hint: Strike my back, not my guard. Patience breaks stone.
dialogue.wildercord.master.stone.victory: The hinge turns for you. Keep the gate as Maren did.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.verdant.gree: Verdant breath takes in the light and gives it back.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.verdant.hint: Gardens grew inside the Last Shelter's walls. Mend, then cut.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.verdant.vict: You fought to keep standing, not to win. That is our way.
dialogue.wildercord.master.verdant.greet: I tend the garden the Last Shelter's keeper planted.
dialogue.wildercord.master.verdant.hint: Roots hold best where the ground was broken first.
dialogue.wildercord.master.verdant.victo: The garden is yours to keep. Let it outgrow you.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.hollow.greet: Hollow breath empties you until the world leans in.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.hollow.hint: Breathe out fully before you strike. The pull follows.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.hollow.victo: Nothing left in you, and still you won. Good.
dialogue.wildercord.master.hollow.greet: I keep the empty places. They are fuller than they look.
dialogue.wildercord.master.hollow.hint: Step into the gap I leave. It is not always a trap.
dialogue.wildercord.master.hollow.victor: Carry the hollow lightly. It only takes what you let go.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.starlit.gree: Starlit breath keeps time with the far lights.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.starlit.hint: Field guides and star charts teach the same thing: look first.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.starlit.vict: Your aura gathered faster than mine. The stars noticed.
dialogue.wildercord.master.starlit.greet: I read the sky for the Archive before the copyists left.
dialogue.wildercord.master.starlit.hint: Every star moves. Watch which way before you cut.
dialogue.wildercord.master.starlit.victo: Your light is on the chart now. Do not let it dim.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.hourglass.gr: Hourglass breath lives between one grain and the next.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.hourglass.hi: A perfect guard stops time for a moment. Use it.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.hourglass.vi: You found the gap between my strokes. Few do.
dialogue.wildercord.master.hourglass.gre: I have waited a long time for this duel. I can wait longer.
dialogue.wildercord.master.hourglass.hin: The moment after my cut is yours. Do not waste it.
dialogue.wildercord.master.hourglass.vic: Turn the glass. Your time starts now.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.crimson.gree: Crimson breath keeps the beat of the blood.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.crimson.hint: The Sword Tomb's keeper left openings on purpose. Find them.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.crimson.vict: You bled and did not stop. The blood answers you now.
dialogue.wildercord.master.crimson.greet: I kept the tomb's oath long after the keeper slept.
dialogue.wildercord.master.crimson.hint: Every wound I give is a promise. Guard, and I owe you one.
dialogue.wildercord.master.crimson.victo: The oath passes to you. Keep it better than I did.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.tide.greet: Tide breath rises and falls. Never fight the pull.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.tide.hint: Tideward surveyors read the water's edge. So should you.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.tide.victory: You gave ground and took it back. That is the tide.
dialogue.wildercord.master.tide.greet: I walked the drowned road when the sea took it.
dialogue.wildercord.master.tide.hint: Step back when I surge. Step in when I ebb.
dialogue.wildercord.master.tide.victory: The tide answers you now. Let it carry you home.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.iron.greet: Iron breath is the forge's breath. Heat, strike, cool, repeat.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.iron.hint: The Fallen Knights carried iron pages. Read what they left.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.iron.victory: You took the hammer and did not crack. Good metal.
dialogue.wildercord.master.iron.greet: I forged blades for the Marchkeepers before they broke the line.
dialogue.wildercord.master.iron.hint: Iron bends before it breaks. Test which one I am.
dialogue.wildercord.master.iron.victory: Your edge is tempered. Do not let it rust.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.dune.greet: Dune breath shifts like sand. Nothing stays where you left it.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.dune.hint: Old roads vanish under sand. The cairns still point the way.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.dune.victory: You kept your footing on loose ground. That is rare.
dialogue.wildercord.master.dune.greet: I buried a city's name in the dunes so no one could take it.
dialogue.wildercord.master.dune.hint: Watch my feet, not my blade. The sand tells you first.
dialogue.wildercord.master.dune.victory: The dunes will remember your step. Few are remembered.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.echo.greet: Echo breath answers. Every strike comes back to you.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.echo.hint: The Returned Step memorial teaches what an answer is. Listen there.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.echo.victory: You heard my cut before it landed. Well done.
dialogue.wildercord.master.echo.greet: I sang in the Empty Bell until it rang back.
dialogue.wildercord.master.echo.hint: Strike once. Wait. The second blow is mine.
dialogue.wildercord.master.echo.victory: Your echo is in the stones now. It will answer for you.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.dawn.greet: Dawn breath wakes slow and ends bright.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.dawn.hint: The first light finds what the night hid. Explore early.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.dawn.victory: You won as the light does: slowly, then all at once.
dialogue.wildercord.master.dawn.greet: I keep watch through the last hour of the night.
dialogue.wildercord.master.dawn.hint: Look away when I flare. Then strike what the light shows.
dialogue.wildercord.master.dawn.victory: The sun is up for you. Go and use the day.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.venom.greet: Venom breath is patient. The cut is small. The end is sure.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.venom.hint: Learn which beasts carry poison. The Field Guide knows.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.venom.victor: You did not panic when it stung. That is the cure.
dialogue.wildercord.master.venom.greet: I learned from the marsh, where every bite waits.
dialogue.wildercord.master.venom.hint: Do not trade blows with me. Trade time, and lose less.
dialogue.wildercord.master.venom.victory: The sting is yours now. Use it only when you must.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.any.greet: Every breath has a teacher. I am one of many.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.any.hint: Your journal remembers what you find. Read it often.
dialogue.wildercord.duelist.any.victory: Good fight. Remember what it taught you.
dialogue.wildercord.master.any.greet: Every school keeps a Master. You found this one.
dialogue.wildercord.master.any.hint: Watch my rhythm before you try to break it.
dialogue.wildercord.master.any.victory: You earned this. The ledger will remember.

message.wildercord.vow.release_hover: Costs %s levels; choose again afterwards for free
message.wildercord.vow.unknown: No vow is called that. Use /vow to see them.
message.wildercord.vow.not_reached: Form the %s Circle first (a cracked circle cannot take a vow).
message.wildercord.vow.taken: You already hold the %s Circle's vow. Release it first: /vow release %s
message.wildercord.vow.no_vow: That circle asks for no vow.
message.wildercord.vow.not_taken: You hold no vow at that circle.
message.wildercord.vow.levels: Releasing a vow costs %s experience levels.
message.wildercord.vow.released: The %s Circle's vow is released. Choose again:
path.wildercord.storm.text: Spells 8% stronger and cooldowns 5% shorter, but 20 less max mana. Overflow wakes at three-quarters mana.
path.wildercord.well.text: +40 max mana and +1 mana regen. Meditation fills you twice as fast.
path.wildercord.ward.text: Spells cost 6% less and their effects last 15% longer. Mana Skin turns back 35% of a wound.
message.wildercord.path.offer: The Tenth Circle asks which way your heart will grow. Walk one path (/path to review):
message.wildercord.path.header: Heart Paths: one choice at the Tenth Circle. Leaving a path costs %s levels.
message.wildercord.path.silent: (silent while the Tenth Circle is unformed or cracked)
message.wildercord.path.leave_hover: Costs %s levels; choose again afterwards for free
message.wildercord.path.unknown: No path is called that. Use /path to see them.
message.wildercord.path.not_reached: Form the Tenth Circle first (a cracked circle cannot choose a path).
message.wildercord.path.walking: You already walk %s. Leave it first: /path leave
message.wildercord.path.levels: Leaving a path costs %s experience levels.
message.wildercord.path.left: You step off your path. Choose again:
message.wildercord.ascension.ready: Your heart has condensed enough to Ascend (%s). Meditate (sneak and stand still) for 10 seconds without getting hurt.
message.wildercord.ascension.formed: Ascension %s: +%s max mana, +%s mana regen and +%s%% spell power, on top of all twenty circles.
title.wildercord.ascension.subtitle: Your heart outgrows its twenty rings
message.wildercord.gauntlet.locked: The Gauntlet opens once you have beaten every Sword Master. %s still wait for you (see /master victories).
message.wildercord.gauntlet.running: You are already running the Gauntlet.
message.wildercord.gauntlet.begin: The Gauntlet: %s Sword Masters, one after another. A breath between each, and no second chances.
message.wildercord.gauntlet.lost: The Gauntlet is lost. Every Master is still yours to face again.
message.wildercord.gauntlet.won: You have run the Gauntlet in %s. Your best: %s.
message.wildercord.gauntlet.champion: %s has beaten every Sword Master back to back, in %s.
item.wildercord.gauntlet_blade.lore: Won by %s, who beat every Master in one run
screen.wildercord.field_forms.free: Needs no slot: it works with any equipped form, or none.
message.wildercord.field_form.air_only: This form starts in the air.
message.wildercord.field_form.plunge_blo: Not enough clear air below to dive.
screen.wildercord.field_forms.ember_ripo: Learn at Form after a recorded Ember Master clear, from a wandering Ember teacher.
Learned. Always ready; no slot needed.
After a perfect guard catches a hit, press %s within a moment while holding forward: a short dash and a cut.
Up to 2.4 blocks toward the attacker. Walls and ledges stop it with no cut. No slot needed. No invulnerability.
book.wildercord.ember_riposte.1: Hessa never lunged first. She let the raider swing, took it on the flat of her blade, and only then went. 'A blocked man is a man with his arms in the wrong place,' she said. 'Use that.'
book.wildercord.ember_riposte.2: The answer is short. You have just caught a blow, and your feet are still under you. Two steps, no more, and a cut while their weapon is still out wide. Miss the moment and the moment is gone.
book.wildercord.ember_riposte.3: Hessa's lesson: when a perfect guard catches a hit, press your form key with forward held. You close up to 2.4 blocks and cut. Spend 12 Aura. Your guard drops for it.
message.wildercord.field_form.learned.em: Ember Riposte learned. Read it in the Cord screen > Aura > Master form > Field forms.
Ember Riposte: catch, close and cut completed.
message.wildercord.field_form.teacher_hi: Catch a blow on a perfect guard and I can show you how to answer it. Sneak-use me with an empty hand.
message.wildercord.field_form.need_clear: Clear a Master's trial of my school first.
screen.wildercord.field_forms.gale_shove: Learn at Form after a recorded Gale Master clear, from a wandering Gale teacher.
Learned. Always ready; no slot needed.
After a perfect guard catches a hit, press %s within a moment while holding a strafe key: push the attacker away.
Hits the attacker if still in reach, else the nearest foe ahead. A push and 3s of Weakness, no damage. No slot needed.
book.wildercord.gale_shove.1: On the river road the danger is not the first cut. It is the second man behind the first. Iven taught us to make room before we made anything else.
book.wildercord.gale_shove.2: Take the hit on your guard, then open your free hand and lean in with your whole weight. It is not a blow. It is a door closing. They stumble back, their grip loose, and you have space to think.
book.wildercord.gale_shove.3: Iven's lesson: when a perfect guard catches a hit, press your form key with a strafe key held. You push the attacker back and weaken them for 3 seconds. Spend 10 Aura.
message.wildercord.field_form.learned.ga: Gale Shove learned. Read it in the Cord screen > Aura > Master form > Field forms.
Gale Shove: catch and push completed.
message.wildercord.field_form.teacher_hi: I can teach you to make room after a block. Sneak-use me with an empty hand.
message.wildercord.field_form.need_clear: Clear a Master's trial of my school first.
screen.wildercord.field_forms.stone_brea: Learn at Form after a recorded Stone Master clear, from a wandering Stone teacher.
Learned. Always ready; no slot needed.
After a perfect guard catches a hit, press %s within a moment with no move key: lift the blade and bring it down.
The slowest answer: a long, plain wind-up. A heavy blow, 2s of Slowness, and it drops a player's raised guard. No slot needed.
book.wildercord.stone_break.1: Quarry wardens do not dance. Orla stood where she stood and let the trouble come to her. When it did, she caught it, and then she lifted her blade over her head like a pick.
book.wildercord.stone_break.2: Everyone sees it coming. That is fine. A foe who just struck your guard is still recovering from it, and a raised guard of their own will not hold under the weight. Do not try it on someone fresh.
book.wildercord.stone_break.3: Orla's lesson: when a perfect guard catches a hit, press your form key with no move key held. You lift, then strike hard and slow the foe. Spend 16 Aura.
message.wildercord.field_form.learned.st: Stone Break learned. Read it in the Cord screen > Aura > Master form > Field forms.
Stone Break: catch, lift and strike completed.
message.wildercord.field_form.teacher_hi: I can teach you what to do after you catch a blow. Sneak-use me with an empty hand.
message.wildercord.field_form.need_clear: Clear a Master's trial of my school first.
screen.wildercord.field_forms.air_step.l: Learn at Form after a recorded Gale Master clear, from a Gale teacher, after Wall Turn and Reed Slip.
Learned. Equip on safe ground, out of combat, after the shared rest.
screen.wildercord.field_forms.air_step.c: In the air, press %s: a short lift where you look. Once per jump or fall.
screen.wildercord.field_forms.air_step.l: Under a block of lift. Ceilings and wards stop it. You still take the fall you owe. Lands, splashes or stalls.
screen.wildercord.field_forms.air_step.c: 15 Aura. 3s shared rest; 0.4s recovery on land, 0.3s in water, 1.2s if stalled.
book.wildercord.air_step.1: I never meant to teach this. A student slipped off the ferry rail and, without thinking, kicked off the wind itself. He landed on the deck. He also landed badly, and I will not pretend otherwise.
book.wildercord.air_step.2: You do not fly. You find one more step where there was none, once, and then you are falling again with everything you owed. Over water, you get wet. Into a wall, you get nowhere.
book.wildercord.air_step.3: Iven's lesson: in the air, press your form key. You rise a little where you look. Spend 15 Aura; rest 3 seconds. Only once per time off the ground.
message.wildercord.field_form.learned.ai: Air Step learned. Read it in the Cord screen > Aura > Master form > Field forms.
Air Step: step and landing completed.
message.wildercord.field_form.teacher_hi: I can teach you a step on the wind. Sneak-use me with an empty hand.
message.wildercord.field_form.need_clear: Clear a Master's trial of my school first.
hud.wildercord.air_step.ready: %s in the air: Air Step · 15 Aura
screen.wildercord.field_forms.plunge.loc: Learn at Sovereign after a recorded Stone Master clear, from a Stone teacher, after Stone Break.
screen.wildercord.field_forms.plunge.lea: Learned. Equip on safe ground, out of combat, after the shared rest.
screen.wildercord.field_forms.plunge.con: In the air with 2 clear blocks below, press %s: hang for a beat, then drive straight down. Landing strikes around you.
screen.wildercord.field_forms.plunge.lim: Hits foes within 2.5 blocks on solid ground. Water splashes it out; hazards or a long fall stall it. Fall damage still counts.
screen.wildercord.field_forms.plunge.cos: 20 Aura. 6s shared rest; 1s recovery on land, 1.2s if stalled.
book.wildercord.plunge.1: Orla once came down a quarry face on a rope that broke. She landed on a raider. She said it was the most useful thing that had happened all year, and she spent the next month learning to do it on purpose.
book.wildercord.plunge.2: The hang is the warning. For a breath you hold still in the air, blade high. Then you drop like a stone. Land on rock and the ground shakes. Land in water and you have just had a bath.
book.wildercord.plunge.3: Orla's lesson: in the air with room below, press your form key. You hang, dive, and strike all around where you land. Spend 20 Aura; rest 6 seconds.
message.wildercord.field_form.learned.pl: Plunging Strike learned. Read it in the Cord screen > Aura > Master form > Field forms.
Plunging Strike: dive and landing completed.
message.wildercord.field_form.teacher_hi: Sovereigns may learn to fall with purpose. Sneak-use me with an empty hand.
message.wildercord.field_form.need_clear: Clear a Master's trial of my school first.
hud.wildercord.plunge.set: Plunging Strike: hanging · Sneak to stop
hud.wildercord.plunge.ready: %s in the air: Plunging Strike · 20 Aura
Learn at Form after a recorded Ember Master clear, from an Ember teacher, after Ember Riposte.
Learned. Always ready; no slot needed.
Hold an Aura weapon and attack just as a hostile spell bolt reaches you: cut it from the air.
Close and facing it: the bolt is cut. Too early or too wide: a miss that still costs. No slot needed.
14 Aura and 0.3s recovery on a cut; 6 Aura and 1s recovery on a miss.
book.wildercord.spell_cut.1: Fire mages troubled the kiln more than raiders did. Hessa had no magic. She had a blade and very good timing, and she noticed that a bolt of fire is just a thing in the air, like anything else.
book.wildercord.spell_cut.2: Swing too early and you cut nothing but you are still off balance. Swing late and you are already burning. Wait until it is almost on you, face it squarely, and cut through the middle.
book.wildercord.spell_cut.3: Hessa's lesson: hold an Aura weapon and attack as a hostile spell bolt arrives. Close and square, it is cut for 14 Aura. Too soon or too wide, it is a miss for 6 Aura and a longer recovery.
message.wildercord.field_form.learned.sp: Spell Cut learned. Read it in the Cord screen > Aura > Master form > Field forms.
Spell Cut: a spell cut from the air.
message.wildercord.field_form.teacher_hi: I can teach you to cut a spell from the air. Sneak-use me with an empty hand.
message.wildercord.field_form.need_clear: Clear a Master's trial of my school first.
message.wildercord.master.starlit_lesson: Starlit master: I mark four stars and they burst in the drawn order. Leave each star before its turn.
message.wildercord.master.hourglass_less: Hourglass master: my long thrust replays down the gold lane. Sidestep it and do not step back in.
message.wildercord.master.crimson_lesson: Crimson master: I bleed to strike four times and heal only when I land. Jump low, duck high, sidestep, then get clear.
message.wildercord.master.constellation_: Leave each star before it bursts!
message.wildercord.master.rewind_hint: Sidestep, then stay off the gold lane!
message.wildercord.master.frenzy_hint: Jump, duck, sidestep, then get clear!

aura.wildercord.method.tide.lore: Breathe as the sea breathes: in with the ebb, out with the flood, and never against the current.
aura.wildercord.method.tide.flavour: Tide: a coated blow pushes its foe back and soaks it (its fire out, a moment slowed), a little more at each stage.
aura.wildercord.method.iron.lore: Breathe as the forge's bellows breathe: deep, steady, and every breath feeding the fire in the steel.
aura.wildercord.method.iron.flavour: Iron: a coated blow cracks its foe's armour for three seconds, more at each stage.
aura.wildercord.method.dune.lore: Breathe as the desert wind breathes: dry, patient, and carrying the sand wherever it goes.
aura.wildercord.method.dune.flavour: Dune: a coated blow may throw grit in its foe's eyes, blinding it a moment (a creature loses you), a better chance at each stage.
aura.wildercord.art.riptide_cut.desc: Swing, swing, then a low swing: a wide cut of water that soaks the foes in front (fire out, a moment slowed) and the current drags them in toward you.
aura.wildercord.art.breaker.desc: A leaping swing (in the air), then a low swing: a wave rolls seven blocks out ahead, cutting and throwing back everything in it, and leaves the ground behind it wet for four seconds: foes in it are slowed, and fire goes out.
aura.wildercord.art.whirlpool.desc: The counter (swing straight after a perfect Aura Guard): a whirlpool opens on the ground ahead for three seconds, drawing every foe near to its heart and cutting them each second.
aura.wildercord.art.surge.desc: Straight after your step, a wave carries you eight blocks on, cutting every foe in the way and carrying them along with you, soaked.
aura.wildercord.art.maelstrom.desc: With your aura full, after three full swings and a low swing: the sea rises round you, five waves rolling over every foe near, and then it crashes down and throws them all away.
aura.wildercord.art.sunder_cut.desc: Swing, swing, then a low swing: one heavy cut through the plates that cracks the armour of the foes in front (four points, for five seconds).
aura.wildercord.art.anvil_fall.desc: A leaping swing, then a low swing: you rise and come down like a hammer on an anvil, striking everything near where you land, holding it still a moment and cracking its armour.
aura.wildercord.art.bulwark.desc: The counter: your guard sets like iron for three seconds. Blows land weaker and don't move you, and foes that come near are shoved back. Foes round you as it's raised are cut and thrown back.
aura.wildercord.art.forge_charge.desc: Straight after your step, a shoulder-first charge seven blocks on through the line, cutting every foe in the way and cracking its armour.
aura.wildercord.art.worldforge.desc: With your aura full, after three full swings and a low swing: a hammer of the world falls where you stand. The foe you face is struck hardest, every foe near is cut, thrown back and its armour cracked wide for eight seconds, and your guard sets like iron.
aura.wildercord.art.grit_flick.desc: Swing, swing, then a low swing: a flick of the blade throws sand in the eyes of the foes in front, blinding them a moment (a creature loses you) and slowing them.
aura.wildercord.art.quicksand.desc: A leaping swing, then a low swing: the ground ahead turns to quicksand for four seconds, swallowing the feet of every foe in it (slowed hard, drawn to its heart) and grinding at them.
aura.wildercord.art.sandveil.desc: The counter: a burst of sand round you blinds every foe near, and for a moment you move quickly and nothing quite finds you.
aura.wildercord.art.dune_runner.desc: Straight after your step, a run seven blocks on across shifting sand: every foe in the way is cut, its footing gives way (slowed, sinking) and it's turned aside.
aura.wildercord.art.sea_of_sand.desc: With your aura full, after three full swings and a low swing: the desert rises round you. Gusts of sand blind and sink every foe near, and then the dunes close over them.
Tide's awakened Dominion: the ground is under water. Each second the foes inside are pushed toward its rim and soaked, and while you stand in it no fire holds on you.
aura.wildercord.sovereign.anvil_court.de: Iron's awakened Dominion: each second a hammer of sparks cracks the armour of every foe inside and strikes one of them, and while you stand in it you're hardened against blows.
aura.wildercord.sovereign.shifting_sea.d: Dune's awakened Dominion: the ground is shifting sand. Each second every foe inside sinks (slowed hard) and one of them is blinded by the blowing grit.
aura.wildercord.finisher.undertow.desc: Tide's finisher: a wave breaks over the foe and the undertow drags it away, soaked.
aura.wildercord.finisher.quench.desc: Iron's finisher: a hammer of sparks falls on the foe and its armour cracks wide for five seconds.
aura.wildercord.finisher.dust_devil.desc: Dune's finisher: a spinning column of sand round the foe, which comes out of it blinded.
screen.wildercord.aura.writing.element.c: pushes foes back %s blocks and soaks them
message.wildercord.master.tide_lesson: Tide master: Step inside my wave, then back out before the undertow pulls.
message.wildercord.master.iron_lesson: Iron master: Leave the spot my hammer marks, then jump as the anvil rings.
message.wildercord.master.dune_lesson: Dune master: Sidestep my sand lane, then step back into it before the storm.
message.wildercord.master.undertow_hint: Step inside the wave, then back out past the undertow!
message.wildercord.master.anvil_hint: Leave the marked spot, then jump the ringing ground!
message.wildercord.master.sands_hint: Sidestep the lane, then step back into the pale sand!
